2. **`/boot-animation` 下的路由** —— 带 `Range`、`HEAD`、`416` 处理，交给浏览器自己的媒体栈去解码；配置、图片、视频、网页、小游戏、上传的素材都是经同一套路由提供的。
3. **设置面板** —— 通过 `settings.section` slot 挂进 DSH 设置界面（和 dsh-better-sidebar 等插件同一套契约），读写同一份 `/config`，并管理上传目录。

客户端脚本是把一个真函数 `toString()` 出来的（`lib/inject.js`），所以注入的 JavaScript 是当普通源码被解析和检查的，也保证不含尖括号和 `</script`。

## 自检工具

| 命令 | 能证明什么 |
| --- | --- |
| `node tools/selftest.mjs` | 配置读写、注入行、Range 服务（视频+图片）、六款游戏页面与中继、上传/去重/删除/穿越防护、路由与状态码 —— 44 项 |
| `node tools/browser-check.mjs` | 真实 Chromium 里：视频（含**声音未被静音**）/图片/网页/小游戏四种模式、**跳过按钮可点、iframe 内 Esc 能转发**、六款游戏逐个加载 —— 19 项 |
| `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 <DeepSeek Harness.exe> --expose-internals tools/verify-install.mjs` | 用 DSH 自己的 profile 加载器验证：bundle 被组合进去了（loaded 而不是 skipped），Host 入口能解析 |

---

## 说明与限制

- 视频的 `moov` atom 在文件尾部，所以首帧之前浏览器要把整个 12 MB 抓下来；走 loopback 基本无感。素材如果真的变大，用 `-movflags +faststart` 重新封装就能消掉这个等待。
- **声音**：视频默认带声播放（Electron 允许无手势自动播放）。Web 端浏览器可能拒绝有声自动播放，此时插件自动退回静音并在角上提示，点一下即可带声重来。也可在设置里直接关掉「播放声音」。
- 跳过和硬上限是刻意的设计：开机动画**永远**不应该有能力锁死窗口。
- 遮罩追加到 `body`，从不碰 `#root`，所以 React 的挂载点不受影响；拆除时它会连同自己的监听器和定时器一起收干净。
- `web` 模式加载的是**你给的**网页：如果你在设置里填了外网 URL，开机时 DSH 会去访问它。这是有意为之的能力，不是默认行为（默认是视频）。
- 上传目录没有配额限制，超大视频会占磁盘；不用了请在设置面板里点 × 删除。
- `assets/boot.mp4` 与本仓库的示例素材只作 550W 风味参考，与《流浪地球》官方无关。如果要公开分发本仓库，请自行确认你对该素材拥有相应权利。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 的 Computer Use 插件：25 个工具让模型像人一样操作 Windows 桌面（截图 / UI Automation / 鼠标键盘 / 剪贴板），含置顶操作指示器与随包技能。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-computer-use 把 **ZCode 的 Computer Use（「电脑控制」）能力逆向重建为 DSH 插件**：让模型能看屏幕、 读应用界面、点按、输入、按快捷键、拖拽滚轮、走剪贴板——像人一样操作这台 Windows 电脑。 25 个工具与上游 Computer Use 工具面**同名**，参数语义、坐标纪律、`state_id` 元素寻址、 错误码语义都按上游契约重建；后端换成 Windows 上可用的原生实现 （长驻 `powershell.exe` + System.Drawing + UI Automation），不再依赖 ZCode 那份从未开源的 原生 Helper。 * 逆向复盘（过程 / 决策 / 验证强度 / 诚实的未竟项）：[docs/reverse-engineering.md](docs/reverse-engineering.md) * 上游契约取证（432 处 `path:line` 证据）：[docs/zcode-cua-contract.md](docs/zcode-cua-contract.md) * 原生桥协议（冻结接口）：[docs/native-protocol.md](docs/native-protocol.md) * 模型面操作手册（随包技能）：[skills/computer-use/SKILL.md](skills/computer-use/SKILL.md) --- ## 1. 它从哪来：一次真实的逆向 上游 ZCode 的开源仓库里 Computer Use 是**不可用占位包** （`packages/zcode-cua/index.js` 里 `createComputerUseRuntime()` 直接返回 "Computer Use is not available in this build."），三个必需资产 （`docs/computer-use.md`、`scripts/computer-use-client.mjs`、`skills/computer-use/SKILL.md`） 也不在仓库里。git 只有三个提交，真实实现从未进过历史。 能重建，是因为契约全留下了： | 留下的东西 | 位置 | |---|---| | 25 个工具名 | `packages/ui/src/ToolCallBlocks/renderers/cuaSummaryMessages.ts` | | 元素寻址/坐标/`action_sent` 等模型面纪律 | `apps/zcode-cli/packages/node-repl-host/src/tool-contract.ts` | | broker 私有传输协议（JSON 行 + `id/token/method/input/context`） | `node-repl-host/src/cua-bridge.ts`、`cua-broker.ts` | | 稳定错误码（`element_unavailable`/`foreground_required`/…） | `packages/zcode-cua/broker.js` | | `state_id`、`screenshot_display.bounds`、图像配额、`_meta` 关联键 | `core/src/tool/executor/result-display.ts`、`packages/zcode-cua/frame-contract.*` | | 官方插件定义、版本、seed 资产清单 | `bootstrap/src/app/official-plugin-definitions.ts` | **没**留下的：真实 SDK 的方法签名、Windows Helper 的 RPC、AX 角色映射表 （`ROLE_TO_KIND = {}`）、以及那三个资产文件本身。这些只能重建，见 [docs/zcode-cua-contract.md](docs/zcode-cua-contract.md) 的「未解之谜」与「重建对照表」。 --- ## 2. 架构 ``` ┌──────────────────────── DSH 进程 ────────────────────────┐ │ src/index.js 插件入口：读配置、注册工具、自装技能 │ │ src/tools.js 25 个工具定义 → 参数映射/信封/降级 │ │ src/schema.js 官方同语义的参数校验 + 无损宽化 │ │ src/format.js 模型面信封、app-associations 元数据 │ │ src/bridge.js NDJSON 客户端：串行队列/超时换进程/自愈│ └───────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────┘ │ stdin/stdout NDJSON（dsh-cua/1） ┌───────────────────────────▼──────────────────────────────┐ │ src/native/cua.ps1 长驻 Windows PowerShell 5.1 进程 │ │ SetProcessDPIAware → 截图/窗口/UIA/输入/剪贴板/启动应用 │ └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` 几个刻意的选择： * **不走 MCP、不用 `defineTool`。** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 在插件侧解析不到 （实测 `createRequire(profile/index.js).resolve()` 失败），因此按注册表接受的 **原始 JSON Schema** 直接 `ctx.tools.register()`——这正是 MCP 服务器注册工具的方式。 参数校验由 `src/schema.js` 按官方子集语义补上（文案逐字对齐，测试里与官方实现对比）。 * **PowerShell 而不是原生 addon。** Windows 上 `System.Drawing` + `UIAutomationClient` 在 5.1 宿主开箱可用；不需要随包发布二进制，也不受 DSH 内部 koffi 影响。 * **`SetProcessDPIAware()` 是必须的。** 实测 150% 缩放下不调用它，截图是 1707x1067 而 UIA/窗口坐标是 2560x1600，两个坐标空间不一致，整个 Computer Use 的坐标映射都会错。 * **超时即换进程。** 协议是串行的；超时后无法判断迟到响应属于哪条请求，因此直接 kill 并在下次调用时重启，绝不猜测归属。 --- ## 3. 安装 插件是普通 npm 包 + 一份 cordis patch，两种装法： ### 3.1 App 内从路径安装（推荐） DSH 的「插件」页 → 从路径安装 → 选择本目录 （本仓库 clone 后的目录），然后**重启 DSH**。 ### 3.2 手改 profile 编辑 `/profiles//package.json` （Windows 默认 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json`）： ```jsonc "dependencies": { "dsh-computer-use": "link:E:/OpencodeProject/Project/DSH-Plugin/dsh-computer-use" }, "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ // …其它 bundle "dsh-computer-use" // ← 加入这里，它的 cordis.patch.yml 才会被应用 ] } } ``` 然后在 profile 目录执行 `pnpm install`，重启 DSH。 `cordis.patch.yml` 只做一件事：把本插件的宿主端入口 insert 进 profile 树。 ### 3.3 验证装好了 六层验证，全部可重复执行（数值是本机实测结果）： ```powershell cd <本仓库目录> node tools/ref-extract-validator.mjs # 从 app.asar 提取官方实现到 .ref/（开发期依赖，可选） npm test # 95 通过：单元 + 与官方实现的等价性交叉验证（含访问闸门矩阵） npm run smoke # 147 通过：原生后端 24 个协议方法（真机） npm run e2e # 74 通过：完整链路端到端（真机，含访问闸门验收） npm run indicator:smoke # 54 通过：操作指示器三条硬性质（真机，见下） npm run verify:registry # 10 通过：真实 cordis + 真实 dsh-tools 注册表加载 npm run verify:in-dsh # 14 通过：真实 DSH 里让模型自己点一次按钮（accessMode=auto） node tools/verify-in-dsh.mjs --patch=tools/verify-profile-patch.yml --access-mode=off # 10 通过：禁用场景（桌面未被碰） node tools/verify-in-dsh.mjs --patch=tools/verify-profile-patch.yml --access-mode=ask # 11 通过：询问场景（fail-closed） node tools/install-skill.mjs status # 技能是否已进用户技能根 ``` **关于 `--patch=tools/verify-profile-patch.yml`**：验证用的 `cu-verify` profile 来自出厂 headless 模板，默认走 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`；该 key 余额耗尽后每次运行都返回 402（`error.code === "QUOTA"`）， 模型压根不启动，于是这一层会全红——那不是插件的失败。这个叠加层把模型路由指到可用的 provider （你桌面 profile 里正在用的那套），**通过 `dsh --patch` 叠加，不修改任何 profile 文件**。 **关于 `--access-mode`**：三个场景跑的是**同一个任务**，唯一差别是这一条设置；判据用夹具窗口标题 这个外部事实，而不是工具自己的返回值。`off`/`ask` 场景的期望是"被拒 + 桌面一字未变"， `auto` 场景的期望是"真的点成功"。 `npm run indicator:smoke` 的两条判据（退出码 `0` 通过 / `1` 产品失败 / `2` 环境不稳定无法判定）： * **首选，与背景无关**：`PrintWindow` 让窗口把自己画进抓图 DC——指示器必须整张全黑（拒绝渲染）， 而同构造、无 affinity 的孪生窗必须正常画出卡片。实测 `indicator distinct=1 avgLuma=0` / `twin distinct=45 avgLuma=130`。 * 旁证，逐像素：显示 vs 隐藏截同一区域要求逐像素一致且 PNG 字节相同，并用「目击区」 排除「背景自己在变」。这条要求该区域静止；你屏幕上若跑着全屏游戏/视频，工具会诚实报 **INCONCLUSIVE** 而不是 FAIL。 `verify:in-dsh` 是最强的一层：在**真实 DSH** 里跑一个受控任务 （`dsh --profile

--json`，任务经 stdin 送入），让模型自己加载技能、读界面、 按 `element_index + state_id` 点我们自己的 WPF 夹具按钮；**结论不采信模型汇报**—— 脚本跑完后用原生后端独立再读一次窗口标题，只有真的变成 `CLICKED:1` 才算通过。 它需要一个独立验证 profile（不碰 `desktop`）： ```powershell # 1) 在 dsh 源码 checkout 里用出厂 headless 模板建验证 profile pnpm dsh cu-verify --from-default-profile headless # 2) 把插件装进它（DSH_PROFILE 决定目标 profile） $env:DSH_HOME="$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh"; $env:DSH_PROFILE='cu-verify' node tools/install-plugin.mjs --apply --install # 3) 跑 node tools/verify-in-dsh.mjs --profile=cu-verify ``` 也可以用带备份的安装器一步装进 profile（默认只预览，不改任何东西）： ```powershell node tools/install-plugin.mjs # dry-run：打印将要发生的改动 node tools/install-plugin.mjs --apply --install # 备份 + 写入 + pnpm install node tools/install-plugin.mjs --rollback # 从备份恢复 ``` 装好并重启 DSH 后，在会话里让模型调 `request_access`：它会回报平台、屏幕、DPI 感知、 显示器数量与后端可用性。**这是最直接的端到端确认。** --- ## 4. 配置 配置读 `/plugins/dsh-computer-use/config.json`（不存在则用默认值）， 也可以在 profile 的插件条目里用 `config:` 覆盖（内联优先）。损坏/缺字段时逐字段回退默认值。 | 字段 | 默认 | 含义 | |---|---|---| | `enabled` | `true` | 关掉后一个工具都不注册 | | `tools` | `"native"` | `native` = 25 个独立工具；`single` = 一个 `computer_use`（带 `action`），省 schema token | | `warmup` | `true` | 加载时预热后端；关掉则首次调用才拉起（多等约 1-2 秒冷启动） | | `installSkill` | `true` | 把随包技能装到 `/skills/computer-use/`（带所有权标记，不覆盖用户自写版本） | | `accessMode` | `"auto"` | 谁能调用电脑操控：`auto` 全自动 / `ask` 每次弹审批 / `off` 禁用（见 §5.4） | | `allowSubagents` | `false` | 是否允许**子代理**调用电脑操控（默认关闭：子代理动用户鼠标键盘时用户看不见也难喊停） | | `indicator` | `true` | 是否显示屏幕最前端的「DSH 正在操作电脑」浮层（见 §5.5） | | `indicatorLocale` | `"auto"` | 浮层文案语言：`auto` / `zh-CN` / `en-US` | | `indicatorShowAction` | `true` | 文案后是否带上当前动作（「· 正在点击」） | | `indicatorAutoHideMs` | `30000` | 无操作活动多久后自动隐藏（兜底，防止浮层滞留） | | `requestTimeoutMs` | `30000` | 单次调用默认超时 | | `screenshotTimeoutMs` | `60000` | 截图/取界面树超时 | | `startupTimeoutMs` | `20000` | 等待后端 ready 上限 | | `maxRestarts` | `3` | 后端崩溃后自动重启上限，超出后报明确不可用原因 | | `screenshotMaxWidth` | `1600` | 模型可见截图长边上限（0 = 不缩放） | | `screenshotMaxBytes` | `524288` | 单张截图字节预算，超出按 png→jpeg→更小栅格降级重拍 | | `screenshotFormat` / `screenshotQuality` | `"png"` / `80` | 默认编码与 jpeg 质量 | | `saveFrames` / `keepFrames` | `true` / `40` | 截图落盘到 `plugins/dsh-computer-use/frames/`，只保留最新 N 张 | | `debug` | `false` | 把原生后端的 stderr 诊断写进 DSH 日志 | ```jsonc // 示例：省 token 的单工具模式 + 更小的截图 { "tools": "single", "screenshotMaxWidth": 1280, "screenshotFormat": "jpeg" } ``` --- ## 5. 工具面（25 个，与上游同名） | 分组 | 工具 | |---|---| | 环境与观察 | `request_access` `list_apps` `list_windows` `get_app_state` `screenshot` `zoom` | | 启动与聚焦 | `open_application`（聚焦窗口走 `list_windows` + 前台语义） | | 鼠标 | `left_click` `double_click` `triple_click` `right_click` `middle_click` `mouse_move` `left_click_drag` `scroll` | | 键盘 | `type` `key` `hold_key` | | 元素动作 | `set_value` `select_text` `perform_action` | | 等待与剪贴板 | `wait` `read_clipboard` `write_clipboard` | | 收尾 |

plugins.description: Keeps bulk output out of the conversation from both ends: a routing gate refuses flooding calls (curl/wget in any shell, web_fetch/read_page), and output already inside is slimmed after the tool runs — JSON re-encoded losslessly, tables windowed with line numbers, logs folded keeping diagnostics — originals readable byte-for-byte via ctk_retrieve.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-context-toolkit

> [简体中文](./README.zh.md) | **English** | [Changelog](./CHANGELOG.md)

A DeepSeek Harness bundle whose single job is **keeping bulk output out of the conversation**.

It separates *raw bytes* from *conclusions*: commands run in a child process, files are analysed in a sandbox, and long material is filed into a local knowledge base — while the conversation receives only conclusions, excerpts and counts. A routing gate refuses, before execution, the calls that would inevitably flood the transcript.

**No third-party runtime dependencies.** The knowledge base rides on Node's own `node:sqlite` (FTS5 included) and code execution uses interpreters already on the machine, so installing it pulls nothing else.

## What it is for

| Problem | What this does |
|---|---|
| A command prints thousands of lines; you only need a count | `ctk_execute` runs it in a child process and returns the answer |
| A large file needs statistics, not a full read | `ctk_execute_file` keeps its bytes in the sandbox |
| Many commands, one question | `ctk_batch_execute` answers in one call with per-command status |
| A page or spec is read once and never reused | `ctk_index` files it; `ctk_search` pulls excerpts on demand |
| `curl` / `wget` paste whole responses into the conversation | The routing gate refuses them and names the alternative |
| You cannot tell how much was saved | `ctk_stats` reports the ledger; the settings page shows a live occupancy panel |

## Tools

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `ctk_execute` | Run code in a sandboxed child process (javascript / esm / typescript / shell), return only the answer |
| `ctk_execute_file` | Run code over a file for statistics or extraction; the file text stays in the sandbox |
| `ctk_batch_execute` | Several commands in one call, per-command status, conclusions only |
| `ctk_index` | File text or a file into the local FTS5 knowledge base |
| `ctk_search` | Multi-query retrieval; excerpts are centred on the match |
| `ctk_retrieve` | Read back a slimmed output's stored original, byte-for-byte, from its `[ctk_retrieve id=…]` marker |
| `ctk_fetch_and_index` | Fetch pages → strip markup → file them |
| `ctk_purge` | Delete filed material (requires `confirm: true`) |
| `ctk_stats` | Savings ledger: refusals, sandbox bytes, filed bytes, call counts |
| `ctk_doctor` | Self-check: interpreters really start, scratch dir writable, knowledge round-trip |
| `ctk_context_report` | This conversation's context occupancy and composition |

## Install

From npm (recommended):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-context-toolkit
```

From GitHub:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:chimneyQ/dsh-context-toolkit
```

From a local checkout:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add D:\path\to\dsh-context-toolkit
```

Confirm `dsh-context-toolkit` appears in `dsh.profile.bundles` inside `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/desktop/package.json`.

Remove:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-context-toolkit
```

## Use it well

**Reach for `ctk_*` first** whenever the work is analysis, counting, filtering or summarising — reading that output into the conversation is the exact problem this bundle exists to solve.

```js
// How many .log files, and how big in total?
await ctk_execute({
  language: 'javascript',
  code: `
    const fs = require('fs');
    const dir = process.argv[2];
    let n = 0, bytes = 0;
    for (const f of fs.readdirSync(dir)) {
      if (!f.endsWith('.log')) continue;
      n++; bytes += fs.statSync(dir + '/' + f).size;
    }
    console.log(n + ' files, ' + bytes + ' bytes');
  `
});
```

File long material once, then pull sections:

```js
await ctk_index({ path: 'D:/specs/api.md' });          // the full text stays in the store
await ctk_search({ queries: ['rate limit', 'auth'] });  // only the relevant excerpts come back
```

## TLS on a proxy-intercepted network

If every `ctk_fetch_and_index` fails with `UNABLE_TO_VERIFY_LEAF_SIGNATURE`, the machine sits behind a
TLS-inspecting proxy and Node's built-in roots cannot verify what the proxy presents. `caPemPath`
names a PEM to trust instead.

`auto` (the default) points at `<DSH_HOME>/context-mode/ca/windows-roots.pem`. **This package does not
ship that file** — it is a snapshot of the *host's own* root store, so on a fresh machine it simply is
not there and fetching falls back to Node's default roots.

Settings → Context Toolkit shows a row under `caPemPath`:

- a badge saying whether the file exists (and its size), checked with a stat on page load — the bundle
  itself is never read just to render the page;
- a button that writes it from the system root store (`tls.getCACertificates('system')`, ~500
  certificates, ~820 KB) when pressed.

A bundle that already exists is never replaced on a single click: the first press asks, and only the
explicit confirmation overwrites it.

**What this does not do:** it exports the *system* store. If the proxy's root certificate was never
installed into that store — IT pushes it via group policy, for instance — the exported bundle still
will not verify the proxy. Install the root first, then export.

## Configuration

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `routing` | `true` | Master switch for the routing gate |
| `denyCurlWget` | `true` | Block curl / wget outright |
| `bashNudgeMinCommandBytes` | `4096` | Nudge threshold for long commands (0 disables) |
| `maxReadBytesBeforeAsk` | `51200` | Nudge threshold for whole-file reads (0 disables) |
| `nudgeFetchTools` | `true` | Nudge the host fetchers (`web_fetch` / `read_page`) too |
| `trustedReadBasenames` | `package.json` etc. | Filenames exempt from the read nudge |
| `compressNudgeTokens` | `120000` | Occupancy warning threshold (tokens) |
| `searchLimit` | `5` | Excerpts per query in `ctk_search` |
| `snippetChars` | `900` | Character ceiling per excerpt |
| `fetchMaxBytes` | `2000000` | Per-page fetch ceiling |
| `caPemPath` | `auto` | TLS trust store for `ctk_fetch_and_index`: `auto` = `<DSH_HOME>/context-mode/ca/windows-roots.pem`, an absolute PEM path, or empty for Node's default roots. Set it when a TLS-inspecting proxy makes every https fetch fail on the certificate. |
| `storageDir` | empty | Knowledge-base root; empty = `<DSH_HOME>/context-toolkit` |
| `tools.*` | see below | Per-tool switches |

Tool switches: `tools.execute`, `tools.executeFile`, `tools.batchExecute`, `tools.index`, `tools.search`, `tools.fetchAndIndex`, `tools.purge`, `tools.stats`, `tools.contextReport`, `tools.doctor` — all on by default.

## Verify

The offline suites need no DSH runtime:

```bash
node smoke.mjs        # 104 checks: contract, runtime discovery, tools, gate (segment matching, host-aligned path base, script_path and host-fetcher coverage), output slimming with reversible retrieval and retention, CA bundle presence/export, resource disposal, knowledge base, observability, version reporting
node test-client.mjs  # 27 checks: browser-half contract and bilingual dictionary parity
node test-package.mjs # 20 checks: publish manifest and the zero-dependency constraint
node release-check.mjs # 34 checks: release readiness (manifest, deps, tool count, gate matching, version, SHA coverage, no hardcoded paths)
```

## Output slimming (after a tool runs)

The gate works at the *door*; slimming handles what is **already inside**. They catch different traffic: the gate can only read a call's *arguments*, while slimming sees the *bytes that actually came back* — from a tool the gate does not know, an entry point it does not cover, or output that was never predictable from the call.

At `tools/post-execute`, the strategy follows the shape:

| Shape | Treatment |
|---|---|
| Uniform JSON array | **Lossless** tabular re-encoding: keys written once, no information dropped |
| Table | Header plus both ends kept; the middle stride-sampled **with original line numbers** (the model gets a map with coordinates) |
| grep / search | Folded by file, first hits per file kept |
| Log | Ordinary lines folded away, **diagnostics kept verbatim** |
| Long prose | Head/tail window with an explicit elision marker |
| Code / key-value | **Not compressed** (the model may b

plugins.description: Portable project memory for coding agents. Standalone runtime, observable records, code fingerprints, and Claude Code/Codex/DeepSeek Harness adapters.
plugins.readme_text:
# Remvu

[![Tests](https://github.com/caotaiyi/remvu/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/caotaiyi/remvu/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Standalone and DSH](https://github.com/caotaiyi/remvu/actions/workflows/standalone.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/caotaiyi/remvu/actions/workflows/standalone.yml)

Save before Claude Code hits its limit. Continue in Codex with the project background intact.

Remvu keeps goals, constraints, rejected approaches, unfinished work and check evidence alongside your project. The complete standalone engine bundles its runtime: **users do not install Python**. Opt-in observable recording, code fingerprints, concurrent updates, recovery and private sharing boundaries remain part of the engine.

[中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Install](docs/quickstart.md) · [DeepSeek Harness plugin](adapters/dsh/README.md) · [Evidence and limits](docs/standalone.md)

Fresh installations create no hooks. Recording is a separate choice; fingerprints, CAS protection and recovery stay available in manual mode. Resume reads a short preview; details are fetched only when needed.

## Try the complete app

> Install the complete Remvu standalone candidate from https://github.com/caotaiyi/remvu for my OS and architecture. Verify its checksum, extract the entire application folder, then run its install command for this project. Preserve existing settings and memory. Install save/resume without hooks. Enable recording only if I ask; explain any required client trust once. Do not install a system Python or substitute the notes-only fallback.

The v0.3.0-beta.3 application is a test candidate. CI produces platform archives; a production release and the full native-client support matrix remain gated on actual acceptance. See [the build and installation guide](docs/standalone.md) for available artifacts, verification and exact steps. Git is still required. macOS distribution signing/notarization is not configured.

| Everyday action | Claude Code | Codex |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Save a private handoff | `/remvu save` | `$remvu save` |
| Continue in a new session | `/remvu resume` | `$remvu resume` |

`save` asks the current agent to consolidate reviewed evidence and exports `.remvu/handoff/REMVU.md`. A direct program invocation without a proposal exports existing state and leaves pending evidence pending. It never uploads or commits. `resume` checks the saved code state before continuing. The receiver can also read the handoff alongside the code without installing Remvu.

Save while the original agent can still respond. Automatic logs retain observations; they cannot recover an exhausted agent's unwritten understanding. Stop hooks do not block completion or force another model turn.

## A handoff in 30 seconds

1. In Claude Code, ask `/remvu save`.
2. Open the project in Codex and ask `$remvu resume`.
3. Review the next step and any stale checks, pending evidence or conflicts, then continue.

This describes the workflow, not a measured completion-time guarantee. [Earlier real handoff trials](docs/validation-report.md) and the [10-task notes-only comparison](docs/product-validation.md) are published with their limits. The latter found no first-pass accuracy advantage over ordinary HANDOFF notes; it does not measure the new standalone app or prove token savings.

## DeepSeek Harness

The `dsh-remvu` bundle adds five native tools and observable event recording to DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2**. It uses the same standalone engine and `.remvu/` state. The JavaScript package needs no compilation or install-time build script. [Install the plugin](adapters/dsh/README.md).

The plugin was installed through the official `dsh plugin add` flow and loaded in a real isolated SDK profile without a model request. Model-driven handoff and GUI acceptance are separate pending checks. Local projects only; it does not claim cloud or remote-filesystem support.

## What stays in memory

Claims distinguish `user_confirmed`, `observed`, `inferred` and `unverified`. Rejected decisions and superseded history survive. Check results retain the code fingerprint they actually tested; later edits make those checks historical. Concurrent proposals cannot silently overwrite newer memory.

Private memory and detailed evidence stay in ignored `.remvu/`. Public `REMVU.md` is generated only on an explicit share request, with public inline evidence and patch review. Hidden reasoning, credentials and unrelated conversations are excluded. `doctor`, `repair`, upgrades, rollback and uninstall remain available when needed; uninstall retains private memory.

## For multi-model platforms and API relay services

“换模型、换客户端，把项目背景一起带走。” A platform that can observe local project changes and tool outcomes can embed the memory engine or build an adapter. Pure API forwarding has no complete view of the project and cannot promise full operation records. The DSH adapter is a concrete local-host integration; no generic relay integration or measured savings percentage is claimed.

## Other paths and contributors

A [notes-only fallback](skills/remvu/assets/markdown-skill.md) remains available for users who deliberately want file-tool save/resume without recording or structured validation. Source developers can still run the standard-library Python engine. Neither path replaces the complete standalone app.

[Open format](spec/README.md) · [Compatibility](docs/compatibility.md) · [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [License](LICENSE). Existing `remvu/1` documents and legacy evidence import remain supported.

plugins.description: Split reading from deciding: the root agent plans and owns every file mutation; subagents are structurally read-only and report findings as summaries.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-root-planner-preset

An agent preset for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) that **separates deciding from doing**.

The root agent's context holds the plan and the decisions; reading, editing and running commands go to subagents that report back summaries. Subagents are full workers — they have `write`, `edit` and a shell — and the one thing none of them may leave behind is **a process still running**.

> The root decides, the workers do the work, and nothing outlives the task.

**Requires DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` or newer.** The package declares it as `engines.dsh`, so the plugin manager refuses to install on an older runtime. The floor is not cosmetic: 0.2.1 introduced `agentPreset` on the delegation tool and removed `toolFilter`. On 0.2.0 this preset still composes, and then quietly runs every child on the platform's default preset — wrong persona, twice the tools — which is worse than not installing it at all.

[中文说明](README.zh.md) | [Install](INSTALL.md) | [Maintainer notes](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)

## The problem it solves

On a long task a coding agent's context fills up with raw file contents and command output, and it forgets the goal, loses the plan, and starts repeating work. The usual answer — "delegate more to subagents" — fails in two opposite directions: a delegate with no hands cannot do anything, so every step bounces back; and a fleet of delegates with no bounds will edit whatever they like and leave servers running.

This preset takes the middle line: **workers with tools, bounded by their task.**

| Requirement | Mechanism | Strength |
|---|---|---|
| A subagent can read, **edit files and run commands** | The `root-planner-worker` preset mounts `tool-fs`, `tool-pwsh`, `tool-web` and the delegation rows; every delegation spawns into that preset by name | Grant by construction — a worker without tools is not a worker |
| A subagent cannot leave a process running | `enableRunInBackground: false` on the preset's `pwsh` row: the call is refused **and** `run_in_background` is removed from the tool schema | **Structural** — no model at any depth can reach for a detached process |
| Nobody runs an unbounded service | Persona rules for the root and for subagents | Prompt-level, covering what a schema cannot (`ops_bash` has no job registry) |
| A subagent stays inside its own workspace | Persona rules: write only under `_agents/<label>/`, the parent's files read-only to it, outside changes sent as a request | Prompt-level, **verified** by the parent (see below) |
| Delegation depth is the user's setting | The runtime depth cap (`subagent.maxDepth`) | **Structural**: past the cap it throws `SubagentDepthError` |
| Live children are capped as well | `subagent.maxActiveSubagents` | **Structural**: past the cap a delegation fails with `subagent limit reached`, and it does not queue |
| The root decides; workers execute | Persona rules | Prompt-level |

The worker's toolset is an **allow list by construction**: a tool exists for a worker only if the worker preset mounts the plugin that provides it. A tool added by a future plugin — or by the app — is invisible to workers until a row is added here.

One caveat, measured rather than assumed: a small number of tools are registered **globally** by the Host and cannot be removed by any preset. On 0.2.1-rc.2 those were `ops_glob`, `ops_grep`, `ops_inspect_local_file`, `ops_replace` (from the `dsh-ops` plugin) and `working_directory`. A worker sees them whatever this package does; the curated set below is what the rows add on top.

### One workspace per worker

Concurrency is handled by separation rather than by coordination. Before delegating,
the root creates `_agents/<label>/` and puts that absolute path in the task; the child
writes **only** there, reads the parent's files freely, and sends a change request
instead of editing anything outside. On completion the child reports its artifacts and
the root decides which to copy in — merging into an existing file where that is what the
change means, keeping them separate where it is not. `_agents/` stays (and belongs in
`.gitignore`) so the same agent can be continued later.

**The boundary is enforced, not just agreed.** This preset's package also ships the fence
as a profile-level entry (`dsh-root-planner-preset/guard`), so one install carries the
protocol and its enforcement together. It refuses a `write`, `edit` or `ops_replace` whose
target resolves outside `<workspace>/_agents/`, and refuses a shell call whose `workdir` is
outside it or whose command names an absolute path into your files:

```
write: outside your workspace. You may write only inside "...\_agents"; everything else
in the parent's directory is read-only to you. Send your parent a change request instead
of writing "...\report.md" directly.
```

The root session is never fenced: it owns the workspace and has to be able to write
anywhere in it to integrate a child's artifacts.

**Being profile-level, it fences every delegated agent in this profile** — including
subagents under a different preset, which were never told about `_agents/`. If that matters
on your machine, turn the entry off in your profile patch:

```yaml
- id: root-planner-guard
  disabled: true
```

Declaring the guard as a row *inside* the preset would scope it to this preset only, and
that was tried first: measured against a live session it registered nothing — six probe
steps all came back allowed while the composed config looked correct. `verify-patch.mjs`
now fails if anyone declares it as a preset row again.

One limitation survives, and it is worth knowing before you rely on this: a shell command
can build a path at runtime (`$env:X` + `'..'`, a script that writes, a Here-String), and
no argument scan can see it. The command scan matches **drive-letter** paths, so on POSIX
it detects nothing at all — the two CI cases for it are skipped there rather than pretending
otherwise. Confining a child's shell properly would need a narrower
sandbox write root, which DSH cannot give a child — `sandboxPolicy.resolve()` accepts only
`{ session, mode }` and derives `workspaceRoot` from the immutable, inherited
`session.header.cwd`. So keep the parent's check as the backstop:

```sh
# before delegating
touch _agents/.mark-<label>
# after the child reports
find . -path ./_agents -prune -o -type f -newer _agents/.mark-<label> -print
```

No output means the child touched nothing outside its own directory; any output is a
file to inspect. The command needs no git repository — which matters, because the
workspace this was developed against is not one.

### Two limits you will meet on a broad task

Both are Host settings, both are structural, and both are documented because they read
like defects the first time:

- **`subagent limit reached (active child limit: N)`** — a delegated child is
  *resident*, not merely running: a slot returns only after its turn ends, its inbox
  is empty, and its own children are disposed. A wide fan-out therefore holds every
  slot until that work actually finishes, and the batch does not queue behind the
  cap. Raise `maxActiveSubagents` (**Settings → Subagents**) if the machine can
  carry more live agents, or dispatch a batch you can finish and collect it before
  opening the next. The author's own profile carries 16 for this reason.
- **`subagent depth N exceeds maxDepth M`** — a delegation from a leaf. That is the
  cap working, not a failure; the child reads the material itself.

## How it works

```
root agent  ──delegates──▶  subagent  ──delegates──▶  … until maxDepth
   │                            │
   └── decides, integrates, and states what each worker may touch
```

Two mechanisms decide what a worker gets and how far the tree goes, and they pull in the
same direction:

- **The worker preset** gives *every* subagent, at *every* level, the same working set —
  read, write, shell — and withholds the same things, because each level spawns into the
  same preset. The grant does not weaken with depth, and neither does the bound.
- **The depth cap** (`subagent.maxDepth`, a Host setting you control) decides how
  many levels exist. `2` means root →

plugins.description: 把 DeepSeek 网页版聊天装进 DSH 桌面版面板：侧栏入口 + 工具栏 + 本地登录快照。 | Embed the DeepSeek web chat in a DSH Desktop main panel.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-dschat

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-dschat.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-dschat)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-dschat.svg)](https://github.com/Jakcet/dsh-dschat/blob/main/LICENSE)

把 DeepSeek 网页版聊天（[chat.deepseek.com](https://chat.deepseek.com/)）装进 **DSH 桌面版**的面板里。

侧栏会多一个「DeepSeek 网页版」图标，点开就是一个主面板，里面用 Electron `<webview>` 原样载入网页版，工具栏可以后退、前进、刷新、回首页、在系统浏览器打开。登录在 DeepSeek 自己的页面上完成，插件不接触你的密码。

> 这个面板需要 `globalThis.dshDesktop.browser`，它只由 DSH 桌面版的 preload 暴露；Web 版只会显示一行提示。

## 功能

- **侧栏入口 + 主面板**：keyed panel，图标是蓝色鲸鱼气泡。
- **工具栏**：后退、前进、刷新、回 DeepSeek 首页、当前地址、在系统浏览器中打开。
- **原样加载** `https://chat.deepseek.com/`，不改页面、不注入脚本（只在你登录后读一次 `localStorage` 做快照）。
- **登录快照**：DSH 侧栏浏览器的 partition 是进程内内存分区，应用重启就丢 cookie。登录后插件把页面 `localStorage` 里登录相关的键备份到 `~/.dsh/dsh-dschat/storage.json`（权限 `0600`），下次载入时先回填、再刷新页面。
  能不能因此完全跳过登录页，取决于网页版把会话放在哪里：`httpOnly` cookie 不在快照范围内。

## 安装

在 DSH 插件市场里搜索 `dsh-dschat` 安装，或手动作为 bundle 装进你的 DSH profile：

```sh
npm install dsh-dschat
```

## 要求

- **DSH 桌面版**（依赖 preload 暴露的 `globalThis.dshDesktop.browser`）。
- DSH `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`。

## 它是怎么工作的

1. 主面板挂载时，client 半部向 DSH 桌面版的 preload 桥申请一个 guest：`globalThis.dshDesktop.browser.acquire(workspace)`。
2. 拿到 `{ lease, partition }` 后创建 `<webview>`，`name` 填 lease、`partition` 填 partition、`src` 填 `about:blank#<lease>`；DSH 主进程会在 `will-attach-webview` 里校验 lease 和 partition，通过后才真正挂载。
3. pages 加载完成（`dom-ready`）后 `loadURL('https://chat.deepseek.com/')`。
4. 登录态变化后，把 `localStorage` 里键名匹配 `token/user/auth/session/login` 的字符串值 POST 给插件的 host 路由，写到本地快照文件；下次打开时先回填再刷新。
5. 面板卸载时 `bridge.release(lease)` 释放 guest。

因为走的是和内置侧栏浏览器同一套 lease 校验、sandbox 与导航策略，插件本身拿不到 Electron/Node 权限。

## 已知限制（来自 DSH 宿主策略，插件绕不过去）

- guest 内发起的**下载会被取消**。
- 通知、麦克风、剪贴板等**权限请求一律拒绝**。
- 窗口打开请求会转成同面板内导航。
- 浏览器 partition 每次启动重建，用公开 API 做不到「完全零登录」重启。
- 只有桌面版可用，Web 版不工作。

## 隐私

插件不代理、不抓取、不转发任何内容，只渲染官方页面并保留一份本地快照。快照里可能有登录相关数据的明文，请当作 cookie 文件对待，不要分享；删掉 `~/.dsh/dsh-dschat/storage.json` 即可清除快照。

## 文件

- `index.js` — host 半部：快照与日志的 HTTP 路由，以及一次性的客户端模块清单缓存刷新。
- `client.js` — client 半部：侧栏图标、主面板、webview 生命周期、工具栏。
- `cordis.patch.yml` — bundle patch。
- `icon.svg` — 插件图标。

## License

MIT

---

# English

Embed the DeepSeek web chat (`chat.deepseek.com`) in a **DSH Desktop** main panel.

A sidebar entry opens a keyed main panel that hosts the real DeepSeek web app inside an
Electron `<webview>` guest, requested from the DSH desktop preload bridge
(`globalThis.dshDesktop.browser.acquire`) so it goes through the same main-process lease
check, sandbox flags and navigation policy as the built-in sidebar browser.

## What it does

- Adds a **DeepSeek Web** entry to the sidebar icon list and a main panel.
- Toolbar: back, forward, reload, home, current URL, open in system browser.
- Loads `https://chat.deepseek.com/` unmodified. Sign-in happens on DeepSeek's own page;
  the plugin never sees or stores your password.
- **Login snapshot.** DSH's sidebar-browser partition is a process-local in-memory
  partition, so cookies are gone after an app restart. After you sign in, the plugin copies
  login-related `localStorage` keys to `~/.dsh/dsh-dschat/storage.json` (mode `0600`) and
  restores them on the next load before reloading the page. Whether that is enough to skip
  the sign-in screen depends on where DeepSeek keeps the session: `httpOnly` cookies are
  not part of the snapshot.

## Install

Install it from the DSH plugin market (search for `dsh-dschat`), or add this package as a
bundle to your DSH profile:

```sh
npm install dsh-dschat
```

## Requirements

- **DSH Desktop.** The panel needs `globalThis.dshDesktop.browser`, which only the desktop
  preload exposes. In the web build the panel shows a notice and does nothing.
- DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.2`.

## Known limits (enforced by the DSH host, not by this plugin)

- Downloads started inside the guest are cancelled.
- Permission requests (notifications, microphone, clipboard) are denied.
- Window-open requests are turned into navigation in the same panel.
- The browser partition is recreated on every app start, so a fully zero-login restart is
  not possible with the public host API.

## Privacy

The plugin does not proxy, scrape or forward anything. It renders the official page and
keeps one local snapshot file. That file can contain login-related values in plain text;
treat it like a cookie jar and do not share it. Delete it to forget the snapshot.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: AI 错题本：把扫描试卷整理成以知识点为索引的错题合集（dsh-plugin）
plugins.readme_text:
# AI 错题本 · DSH 插件

把**扫描试卷**变成一本**以知识点为索引的错题本**：投喂 PDF/图片 → 插件建批次并光栅化 → 模型在会话里读卷面、提取错题 → 生成卡片草稿 → **你确认后**归档进 `library/`，并自动重建索引。

不是"AI 帮你解题"，而是"AI 帮你把卷面上**已经存在**的东西整理成可复习的结构"。

## 功能

- **扫描件直读**：PDF 自动光栅化（默认 400 dpi），切成整页概览 + 高清横带；看不清时按需索取原生分辨率重切
- **只在错题上花力气**：按你报的题号逐题提取，题干、作答、划改、页边演算、卷面标注、知识点、错因、难度
- **绝不编造**：读不准的内容写进"待人工确认"，交给人核对
- **卡片即 Markdown**：`library/<学科>/<卷子>/cards/*.md`，带 front-matter，可手改、可 diff、可进版本库
- **知识点索引**：自动重建 `index.md` / `index.json`，按 学科 → 一级 → 二级知识点 归类
- **导出打印版 PDF**：板块（含自定义板块）可勾选、可排序；**公式以 Word 原生公式（OMML）排版**，不是 Unicode 拼凑
- **回收站**：删除先进 `_trash/`，可逐项还原，清空才真正销毁
- **会话可追溯**：待归档页可跳回分析会话继续修改
- **Prompt 配置**：设置页按模型实际接收顺序单列展示分析任务书、背景、错因分类和 PDF 导出模板；PDF 模板支持新增自定义板块，模型按板块说明为每道错题产出内容

> 更新记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

## 界面

| 已归档 · 浏览（按知识点索引） | 已归档 · 管理（导出 / 删除 / 回收站） |
|---|---|
| ![已归档浏览](docs/screenshots/01-library-browse.png) | ![已归档管理](docs/screenshots/02-library-manage.png) |

| 设置 · Prompt 配置与 PDF 模板 | 待归档（空状态） |
|---|---|
| ![设置页 Prompt 配置](docs/screenshots/03-settings-prompt-config.webp) | ![待归档](docs/screenshots/04-pending-empty.png) |

- 「已归档 · 浏览」左栏是学科 → 一级知识点 → 二级知识点的索引树，右栏是卡片列表；点卡片可对照原卷裁剪图查看转录。
- 「已归档 · 管理」里导出 PDF、管理导出文件、删除卡片（进回收站）与还原。
- 「设置」里左侧是可收起的 Prompt 配置；PDF 模板是统一列表（预设板块 + 自定义板块），可拖动顺序、勾选包含、编辑说明，列表下方可新增自定义板块。

## 环境要求

- **DSH（DeepSeek Harness）桌面版**，Web/桌面 profile 均可。要求 DSH `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`
- 分析模型需要**支持图片输入**（插件启动前会校验，不支持会直接报错而不是静默失败）
- Node.js ≥ 22（DSH 自带运行时已满足）

## 安装

> 目前只通过 GitHub 分发（npm 包尚未发布）。

### 方式一：从 GitHub 安装（推荐）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:suanmingxing/dsh-ai-mistake-book
```

> 把 `desktop` 换成你实际使用的 profile（桌面版通常是 `desktop`，`dsh web` 用 `web`）。
> 装完**重启 DeepSeek Harness** 生效。

### 方式二：本地目录（开发/调试）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/suanmingxing/dsh-ai-mistake-book.git D:\tools\dsh-ai-mistake-book
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:D:/tools/dsh-ai-mistake-book"
```

> `link:` 安装时 pnpm 不会替插件装 `dependencies`，所以本仓库**已把必要依赖放在 `node_modules/` 里一并提交**（见 [VENDOR.md](VENDOR.md)）。若你删掉了它，请手动补装：`npm i @deepseek-ai/schemastery @deepseek-ai/cosmokit katex`。

## 首次使用

1. **设置归档根**：设置 → 插件 → AI 错题本 → `archiveRoot`，填一个你希望存放错题本的绝对路径（默认 `~/.dsh/ai-mistake-book`）。改这个字段需要重启插件。
2. **建一个"归档工作区"会话**：在 DSH 里打开该目录作为工作区（首次 `/mistake` 会自动创建）。
3. **投喂试卷**：
   ```
   /mistake 错题为 3、5、6、8、9、11 题  @"C:\path\to\扫描卷.pdf"
   ```
   或在插件页用模型工具 `mistake_ingest` 指定文件路径。
4. **等分析**：分析在当前会话里进行；期间该会话的工具会被临时收窄到 4 个（读页面、提交候选、提交决定、问用户确认），结束后自动恢复。
5. **确认归档**：插件页 →「待归档」核对候选 → 确认归档；之后到「已归档 → 管理」导出 PDF 或删除。正式归档需在插件页确认。
6. **定制版式与提词**（可选）：到「设置 → AI 错题本」的 Prompt 配置里改分析任务书、背景、错因分类；在 ⑤ PDF 导出模板里调整板块顺序、勾选或新增自定义板块。改完点「保存全部修改」，分析新试卷时生效。

## 数据与隐私

- **所有数据都在你自己的机器上**：试卷、转录、卡片、导出件都在 `archiveRoot` 下，插件不向任何第三方服务上传内容
- 模型调用走你 DSH 里配置的 provider（同样的调用链路，不会额外外发）
- 归档根结构：

```
<archiveRoot>/
├─ inbox/<batchId>/     进行中的批次（原始扫描、光栅图）
├─ library/<学科>/<卷子>/cards/*.md   归档后的错题卡片
├─ templates/           可编辑的提示词（analysis / background / error-taxonomy / custom-templates.json）
├─ exports/             导出的 PDF
├─ export-settings.json PDF 导出模板（板块顺序/勾选/预设说明/原卷图）
├─ _trash/              回收站
└─ index.md / index.json  自动生成的索引
```

## 主要设置项

| 设置 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `archiveRoot` | `~/.dsh/ai-mistake-book` | 错题本存放位置 |
| `pdfDpi` / `overviewDpi` | 400 / 200 | 横带与整页概览的分辨率 |
| `pagesPerRequest` | 2 | 一次投喂几页（每页 1 概览 + N 横带） |
| `maxRecutsPerPage` | 4 | 每页原生重切配额 |
| `restrictAnalysisTools` | true | 分析期间收窄会话工具集 |
| `analysisProvider` / `analysisModel` | 空 | 空 = 用部署默认；必须支持图片 |
| `deleteToTrash` | true | 删除进回收站而非销毁 |

## 设置页：设置选项与 Prompt 配置

设置页只有两块：

- **设置选项**（置顶，只读）：当前生效的模型、光栅化、导出与存储参数；真正的修改入口在 DSH 的「设置 → 插件 → AI 错题本」。
- **Prompt 配置**（单列，按模型实际接收顺序，所有板块都可收起/展开）：

  1. **分析任务书**（`templates/analysis.md`）——主体；`{{background}}` / `{{taxonomy}}` / `{{custom}}` 是插入点
  2. **难度与学段背景**（`templates/background.md`）——替换进分析任务书「三、难度标定背景」
  3. **错因分类**（`templates/error-taxonomy.md`）——替换进「四、错因分类」
  4. **系统自动追加**（只读折叠）——每批次固定追加的工具调用速记，不可编辑
  5. **PDF 导出模板**——**统一列表**：六个预设板块 + 你自己的自定义板块（`tpl:<id>`）混排，全部可勾选、↑↓ 排序；列表最下方可「新增模板」。
     - 每条板块（预设和自定义）都有自己的「说明」；预设板块点行内「编辑说明」可改（标题固定，说明可改），自定义板块可改标题+说明。**说明会写进分析提示词**，模型据此为每道错题产出板块内容；卡片里生成 `## 板块标题` 段落，导出 PDF 时按模板顺序显示。
     - 删除/停用自定义板块后，导出会跳过它；停用的板块不会被当成"未登记标题"重新塞回 PDF 末尾。
  6. 旧版本的 `templates/custom.json` 会在首次加载时自动并入分析任务书、原文件改名为 `custom.json.migrated`；新的自定义板块存在 `templates/custom-templates.json`（`{id,title,description,enabled}`，顺序和预设说明记在 `export-settings.json` 的 `order` / `descriptions` 里）。

不会自动保存：改完点「保存全部修改」；每块的「恢复默认」只改草稿，仍需保存。PDF 导出时「管理」页还可以对这一次导出做临时覆盖。

## 依赖说明

本插件在 `node_modules/` 里**随包提交**了三份依赖（合计约 0.7 MB）：`@deepseek-ai/schemastery`、`@deepseek-ai/cosmokit`（DSH 发布版，公开 npm 同版本）、`katex`。原因与升级方式见 [VENDOR.md](VENDOR.md)。

`katex` 仅用于会话内的公式预览（MathML），缺失时会降级为纯文本，不影响归档。

## 已知限制

- 公式排版覆盖错题卡常见写法（分数、根式、上下标、向量、`\left…\right`、希腊字母与常用运算符）；矩阵、分段函数等结构暂不支持，会退化为可读文本
- 分析依赖模型的视觉能力；看不清的字段会进入"待人工确认"，不会猜测
- 界面文案提供中/英两份字典，提示词模板本身默认中文

## 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 suanmingxing

plugins.description: 跨 agent / 跨文件夹的工作记忆 CLI。一条命令还原"上次做到哪"， 一条命令留下路标。存储是人可读的 Markdown，零依赖， 支持 Claude Code / VS Code Copilot / DSH / 任何认 AGENTS.md 的 agent。
plugins.readme_text:
# Cairn

> **cairn** /kern/ · n. 登山者在岔路上垒起的一堆石头，给后来的人指路。
> 它不修路，只在关键处留一个记号：**这边走过，那边是死路。**

跨 agent、跨文件夹的工作记忆。
**一条命令还原现场，一条命令留下路标。**

纯 Python 标准库 · 零依赖 · 存储是人可读的 Markdown · 不在你的项目里留任何文件

---

## 你遇到的问题不是「没有记忆」

是**记忆锁在某个 agent 的某个会话里**：

| 症状 | 代价 |
|---|---|
| 换个 agent（Claude Code ↔ Copilot ↔ Codex ↔ DSH） | 背景重讲一遍 |
| 换个文件夹 | 上下文归零 |
| 隔三天回来 | 忘了做到哪，也忘了上次**为什么**否掉某个方案 |
| 同一个坑 | 踩第二次、第三次 |
| 上下文越聊越糊 | agent 开始编数字，而你没法核对 |

cairn 把「上次做到哪」从会话里捞出来，变成一份**谁都能读的全局文件**。

## 30 秒看懂

```bash
cairn init     # 在项目里跑一次，登记
cairn boot     # 以后每次开工：还原现场
cairn wrap     # 每次收工：留下路标
```

`cairn boot` 打出来的是这样（真实格式，内容为示例）：

```
============================================================
 cairn · 开工上下文         项目 支付网关（pay-gw）
 你是被交接的 agent。读完下面内容，先复述再动手。
 不要改文件，不要开始干活 —— 复述完停下等用户确认。
============================================================
 项目路径：D:\work\pay-gw

--- NOW.md（当前状态，最重要）------------------------------
**最后更新**：2026-03-14

## 在干嘛
把 refund 的幂等键从 `order_id` 换成 `order_id + attempt`。
线上有个重复退款的 case，复现脚本已经写出来了。

## 下一步
打开 `src/refund/handler.py:88`，那里 `_idem_key()` 还是旧的拼法。

## 不要碰
`db/migrations/` —— 下周要合并另一个分支的迁移，现在动会冲突。

--- LOG.md（最近 5 条）-------------------------------------
 - 16:20 | 复现了重复退款 | `pytest tests/test_refund.py -k idem` 稳定红 | 确认不是偶发
 - 15:02 | 排除了并发窗口 | 加了 `asyncio.sleep(0.5)` 仍然重复 | 不是竞态

--- DECISIONS.md -------------------------------------------
 | 2026-03-11 | 幂等键不用 Redis 去重 | 少一个外部依赖，且要能离线重放 | Redis SETNX 方案 |

--- GOTCHAS.md ---------------------------------------------
 - **本地跑迁移会把 dev 库清空**
   → 原因：`make migrate` 里写死了 `DROP SCHEMA`
   → 对策：用 `make migrate-safe`
============================================================
 复述这 4 句，然后停下：
   ① 这个项目在做什么？  ② 上次做到哪？
   ③ 下一步是什么？      ④ 哪些坑不能踩？
============================================================
```

**这就是「上次做到哪」。** 不用谁再讲一遍。

## 安装

需要 **Python 3.8+**（只用标准库，不需要 `pip install` 任何东西）。

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/oranchenjie/cairn.git $env:USERPROFILE\.cairn\src
cd $env:USERPROFILE\.cairn\src
.\install.ps1
```

装完**新开一个终端**（PATH 生效），然后：

```bash
cd <你的项目>
cairn init          # 登记（项目里已有 _ai/ 的话会自动迁移）
cairn boot          # 看看它能不能说出「上次做到哪」
```

可选参数：

```powershell
.\install.ps1 -SkipPath                    # 不动 PATH
.\install.ps1 -Python "C:\...\python.exe"  # 指定 Python
.\install.ps1 -DshHome "\\wsl$\...\.dsh"   # DSH 跑在 WSL 里时看这里
.\install.ps1 -SkipVSCode -SkipClaude -SkipDsh   # 只装 CLI
```

> **不碰系统 PATH、不碰注册表、不装任何包。**
> 出问题了就把 `~/.cairn` 和 `~/.vscode/extensions/oranchenjie.cairn-*` 删掉。

## 存储长什么样

```
~/.cairn/
  index.json                 项目索引：路径 → slug
  projects/<slug>/
      NOW.md          ← 当前状态。每次收工**整体重写**，≤60 行
      LOG.md          ← 工作日志。只追加，最新在上
      DECISIONS.md    ← 决策 + **否决了什么**
      GOTCHAS.md      ← 踩过的坑：症状 → 原因 → 对策
      STATE.md        ← 环境 / 路径 / 命令 / **实测数字**
```

**为什么拆成 5 个？** 因为 `NOW` 要短（每次重写）、`LOG` 要长（只追加），
混在一个文件里两边都做不好。

**为什么是 Markdown？** 你能用眼睛看、能 `git diff`、能 grep、坏了能手动改一行。
它不是黑盒 —— 这一条直接排除掉了数据库和向量库。

**项目根里一个文件都不留。** 项目识别靠 `index.json` 里登记的路径，
从当前目录往上比对。所以你在任何子目录里跑 `cairn` 都能认出来，
而**不会**在你的仓库里凭空多出一个未跟踪文件。

> 早期版本会在项目根写一个标记文件。它能工作，但代价很实在 ——
> 那是个裸的未跟踪文件，会一直挂在 `git status` 里。现在标记**只读不写**：
> 老项目不用重新登记，`init` 会顺手清掉遗留的，`doctor` 会把残留的报出来。
>
> 代价说清楚：新登记的项目不再有标记，所以**把项目文件夹改名或搬走之后认不出来了** ——
> 到新位置重新 `cairn init` 一次即可。

## 命令

| 命令 | 干什么 |
|---|---|
| **`cairn boot`** | ★ 会话开头：打印开工上下文（**有硬上限**，不会撑爆 context） |
| **`cairn wrap`** | ★ 会话结尾：打印收工清单 + 当前规模 |
| `cairn init [dir]` | 登记项目，自动迁移已有的 `_ai/` |
| `cairn now` / `--set -` | 读 / **整体重写** `NOW.md` |
| `cairn log "..."` | 追加日志（**没证据会警告，纯空话直接拒写**） |
| `cairn decide "..." --why "..." --rejected "..."` | 记决策 |
| `cairn gotcha "症状" --cause "..." --fix "..."` | 记坑 |
| `cairn state` / `--set -` | 环境 / 路径 / 命令 / 实测数字 |
| `cairn find <kw> [--all]` | 全文搜索（`--all` 跨所有项目） |
| `cairn doctor` | 体检：超长的 NOW、没证据的日志、没写否决项的决策 |
| `cairn status` | 所有项目一览 |
| `cairn forget <slug> [--purge]` | 注销（默认留记忆，`--purge` 连记忆一起删） |
| `cairn prompt --agent <X>` | 生成喂给某个 agent 的接入提示词 |

`now` 和 `state` 都支持 `--set -` 从 stdin 读，长内容一律走它。

## 它怎么保证「记了有用」

大多数「记忆」工具死于同一个原因：**记了一堆三个月后没人看得懂的东西。**
cairn 在三个地方设了闸。

**① 没证据的不让写。** `cairn log` 会检查内容里有没有数字 / 文件名 / 路径 ——
纯空话（「优化了一下」）**直接拒写并以退出码 2 结束**：

```
$ cairn log "优化了一下"
[x] 这条又没证据又是空话（如「优化了一下」），不写。
  改成：干了什么 | 命令/文件名/数字 | 影响
  确认要写就加 --force。
```

**② 「否决了什么」才是决策的重点。** `DECISIONS.md` 的意义不是记你选了什么，
而是记你**没选什么、为什么** —— 否则三天后（包括你自己）会把已经否掉的方案再提一遍。
没写 `--rejected` 会收到提醒。

**③ 记忆不能自己变成负担。** `boot` 的输出有硬上限（NOW 70 行、LOG 5 条、
GOTCHAS 12 行、STATE 45 行）。**上下文本身是稀缺资源**，
一个把所有日志塞进 prompt 的「记忆工具」是在帮倒忙。

## 各 agent 怎么接

一份实现（`core/cairn.py`），N 个壳。**所有适配器都只做转发** ——
所以不会出现「插件说的和 CLI 说的不一致」。

| Agent | 机制 | 自动吗 |
|---|---|---|
| **Claude Code** | 插件：`SessionStart` hook **自动注入** `cairn boot` + 3 个斜杠命令 + 1 个技能 | ✅ 装了就行 |
| **VS Code Copilot** | 扩展注册 7 个 `languageModelTools` + 8 个命令 | ✅ 装了就行 |
| **DSH**（DeepSeek Harness） | skill（按需加载）+ `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md`（**自动注入**） | ✅ 装 skill 就行；全自动要贴一次片段 |
| **Codex / Zed / Windsurf / Amp / Jules / Junie / Devin / Kilo** | 都认 `AGENTS.md` | ✅ 把 `adapters/generic/AGENTS.snippet.md` 贴进去 |
| **Cursor** | `.cursor/rules/*.mdc` | ⚠️ 要建文件 |
| **Cline** | `.clinerules/` | ⚠️ 要建文件 |
| **Aider / Gemini CLI** | 默认不读 | ❌ 要改配置 |

细节见 `adapters/<名字>/README.md`。

## 为什么不做成 MCP，也不做成数据库

这两条路都认真考虑过，都否掉了。

**MCP server** —— 每个 agent 要**单独装、单独配**。你换工具就得重配一遍，
反而更浪费时间。而「有终端」是**所有** agent 的公共能力，CLI 一个命令谁都能调。

**数据库 / 向量库** —— 你不能用眼睛看、不能 `git diff`、不能手动改一行、不能 grep。
出问题时是黑盒，调试成本远大于收益。而且「记忆」这件事，
**可核对性比检索能力重要得多**。

所以：存储是 Markdown，接口是命令行。

## 设计取舍（以及否决了什么）

| 决策 | 为什么 | 否决了什么 |
|---|---|---|
| 存储用**全局目录**，不用 repo 内的 `_ai/` | 你要的就是「跨文件夹」 | 每个 repo 一份 `_ai/` |
| 项目识别用 **index.json 路径匹配** | 往用户仓库里塞文件不可接受 —— 它会在 `git status` 里裸奔 | 项目根的标记文件（降为只读兼容） |
| 拆成 **5 个文件** | `NOW` 要短、`LOG` 要长，混一起两边都做不好 | 一个 `NOTES.md` |
| 认不出项目就**报错**，绝不回退 | 在 `C:\` 里跑能面无表情地吐出另一个项目的内容 —— 比报错可怕得多 | 「只有唯一项目就用它」的回退 |
| 日志**拒写**空话 | 没证据的日志三个月后等于没写 | 什么都让写 |
| `boot` 输出**有硬上限** | 记忆不能自己变成负担 | 把整个 LOG 塞进去 |
| VS Code 扩展用**纯 JS** | 装机成本 = 拷文件夹，没有 npm/tsc/vsce 三层失败点 | TypeScript + 打包 |
| 适配器**不自己实现逻辑** | 一份实现，不会出现说法不一致 | 在 TypeScript 里重写一遍 |
| slug **必须校验** | `forget "../../x" --purge` 曾能删掉 `projects/` 之外的任意目录。这工具是给 agent 用的，提示词注入足以触发 | 信任传入的项目名 |

## 目录

```
~/.cairn/
    src/                            ← 源码（本仓库的全部内容）
        core/cairn.py                   唯一的核心实现（纯标准库）
        install.ps1                     部署：CLI→bin、扩展→VS Code、插件→Claude Code、skill→DSH
        make-vsix.ps1                   打包 .vsix
        selftest-vscode.js              无头验证扩展的项目识别（不用启动 VS Code）
        adapters/
            vscode/                     纯 JS 扩展，无构建
            claude-code/                Claude Code 插件
            dsh/                        DSH 适配
            generic/AGENTS.snippet.md   给所有认 AGENTS.md 的 agent
        README.md                       本文件
    bin/                            ← 部署出来的 CLI（别手改，会被 src 覆盖）
    claude-plugin/                  ← 部署出来的 Claude Code 插件
    projects/<slug>/                ← ★ 你的记忆数据（这里才是活数据）
```

> **⚠️ 不要在这个仓的上级目录（`~/.cairn/`）里 `git init`。**
> 那会把 `projects/` 里你的私人工作记忆一起提交上去。
> **仓库根是 `src/`。** `.gitignore` 里也列了这些名字作为兜底，但别依赖它。

**为什么源码不住在项目目录里。** 源码曾经放在某个项目的 `agent-memory/` 下，
那是个坑：你把那个项目删了/移了，**工具本身就跟着没了**。
工具是**跳项目**的，它的家也应该是**跳项目**的。

## 开发

改了 `core/cairn.py` 之后：

```powershell
cd $env:USERPROFILE\.cairn\src
.\make-vsix.ps1     # 先打包（它会自动把 core 同步到 adapters/vscode/vendor/）
.\install.ps1       # 再部署
```

**改了扩展代码必须先 `make-vsix.ps1`。** `install.ps1` 只安装现成的 `.vsix`，
不会重新打包 —— 忘了这一步的后果是 CLI 更新了、扩展还是旧的。

**`.ps1` 文件必须带 UTF-8 BOM。** PowerShell 5.1 在无 BOM 时按 ANSI(GBK) 读，
中文会乱，严重时连解析都过不去。检查前三个字节是不是 `EF BB BF`。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件：在 ctx.web seam 上注册网页搜索和网页抓取两个 provider，后端使用 DeepSeek 原生的 Search / Fetch JSON API。  它接入 harness，而不是自带模型工具：模型侧 web_search / web_fetch 的 schema、provider 选择与结果渲染仍由 dsh-tool-web 负责；本包只提供两个后端。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-deepseek-search

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.1--rc.2-blue)](package.json)
[![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D24-brightgreen)](package.json)
[![English](https://img.shields.io/badge/lang-English-blue)](README.en.md)

**简体中文** ｜ [English](README.en.md)

一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 插件：在 `ctx.web` seam 上注册**网页搜索**和**网页抓取**两个 provider，后端使用 DeepSeek 原生的 Search / Fetch JSON API。

它接入 harness，而不是自带模型工具：模型侧 `web_search` / `web_fetch` 的 schema、provider 选择与结果渲染仍由 `dsh-tool-web` 负责；本包只提供两个后端。

## 功能

- **搜索 provider** — 调用 `POST /v1/tools/search`，映射为 `WebSearchResult` 的 sources（`url`、`title`、`snippet`、`publishedAt`）。
- **抓取 provider** — 调用 `POST /v1/tools/fetch`，返回 `text` 类型的正文，内容为服务方抽取出的 Markdown。
- **同一个 id 覆盖两类能力** — 都注册为 `deepseek-search`；自带的 bundle patch 把 `searchProvider` 和 `fetchProvider` 都指向它。
- **凭据处理** — 依次读取显式配置、`DEEPSEEK_SEARCH_API_KEY`、`DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`；不读磁盘、不写日志。
- **重试** — 对 `408`、`429`、`500`、`502`、`503`、`504` 指数退避，尊重 `Retry-After`（上限 8 秒）。
- **可取消** — 响应 seam 传入的 `AbortSignal`，取消后以 `WEB_ABORTED` 结束。
- **有上限的 I/O** — 原始响应 8 MiB，解压后 16 MiB。
- **稳健解码** — 按魔数识别 gzip/zlib，宿主安装不同版本的 undici dispatcher 也不会让 `response.json()` 失效。

## 与官方 DeepSeek provider 的区别

DSH 自带 `web-search-deepseek`（provider id 为 `deepseek-official`），走 DeepSeek 的 Anthropic 兼容接口和原生 `web_search` 工具。本插件直接调用 DeepSeek 的 Search / Fetch JSON API，并且是两者中唯一同时提供 **fetch** provider 的：

| | `deepseek-official` | 本插件 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 搜索后端 | Anthropic 兼容的 `web_search` 工具 | 原生 `POST /v1/tools/search` |
| 结构化字段 | 工具块中的 sources | 标题、URL、summary/snippet、日期 |
| 抓取 provider | 无 | 原生 `POST /v1/tools/fetch` |
| 模型回合 | 有 | 无，只做检索 |

两者可以共存；最终用哪个 provider 由 bundle patch 决定。选择本插件的主要理由是抓取：页面由 DeepSeek 抽取后以 Markdown 返回，而不是原始 HTML。

## 环境要求

- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2**（peer 依赖 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web` / `@deepseek-ai/dsh-launch-environment`）。
- **Node.js 24+**。DSH 0.2.1 的 CLI 入口使用 `import.meta.main`，Node 22 没有这个特性，CLI 会静默退出、什么都不做。
- 一个可访问 `/v1/tools/search` 与 `/v1/tools/fetch` 的 DeepSeek API key。调用由 DeepSeek 计费。

## 安装

### 从 npm 安装（发布后）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-deepseek-search
```

### 从 GitHub 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zou-hong-run/dsh-deepseek-search
```

### 从本地目录安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add link:C:/path/to/dsh-deepseek-search
```

`dsh plugin` 会把参数转发给 profile 目录里的 pnpm，并把包加入 `dsh.profile.bundles`。真正注册插件、改写 `web` 行的是包里的 bundle patch。

安装后重启 profile：

```bash
dsh web
```

### 验证

```bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A4 -- '- id: web'
```

应看到：

```yaml
- id: web
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-web'
  config:
    searchProvider: deepseek-search
    fetchProvider: deepseek-search
```

之后在会话里调用 `web_search` 或 `web_fetch` 即可。本插件没有自己的模型工具名，工具仍由 `dsh-tool-web` 提供。

## 凭据

插件加载时按以下顺序解析一次：

1. 插件配置里的 `apiKey`
2. `DEEPSEEK_SEARCH_API_KEY`
3. `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`

`available()` 只做本地检查（`apiKey` 非空且 `baseURL` 是合法的 http/https 地址），这是 seam 的要求，不会发起网络请求。找不到 key 时 provider 报告不可用，seam 会返回 `WEB_PROVIDER_CONFIGURED_UNAVAILABLE`（未显式指定 id 时为 `WEB_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE`）。

在启动环境里设置 key：

```bash
export DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-...
dsh web
```

或在 `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml` 中覆盖插件条目：

```yaml
- id: dsh-deepseek-search
  config:
    apiKey: sk-...
```

## 配置

| 键 | 默认值 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apiKey` | `""` | 显式凭据，优先于两个环境变量 |
| `baseURL` | `https://api.deepseek.com` | API 基地址，自动拼接 `/v1/tools/search` 和 `/v1/tools/fetch` |
| `count` | `10` | 调用方未传 `maxResults` 时的默认结果数 |
| `maxRetries` | `2` | 首次尝试之后的重试次数 |
| `retryDelayMs` | `800` | 指数退避的基础延迟 |

覆盖示例：

```yaml
- id: dsh-deepseek-search
  config:
    baseURL: https://api.deepseek.com
    count: 5
    maxRetries: 1
```

bundle patch 会整行替换 `web` 的 config。如果你的部署还需要在 `web` 行上保留其他键，请在自己的 patch 层里一并写回（用户 patch 在 bundle 之后应用）。

## 字段映射说明

seam 的词汇比 DeepSeek 响应窄，部分字段会被有意丢弃：

- **搜索** — `summary` 映射为 `snippet`（没有时回退到 `snippet`），`date` 映射为 `publishedAt`。`authority`、`rerankScore`、`siteName`、`siteIcon` 和页面 `content` 在 seam 中没有对应字段，不会返回。`content`（服务方生成的答案）也不返回，因为 DeepSeek 不生成答案。
- **抓取** — 返回 `{ kind: 'text', content }`。`WebFetchResult` 没有标题字段，抽取出的 title 会被丢弃。`statusCode` 固定为 `200`：DeepSeek 报告的是自身抽取状态，不是源站 HTTP 状态。`truncated` 保持 `false`，按结果数截断由 seam 负责。
- **结果数** — `request.maxResults` 会作为 `count` 发送，并限制在 API 上限 50 以内；调用方未传 `maxResults` 时使用配置里的 `count`。

## 错误码

| 错误码 | 来源 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `WEB_PROVIDER_ERROR` | 本插件 | 参数非法、服务方报错，或响应无法解析 |
| `WEB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING` | 本插件 | 未配置 key 时直接调用了 `search()`/`fetch()` |
| `WEB_ABORTED` | 本插件 | 调用方 signal 触发，或请求被中止 |
| `WEB_PROVIDER_CONFIGURED_UNAVAILABLE` | DSH seam | 配置的 id 已注册，但 `available()` 返回 false |
| `WEB_PROVIDER_CONFIGURED_MISSING` | DSH seam | 配置的 id 没有注册 |

DeepSeek 返回的错误信息会原样透出。

## 开发

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm test
```

测试使用 `node:test` 并 mock `globalThis.fetch`，不需要 key，也不会发起真实网络请求。当前覆盖：配置优先级、可用性判断、结果映射、请求体、重试与取消、gzip 解码、参数校验、provider 注册。

目录结构：

```text
dsh-deepseek-search/
  cordis.patch.yml      # bundle patch：插入插件、改写 web 行
  package.json          # dsh.bundle.patch 与 peer 版本范围
  lib/index.js          # Config schema、两个 provider、传输层、apply()
  test/providers.test.mjs
```

## 限制

- `/v1/tools/search` 与 `/v1/tools/fetch` 由服务方维护，可能变更或限流；本插件不做本地爬取或 HTML 解析。
- 抓取结果是 DeepSeek 抽取器的输出；抽取失败的页面会以 `WEB_PROVIDER_ERROR` 结束。
- 插件只做检索，不运行模型回合，也不生成答案文本。
- 已在 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 + Node 24.22 上验证；其他版本可能改变 loader 或 seam 契约。

## 许可证

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

这是第三方插件，与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系。

---

[English README](README.en.md)

plugins.description: dsh-cn-doc-formatter · DSH 插件
plugins.readme_text: # @deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-doc-formatter [![dshfind 收录](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/feely0208/dsh-cn-doc-formatter?lang=zh)](https://dshfind.com/zh/plugins/feely0208/dsh-cn-doc-formatter) [![Listed on DSH Plugin Hub](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/zh/plugins/feely0208/dsh-cn-doc-formatter) ## 安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-doc-formatter ``` **中文公文排版** —— 给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 用的 skill 插件。 按 **GB/T 9704-2012《党政机关公文格式》** 生成 `.docx` / `.pdf` / `.txt`， 并自带**输出自检**——生成完逐项核对页边距、字号、行距、字体、页面尺寸， 不符合规范就报错，而不是让你交付一份看起来差不多、实际不合规的文件。 ## ⚠️ 本插件不含字体，字体需你自备 **这是刻意的设计，不是缺失。** 公文规范要求的仿宋（方正仿宋等）是**商业字体**。其授权允许你在文档中使用， 但**不允许再分发字体文件本身**。所以本插件只做「排版引擎」，字体由你提供： ```bash # 方式一：直接指定字体文件（推荐，最明确） export DSH_CN_FANGSONG=/path/to/仿宋.ttf export DSH_CN_FANGSONG_BOLD=/path/to/仿宋加粗.ttf # 可选 # 方式二：指定一个目录，脚本在其中按文件名查找 export DSH_CN_FONT_DIR=~/my-fonts ``` 也可以直接装进**系统字体目录**（一次装好处处可用）： | 系统 | 目录 | |---|---| | macOS | `~/Library/Fonts/` | | Windows | `C:\Windows\Fonts\` | | Linux | `~/.fonts/` 或 `~/.local/share/fonts/` | 装 WPS Office 也行 —— 它自带方正仿宋。 **找不到字体时不会静默失败**：PDF 退回系统宋体，并在 stderr 打印上面这张获取指引。 docx 只在文件里声明字体族名（由你机器上的 Word 渲染），不依赖字体文件。 > **一个细节**：如果你只有常规仿宋、没有加粗体，**标题会继续使用仿宋**（只是不加粗）， > 而不是换成宋体。因为「全文统一仿宋」是硬规范，宁可字重不够也不换字体族。 > reportlab 不做合成粗体，这是引擎限制。 ## 它管什么 | 项目 | 规范值 | |---|---| | 标题 | 仿宋，二号（22pt）加粗，居中，行距 33–36 磅 | | 一/二/三/四级标题 | 仿宋，三号（16pt）加粗，左空二字 | | 正文 | 仿宋，四号（14pt），固定行距 28 磅，首行缩进严格 2 字 | | 版头（可选） | 份号 / 密级 / 紧急程度 / 发文字号，仿宋三号 | | 署名与日期 | 距正文下空 3 行，日期阿拉伯数字右空 4 字 | | 页码 | 「- 1 -」，单页居右空一字、双页居左空一字 | | 页边距 | 上 3.7 / 下 3.5 / 左 2.8 / 右 2.6 cm | | 文档网格 | 每面 22 行、每行 28 字 | **不出现任何 AI 痕迹**：无水印、无生成标记、无作者信息、无版本说明、无注释。 ## 安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-doc-formatter ``` 然后重启 dsh。技能会在 agent 需要时自动可用。 ### Python 依赖 排版脚本是 Python，需要这些库： ```bash pip install python-docx reportlab fontTools pypdf ``` | 库 | 用途 | |---|---| | `python-docx` | 生成 Word 文档 | | `reportlab` | 生成 PDF | | `fontTools` | 探测本机已装字体（读字体 name 表） | | `pypdf` | 自检时校验 PDF 是否真的嵌入了目标字体 | ## 它比「套个模板」多做了什么 **1. 输出自检（`verify_output.py`）** 生成完不是结束。自检会真的打开产出文件，逐项核对： ``` ── 公文.docx ✅ 上边距 3.70cm ✓ ✅ 标题 22pt 加粗 ✓ ✅ 正文 14.0pt / 行距 28pt ✓ ✅ 全文统一字体：FangS-SC ✓ ── 公文.pdf ✅ 嵌入字体：/AAAAAA+FangS-SC, /AAAAAA+FangS-SC-Bold ✅ 页面 A4 21.0×29.7cm ✓ ``` 退出码 `0` = 通过，`1` = 有不符合项 —— **可以直接用在 CI 或交付卡口上**。 **2. Markdown 输入适配（`md_adapter.py`）** 内容常以 Markdown 写就，直接喂给脚本会丢失层级（整篇被当正文）： | Markdown | 转成 | 公文层级 | |---|---|---| | `## 一、小节` | `一、小节` | 一级标题 | | `### 1.1 小节` | `（一）小节` | 二级标题 | | `#### 更深` | `1. 小节` | 三级标题 | | `- 列表项` | 正文 | 正文 | | `\| 表格 \|` | `表头：值；表头：值。` | 正文 | 它还会把同一段内的软换行合并成一行 —— 源文档常手动折行， 逐行当独立段落会在断句处留下孤立标点（如单独一行的「、」）。 **3. 跨平台字体探测** 早期实现用 `fc-list` 探测字体，而 **macOS 不预装 fontconfig**， 异常被吞掉后恒返回「字体不存在」，于是**即使装了仿宋也检测不到**，会始终走回退分支。 本版改为直接读字体文件的 `name` 表，macOS / Windows / Linux 通用。 ## 用法 技能正文里有完整命令。核心三条： ```bash # 生成 Word / PDF python "<插件目录>/scripts/docx_formatter.py" --output <目录> \ --title "标题" --body "正文..." --sender "发文机关" --date "2026年9月25日" python "<插件目录>/scripts/pdf_formatter.py" --output <目录> \ --title "标题" --body "正文..." --sender "发文机关" --date "2026年9月25日" # 输出自检（不要跳过） python "<插件目录>/scripts/verify_output.py" --dir <输出目录> ``` > ⚠️ **早期文档里的 `--type notice` 参数并不存在**，加上会直接报 > `unrecognized arguments`。文种由内容决定，脚本不做区分。本版已修正文档。 ## 设计取舍 **不分发字体。** 见上文——这不是省事，是避免把商业字体的再分发风险 转嫁给每一个使用者。 **不联网。** 排版、字体探测、自检全部在本地完成，不把文档内容发往任何第三方服务。 **文种不参与排版。** 通知 / 报告 / 函 / 决定的排版规范是一致的， 差别只在正文怎么写。脚本不为文种分叉，避免维护一堆看似不同实则相同的模板。 ## 与其它插件的关系 按 [DSH 插件生态倡议书](https://github.com/anywhere-labs/dsh-desktop/blob/main/docs/plugin-ecosystem.md) 的三条原则开发：**组合优先、声明清晰、兼容优先**。不假设、不覆盖其它插件的内部实现。 ## 许可 MIT。**本软件不包含任何字体文件**；使用者在文档中选用何种字体，由使用者自行负责 取得该字体的合法授权。 ---

plugins.description: Bulk RNA-seq and single-cell pseudo-bulk concordance, with DSH and MCP integrations for ChatGPT and Claude.
plugins.readme_text:
# Bulk–scRNA Concordance

Compare bulk RNA-seq expression with group-level pseudo-bulk profiles from
single-cell RNA-seq. Available as a DSH Host plugin, Python CLI and MCP server
for Claude, ChatGPT and other MCP clients.

The tool reports Pearson and Spearman correlations, a linear regression,
optional group-matching diagnostics, and figures. Each run records parameters,
input/output hashes and package versions.

## Inputs and analysis

- Single-cell raw counts: `.h5ad`, or a genes × cells CSV with cell metadata.
- Bulk expression: a genes × samples CSV/TSV.
- A group label for each cell; bulk sample names must contain the matching
  group as an exact delimited token.

Cells are summed by group, and bulk samples are averaged within each group.
The default normalization is CPM followed by `log2(x+1)`. The regression and
figure use bulk as x and pseudo-bulk as y, with the same genes and transformations.

For `.h5ad`, the default count source is `layers['counts']` when available,
otherwise `X`. Select a layer with `--sc-layer <name>` or explicitly select
`raw.X` with `--sc-use-raw`. Gene metadata follows the selected matrix.
All single-cell inputs must contain raw counts: nonfinite, negative and
non-integer values are rejected. These checks cannot prove that integer-valued
data are untransformed; confirm the source before running.

This is a descriptive comparison. Pooling by group does not estimate biological
replicate variation. The optional matched–mismatched correlation gap can flag
unexpected matches, but does not prove biological agreement.

See [docs/usage.md](docs/usage.md) for parameters, normalization and limitations.

## Requirements

Python with `numpy`, `pandas`, `scipy` and `matplotlib`; `.h5ad` input also
requires `anndata` and `h5py`.

```bash
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
```

## Real-data example: human iPSC (GSE77288)

This example compares independently measured bulk and single-cell read counts
from three donors in [Tung et al. (2017)](https://doi.org/10.1038/srep39921),
available as [GSE77288](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE77288).
It uses the authors' 564 QC-passing cells and eight matching bulk libraries.
The QC list excludes all NA19098.r2 cells, so that batch's bulk library is also
excluded. Both inputs use untransformed read counts; the 92 ERCC spike-in
columns are removed.

![Bulk and single-cell expression concordance in three real iPSC donors](examples/gse77288/results/GSE77288_real_bulk_scrna_correlation.png)

| Donor | Cells | Bulk libraries | Genes used | Pearson r | Spearman ρ |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| NA19098 | 142 | 2 | 15,844 | 0.966628 | 0.963411 |
| NA19101 | 201 | 3 | 16,440 | 0.968652 | 0.967269 |
| NA19239 | 221 | 3 | 16,247 | 0.972792 | 0.970065 |

The figure uses default shared axes, hexagonal gene-density bins, a logarithmic
gene-count colorbar, grid lines, regression lines and per-panel statistics.
The reference run used analysis commit
[`7478bde`](https://github.com/Wanner122333/dsh-bulk-scrna-concordance/commit/7478bdef898cdca66ba05b101f6a5cbfe239035e).
Raw counts and the correlations/regressions were checked independently.

[PDF](examples/gse77288/results/GSE77288_real_bulk_scrna_correlation.pdf) ·
[SVG](examples/gse77288/results/GSE77288_real_bulk_scrna_correlation.svg) ·
[Statistics CSV](examples/gse77288/results/GSE77288_real_bulk_scrna_correlation_stats.csv) ·
[Cross-donor correlations](examples/gse77288/results/GSE77288_real_discriminability.csv) ·
[Results, parameters and source hashes](examples/gse77288/reference_run.json)

From the repository root, prepare the public inputs and run the same analysis:

```bash
python examples/gse77288/prepare.py --out-dir results/gse77288/input-data
python python/bulk_scrna_concordance.py \
  --sc-h5ad results/gse77288/input-data/sc_read_counts.h5ad \
  --bulk-csv results/gse77288/input-data/bulk_read_counts.csv \
  --group-col individual --gene-id-key var_names --discriminability \
  --out-dir results/gse77288 --out-prefix GSE77288_real \
  --results-json results/gse77288/GSE77288_real_results.json
```

The preparation script downloads about 13 MB of compressed counts plus sample
annotations, verifies fixed SHA-256 hashes, and writes raw-count inputs and
provenance. It reuses verified cached downloads on later runs. The underlying
counts are downloaded from their public sources rather than bundled here.
See the [example notes](examples/gse77288/README.md) for filtering, caching and
the reference environment. All three donors are iPSCs: these gene-wise
correlations describe expression agreement, not biological replicate inference
or general classification accuracy. Pearson p-values underflow to zero in the
statistics CSV and display as `p < 1e-300` in the figure.

## Command line

Run the included synthetic fixture:

```bash
python python/bulk_scrna_concordance.py \
  --sc-matrix-csv examples/synthetic/sc_expr.csv \
  --sc-meta-csv examples/synthetic/sc_meta.csv \
  --bulk-csv examples/synthetic/bulk.csv \
  --group-col Group --discriminability \
  --out-dir results --out-prefix example \
  --results-json results/example_results.json
```

For real `.h5ad` data:

```bash
python python/bulk_scrna_concordance.py \
  --sc-h5ad /path/to/counts.h5ad --sc-layer counts \
  --bulk-csv /path/to/bulk.csv --group-col Group \
  --out-dir results --out-prefix my_run \
  --results-json results/my_run_results.json
```

## DSH plugin

Clone the repository:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Wanner122333/dsh-bulk-scrna-concordance.git
```

In DSH, open **Settings → Plugins** and install the bundle using the absolute
path to the checkout containing `package.json`. The registered tool is
`bulk_scrna_concordance`. Check the installation result and restart DSH if it
reports `restart-required`.

For profiles managed through the CLI:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/dsh-bulk-scrna-concordance
```

Set `pythonPath` in the profile's plugin configuration if the required Python
interpreter is not on its `PATH`:

```yaml
- id: bulk-scrna-concordance
  name: "@local/dsh-bulk-scrna-concordance"
  config:
    pythonPath: /absolute/path/to/python
    defaultTimeoutMs: 1800000
    maxLogLines: 40
```

Use the in-app installer for the Desktop-owned profile.

## ChatGPT and Claude through MCP

Install the optional MCP dependencies:

```bash
python -m pip install -r requirements-mcp.txt
python python/mcp_server.py --transport stdio --workspace /path/to/data
```

The server exposes `bulk_scrna_concordance` through stdio for local clients
such as Claude Desktop and Claude Code. Streamable HTTP is also supported.
ChatGPT can connect through Secure MCP Tunnel or an operator-deployed HTTPS
endpoint; account and workspace policies apply. See [MCP setup](docs/mcp.md)
for client configuration and deployment requirements.

Inputs must exist on the server machine. The server returns statistics and
artifact paths; it does not upload chat attachments or serve file downloads.
The HTTP server has no built-in authentication and binds to loopback by
default. Keep it private, or place it behind an authenticated HTTPS proxy.

## Outputs

Files are written under `--out-dir`:

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `<prefix>_results.json` | Parameters, per-group statistics, diagnostics and warnings; CLI requires `--results-json` |
| `<prefix>_bulk_scrna_correlation_stats.csv` | Per-group statistics |
| `<prefix>_discriminability.csv` | Pseudo-bulk × bulk correlation matrix, when requested |
| `<prefix>_bulk_scrna_correlation.{png,pdf,svg}` | Scatter plots with regression and y=x lines |
| `<prefix>_manifest.json` | Code/input/output hashes and recorded environment versions |
| `<prefix>_run.log` | Analysis log when called through DSH or MCP |

The manifest's `environment_lock` field records installed versions; it is not
an installable dependency lockfile.

## Checks

```bash
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
node --check index.js
```

These synthetic regression checks cover input handling and numerical behavior.
They do not establish biological validity or confirm an installed host's setup.

plugins.description: Windows bash tool for DeepSeek Harness: replaces the preset's pwsh with Git for Windows or MSYS2 bash while keeping the official terminal contract (cwd, background jobs, timeout promotion, result markers, terminal cards).
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-gitbash

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

A Windows terminal bridge for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**. It replaces the
model-facing `pwsh` tool with a real `bash` tool, with selectable **Git for
Windows** and **MSYS2** profiles, while keeping the official terminal-tool
behaviour: working directory, background jobs, timeout promotion, permission
escalation, terminal cards, PTC and `meta.cwd`.

This is the complete user manual and reference. It covers installation, daily
usage, the security model, settings, troubleshooting and development.

> **Minimum DSH: 0.2.1.** Windows 10/11 only. The replacement applies to **new
> sessions**; existing sessions keep the tools they were created with.

---

## Contents

- [What you get](#what-you-get)
- [Requirements](#requirements)
- [Install](#install)
- [Quick start](#quick-start)
- [Security model (read this first)](#security-model-read-this-first)
- [Using the bash tool](#using-the-bash-tool)
- [Shell profiles](#shell-profiles)
- [Settings](#settings)
- [Cookbook](#cookbook)
- [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)
- [Diagnostics](#diagnostics)
- [Compatibility and upgrades](#compatibility-and-upgrades)
- [Development](#development)
- [Limitations and non-goals](#limitations-and-non-goals)
- [License](#license)

---

## What you get

- **One `bash`, no `pwsh`** in the model tool catalogue: `tools.restrict` hides
  `pwsh`, the `tool:pwsh` prompt section is shadowed, and `tool:bash` is added.
  The replacement applies to new sessions; existing ones are not retrofitted.
- **Two shell families, one selector**: Git for Windows (default priority) or
  MSYS2 (`UCRT64`, `MINGW64`, `CLANG64`, `CLANGARM64`, `MINGW32`, `MSYS`).
  Discovery reads the registry, `where.exe`, PATH and the usual install roots,
  validates the candidate with `bash --version`, and never proposes WSL's
  `bash.exe`.
- **Official tool contract**: `description`, `command`, `timeoutMs`, `workdir`,
  `run_in_background`, `sandbox_permissions` / `justification`, POSIX and
  Windows-form workdirs, the same `[exit code: N]`, `[stderr]` and truncation
  spill markers, and `meta.cwd` for the terminal card.
- **Background work**: `run_in_background` returns a job id; collect with
  `job_output`, stop with `job_kill`, and a foreground call past its deadline is
  promoted to a job instead of being killed.
- **Isolation instead of improvisation**: PATH entries from the other bash
  family are filtered out, `MSYSTEM` matches the selected profile, and Git's
  `bin\bash.exe` launcher is canonicalized to `usr\bin\bash.exe`, so the
  environment the plugin composes is the one that actually runs.
- **Windows-specific correctness**: the `signalNumber << 8` exit encoding
  becomes `[killed by signal: SIGTERM]`, and inherited Windows `PWD` /
  `OLDPWD` are tombstoned so `pwd` stays POSIX.
- **Native DSH display**: terminal cards, the `1 background task` /
  `1 subagent` header badges, job cards and subagent cards are rendered by DSH
  itself — the plugin registers a `bash` tool with `meta.cwd`, it does not draw
  its own chat UI.
- **A compact settings row** with automatic discovery, an instant profile
  selector, compatibility mode, one-line warning and folded diagnostics.
- **Explicit security**: never silently widens permissions. `workspace-write`
  runs bash unconfined and labels the result with `[compat: ...]`, `read-only`
  refuses, and `strict` allows only `danger-full-access`. See
  [Security model](#security-model-read-this-first).
- **Verified**: 75 unit and integration tests, plus real-machine smoke on Git
  and MSYS2 (direct, background and subagent calls; light and dark settings UI).

---

## Requirements

| Item | Requirement |
|---|---|
| DSH | `>= 0.2.1` (tested on desktop runtime `0.2.1-rc.2`) |
| Windows | Windows 10/11, x64; MSYS2 arm64 environments are also supported |
| bash provider | Git for Windows and/or MSYS2 |
| Node.js | `^22.19.0` or `>=24`, development/build only |
| Optional | Cygwin, best-effort and not recommended |

- Git Bash and MSYS2 both use the MSYS2 runtime. That runtime cannot start
  inside DSH's Windows ACL sandbox; this is an OS constraint, not a plugin bug
  (evidence in [docs/DESIGN.md](docs/DESIGN.md)).
- WSL's `bash.exe` is intentionally excluded. WSL is not Git Bash and does not
  fit this profile/environment model.

---

## Install

### Use the CLI that ships with DSH Desktop

Do **not** use an old global npm `dsh` (for example `0.1.7`); it does not know
the 0.2.1 plugin/profile contract. Use the CLI under the desktop install:

```bat
set "DSH_CLI=%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd"
%DSH_CLI% --version
:: expect 0.2.1-rc.2 or newer
```

Fully quit DSH Desktop before changing a profile.

### From a local checkout (development)

```bat
%DSH_CLI% plugin --profile desktop add link:D:/GitHub/dsh-gitbash-new
```

Reopen DSH, then hard-refresh the Web UI (`Ctrl+Shift+R`).

### From GitHub (after publishing)

```bat
%DSH_CLI% plugin --profile desktop add github:riverzhou/dsh-gitbash-new
```

### From npm (published)

```bat
%DSH_CLI% plugin --profile desktop add @riverzh/dsh-gitbash@0.2.2
```

Use `@riverzh/dsh-gitbash@latest` for the newest release.

### Upgrade

Use the same CLI, restart DSH, hard-refresh:

```bat
%DSH_CLI% plugin --profile desktop remove @riverzh/dsh-gitbash
%DSH_CLI% plugin --profile desktop add link:D:/GitHub/dsh-gitbash-new
```

For a released version, replace `link:...` with `@riverzh/dsh-gitbash@<version>`.

### Uninstall

```bat
%DSH_CLI% plugin --profile desktop remove @riverzh/dsh-gitbash
```

Restart DSH. The settings row disappears with the plugin. A `dsh-gitbash`
entry left in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` is inert and can be deleted
manually.

### Do not run two “bash instead of pwsh” plugins

`dsh-tweaks`' `git-bash-terminal-tool` also hides `pwsh` and registers `bash`.
If it is already installed, remove or disable it first:

```bat
%DSH_CLI% plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-tweaks-git-bash-terminal-tool
```

When both are present, the first one to replace wins; the later one usually
skips because `pwsh` is no longer restrictable. The log contains
`skipped ... pwsh is not restrictable`.

---

## Quick start

1. Install and restart DSH.
2. Open **Settings → General → Terminal tool (Git Bash / MSYS2)**.
3. Leave **Shell** at **Auto (recommended)**, or pick a specific Git/MSYS2
   profile.
4. Keep **Compatibility** at **Compatibility mode (recommended)** unless you
   want strict mode.
5. Start a **new** session and ask the model to run something:
   *“Use bash to print the shell, cwd and Git status.”*
6. Confirm the model calls `bash` (not `pwsh`) and the result carries the
   expected cwd.

The settings row looks like this:

![Settings row: terminal tool](docs/images/settings-row.png)

The Shell, Compatibility and MSYS2-environment dropdowns use the DSH light/dark
surface tokens, so both the closed control and the open list stay readable:

![Shell dropdown in dark theme](docs/images/settings-dropdown-dark.png)
![Shell dropdown in light theme](docs/images/settings-dropdown-light.png)

---

## Security model (read this first)

The MSYS2 runtime cannot start under DSH's Windows ACL sandbox: restricted
tokens break its named shared memory, signal pipe and `BaseNamedObjects`. Adding
the user SID defeats write confinement; lowering to Low integrity breaks
`BaseNamedObjects` again. There is no configuration in which Git Bash both runs
and stays inside that sandbox.

The plugin therefore makes the trade-off **explicit**:

| Session permission | `compat: auto` (default) | `compat: strict` |
|---|---|---|
| `danger-full-access` | bash runs normally | bash runs normally |
| `workspace-write` | bash runs **outside the file sandbox**, result carries `[compat: ...]` | **refused** |
| `read-only` | **refused** | **refused** |

- **File tools remain sandboxed** by DSH. Only the bash process is unconfined.
- Under `workspace-write` + `auto`, bash can write outside the workspace. Treat
  paths outside the workspace as read-only unless the user explicitly asks
  otherwise.
- The plugin never silently widens permissions. The warning is always in the
  s

plugins.description: 把 DSH Web 界面换成自家品牌（Logo / 名称 / 中央标题 / favicon），并给页面与项目文件夹打上「为什么加 · 在干什么」水印。Rebrand your DSH web UI and stamp "why added / what job" watermarks on pages and project folders.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-brand-text

**English** | [中文](./README.zh.md)

Branding for the **DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web** client, in **two layers**:

1. **Basics** — sidebar logo, sidebar name, the hero title in the middle of an empty conversation, browser tab title, favicon and PWA manifest.
2. **Watermark** — a translucent, opacity-tunable overlay on the page, **plus** a stamping ledger that writes *“why this was added”* and *“what job was running”* into the project files and folders DSH works on.

Both layers are edited from one settings panel (`/brand-studio/`) or by double-clicking in place, and both live in the same `brand.json`.

> ⚠ Not the same as the community plugin [`dsh-custom-brand`](https://github.com/baisama-cloud/dsh-custom-brand).
> Both occupy the sidebar brand slots, so **do not enable them together** — they fight over the same DOM.

## ① Basics — what you can change

| Item | Where it shows | Data key |
|---|---|---|
| Sidebar name | Top-left of the sidebar; also the browser tab title and PWA name | `productName` |
| Hero title | The line in the middle of an empty new conversation | `heroText` (empty = official default "Into the Unknown" / 「探索未至之境」) |
| Sidebar logo | Sidebar brand slot / favicon / PWA icon | `logoPath` |

Changes take effect on a **page refresh (F5)** — no DSH restart required.

This plugin also covers everything the community plugin `dsh-client-ui-brand` did (title / brand slots / favicon / manifest),
so you do **not** need to install that one.

## ② Watermark — why bother doing it inside DSH

The obvious use is stamping photos. The less obvious one is the reason this lives in DSH:

> You add a pile of project files/folders while working on something. Two weeks later you open them again and
> have no idea **why they were added** or **what job you were in the middle of**.

So the watermark stores two sentences — *why this was added* and *what is being worked on* — and shows them in two places:

| Form | Where you see it | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **A. Page overlay** | A translucent diagonal text layer over DSH | opacity / angle / size / tiled-or-single are all tunable; `pointer-events: none`, so it never blocks clicks |
| **B. File / folder stamp** | Inside the project directory — a `_DSH水印说明.md` note, an Explorer hover tip (InfoTip), and folder icon swapped to the brand mark | Written to the folder itself, so it survives outside DSH |

Stamps are tracked in a **ledger** (`watermark.targets`) with an *apply* / *undo* button per path. Undo removes the note,
restores the previous `desktop.ini`, and clears the folder attribute.

> Windows only for form B (it relies on `desktop.ini` + `attrib`). Form A works on any browser.
> Applying a stamp sets the **system** attribute on the target folder — that is how Explorer is told to read `desktop.ini`.
> Explorer may need F5 to pick it up.

## Quick start

```bash
# 1. install into a profile — npm first (recommended)
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-brand-text

# 2. restart that DSH instance

# 3. open the settings panel
#    http://127.0.0.1:<dsh-port>/brand-studio/
```

If the GitHub route fails (network, pnpm build blocked, version gate), fall back to a local copy —
see [Install C](#c-from-a-local-folder-offline--fallback).

## Two ways to edit (same data, same API)

| Way | How | Good for |
|---|---|---|
| **Settings panel** | `http://127.0.0.1:<dsh-port>/brand-studio/` | Everything: basics, watermark tuning with a live preview, and the file/folder ledger |
| **Double-click in place** | Double-click the **top-left brand area** (logo or text) for a quick dialog; double-click the **hero line** to edit that copy | Quick tweaks — the page reloads after saving |

The dialog keeps the same order as the panel: **① basics first** (name, hero title, logo), **② watermark after it**
(enable switch, watermark text, *what job is running*, opacity slider).

> Trade-off: the sidebar brand area is normally a "new conversation" button, and a double-click would fire two clicks.
> To make double-click usable, the plugin swallows `click` / `pointerdown` on the brand slots —
