# dsh-liquid-inference

[Liquid Inference](https://liquidinference.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): a `liquid` model route plus read-only market tools.

## Install

Not published to npm yet. Install from GitHub or from a packed tarball, then export a buyer key with the `spend` scope and restart the profile:

```sh
export LIQUID_API_KEY=sk-liquid-...
```

**From GitHub.** The built `lib/` is committed, so no build step or `allowBuilds` entry is needed:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:architect-xyz/liquid-dsh-plugin
```

Pin a commit (`github:architect-xyz/liquid-dsh-plugin#<sha>`) so a later push cannot change what you install.

**From a tarball.** Needs no build permission:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/architect-xyz/liquid-dsh-plugin.git
cd liquid-dsh-plugin && pnpm install && pnpm pack
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-liquid-inference-0.1.0.tgz
```

Pick **Liquid Auto** (`liquid.auto`) in the model picker.

## What it adds

**Model route `liquid`** — no adapter code. The bundle patch configures the stock `llm-pi-ai` adapter with `api: openai-completions`, `baseURL: https://router.inference.ai.exchange/v1` and `apiKeyEnv: LIQUID_API_KEY`.

- **Cap.** Each request carries `x-liquid-cap-usd`, the most it can cost, locked before the first token. The default is 1 USD; set `LIQUID_CAP_USD` in the launching environment to change it.
- **Models.** `liquid.auto` plus its ranking variants `:cheapest`, `:economy`, `:balanced` and `:premium` (documented in the description of `GET /v1/exchange/routers`), and `deepseek-v4-flash` as a pinned model. Add any id from `GET /v1/models` with a `models` entry in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`.
- **Reasoning.** Levels `low`, `medium` and `high` are sent as `reasoning_effort`. The exchange passes the level through unchecked, so a level the winning provider rejects fails that request.

**Tools** (plugin `liquid-inference`)

| Tool | Endpoint | Key |
|---|---|---|
| `liquid_get_book` | `GET /v1/exchange/offers` | no |
| `liquid_get_markets` | `GET /v1/exchange/markets` | no |
| `liquid_get_routers` | `GET /v1/exchange/routers` | no |
| `liquid_get_job` | `GET /v1/jobs/{id}` | yes |

Chat, image, speech and video purchases are deliberately not tools: the harness's own model route is the one place that spends.

## Data flow

Full prompts and tool results go to `router.inference.ai.exchange`, which forwards them to whichever third-party provider wins the auction. The key is read per request, from the credential store when the profile mounts one and from `LIQUID_API_KEY` otherwise (headless profiles disable the store). It is never written to config.

## Notes

- The patch replaces the `llm-pi-ai` row's whole `config`. If another bundle also configures pi-ai providers, restate them in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`.
- Develop: `pnpm install && pnpm run check`. Commit the rebuilt `lib/` with source changes (CI fails on a stale one). `pnpm run test:install` packs the bundle, installs the tarball into an isolated profile of a real dsh (`DSH_VERSION` picks the release, default `next`) and boots it; it needs network access.

plugins.description: A living sky for DeepSeek Harness — 给工作区一扇流动的天空。
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH 天空窗

[简体中文](./README.md) · [English](./README.en.md)

给长时间对着屏幕工作的人，一扇会流动的天空。

这是一个运行在真实 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）工作区里的换肤插件：太阳按当地时间沿半圆轨迹移动，天空从晨光、晴空、暮光过渡到月色与星光，云朵和 DeepSeek 标志云彩会缓慢漂浮。

**工作时，天空留在身后。** 原生工作区、对话和输入框照常使用。

[![天空窗在真实 DSH 工作区中的效果](./dsh-sky-window/docs/images/02-workspace-skin.png)](./dsh-sky-window/docs/images/02-workspace-skin.png)

**把天空调成喜欢的样子。** 选择城市、预览日出日落、调整天空浓度与云朵动效。

[![天空设置与时间预览](./dsh-sky-window/docs/images/03-sky-settings.png)](./dsh-sky-window/docs/images/03-sky-settings.png)

两张截图均直接引用 PNG 原图，点击可查看原始尺寸。

![晨光、晴空、暮光与夜色四宫格](./dsh-sky-window/docs/images/00-day-in-four-scenes.png)

![从早到晚的天空窗演示](./dsh-sky-window/docs/media/sky-from-morning-to-night.gif)

## 已有 DSH：安装插件

推荐从 [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-sky-window) 按包名安装，无需下载源码或自行构建：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-sky-window
```

npm `0.1.1` 已通过独立 Profile 的官方安装与实际加载检查；运行文件及 DSH 加载声明与此前完整验收的 `0.1.0` 一致，可复用其功能验收结果。

`0.1.2` 补充 npm 的仓库与项目链接，便于社区采集器识别；已逐文件对比线上 `0.1.1`，包内仅 `package.json` 元数据变化，运行文件及 DSH 加载声明一致。

也可以从 [v0.1.0 发布页](https://github.com/nickfast2025/dsh-sky-window/releases/tag/v0.1.0)下载 `dsh-sky-window-0.1.0.tgz`，在下载目录打开 PowerShell：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add .\dsh-sky-window-0.1.0.tgz
```

`web` 是示例 Profile 名称。安装后按原来的启动命令重启该 DSH，在 DSH 设置中启用天空窗。继续使用原有模型配置、聊天记录、地址和端口。详细步骤及卸载方法见[插件说明](./dsh-sky-window/README.md#安装到已有-profile)。

## 独立体验（Windows Web）

安装 Node.js 22 或更高版本，从 GitHub 的 **Code → Download ZIP** 下载并解压本仓库，在包含本 README 的目录打开 PowerShell。

首次使用 DSH 时安装推荐版本；已有 DSH 的用户可跳过安装命令，先检查版本：

```powershell
node --version
npm install --global @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2
dsh --version
```

启动天空窗：

```powershell
.\start-dsh-sky.ps1
```

浏览器通常会自动打开。若需手动打开，请使用终端中 **DSH 打印的完整认证链接**；只输入 `http://127.0.0.1:3081` 可能会显示需要认证。该链接含临时登录令牌，请勿公开。

脚本会在解压后的项目文件夹内自动创建 `.runtime/dsh-home`，保存这套环境的设置和聊天记录。首次在 DSH 网页设置中填写自己的 API Key 并选择模型，保存后下次启动会继续使用。已有 DSH 的用户也可以选择上面的插件安装方式，沿用现有配置。

点击侧栏「工作区」旁的添加按钮，可浏览目录、新建文件夹并加入工作区。端口冲突时可运行 `.\start-dsh-sky.ps1 -Port 3085`；在终端按 Ctrl+C 停止服务。

插件的完整说明、截图和 MP4 演示在 [dsh-sky-window/README.md](./dsh-sky-window/README.md)。

已有 DSH、只想安装插件时，按[打包安装步骤](./dsh-sky-window/README.md#安装到已有-profile)操作。安装后继续使用原来的 DSH 启动命令、地址和端口；天空窗插件不会另开一个服务，也不要求使用 `3081`。

## 验证

```powershell
cd .\dsh-sky-window
npm test
npm pack --dry-run
```

插件源码只使用 Node 内置模块，不需要额外运行 `npm install`。GitHub Actions 配置覆盖 Node 22 / 24 的构建、测试与打包检查；真实 DSH 界面兼容结果见下表。

## 兼容性

**推荐版本：**新安装优先选择 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`；已有 `0.1.1-rc.2` 环境的用户可以继续使用。天空窗不绑定单一 DSH 版本，其余五个 RC 版本也已有天空界面的运行记录。部分版本在测试中需要处理依赖或 Profile 配置，详见下表。

表中的「调整后」是测试时确实做过的处理；各版本的原样安装状态以对应记录为准。

| DSH 版本 | 天空窗与对话 | 安装或配置记录 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `0.1.1-rc.1` | 调整后天空界面运行；隔离模型对话收到回复 | DSH 默认安装曾因 Cordis 混版而无法启动；固定配套依赖后运行。测试插件副本曾调整版本声明 |
| `0.1.1-rc.2` | 现用开发基线；天空窗持续运行 | 本轮尚未把去锁后的发布包放进全新 Profile 做完整验收 |
| `0.1.2-rc.1` | 调整后天空界面运行；本轮隔离模型对话待测 | 测试插件副本的版本声明与 Profile 配置曾调整 |
| `0.1.5-rc.3` | 隔离天空界面运行；隔离模型对话收到回复 | 直接运行沙箱 CLI，未完成官方插件安装命令的原样验收 |
| `0.1.7-rc.2` | 补依赖后天空界面运行；隔离模型对话收到回复 | 沙箱补装缺失的 Windows 原生依赖；测试插件副本曾调整版本声明 |
| `0.2.0-rc.2` | 调整后天空界面运行；隔离模型对话收到回复 | 测试插件副本的版本声明与 Profile 配置曾调整；去锁发布包的原样安装待测 |
| `0.2.1-rc.2` | 正式 0.1.0 包独立安装后，预览、一天播放、暂停壁纸、恢复实时、设置保存、停用恢复主题及真实模型对话通过 | 官方插件安装、卸载均通过，无需版本豁免；新版对话阅读背景适配已包含。另已验证干净副本的 Windows 启动器及新建工作区 |

上述结果来自 Windows Web 环境。去掉版本锁后，DSH 不再因为写死的版本号拒绝天空窗；某版本是否能顺利安装并完整使用，仍以该版本的实测结果为准。

## 来源与反馈

这是社区项目。DeepSeek 标志来源记录在[素材说明](./dsh-sky-window/src/deepseek-mark.source.md)，标志相关权利归其所有者。项目代码采用 [MIT](./LICENSE) 许可证。

问题反馈请附 DSH 版本、系统、安装方式和复现步骤；功能变更见 [CHANGELOG](./CHANGELOG.md)。

# Rustvy (`dsh-rustvy`)

Русский | [English](README.en.md)

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-rustvy)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-rustvy)
[![загрузки](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-rustvy)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-rustvy)
[![лицензия](https://img.shields.io/badge/лицензия-MIT-blue)](LICENSE)
[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/тема-dsh--plugin-blueviolet)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

Значки производителей в списке моделей DeepSeek Harness, список моделей, который
остаётся настолько же актуальным, насколько актуален сам провайдер, и несколько
ключей провайдера в одном профиле — каждый чат отправляет запросы тем, который
выбрал. Один плагин, одно зеркало, без перезапусков.

## Что он делает

У плагина три задачи. Первые две работают от одного зеркала публичного каталога
провайдера; третьей зеркало не нужно — ей нужен только маршрут профиля.

**Значки.** Один монохромный значок производителя перед каждой строкой модели в
списке выбора — нарисованный так же, как его рисует собственная панель провайдера:
CSS-маска, заливаемая `currentColor`, поэтому один файл на производителя
обслуживает обе темы оформления и все состояния строки — наведение, выбор,
отключение — без цветовых вариантов.

| Где | Что появляется |
|---|---|
| Меню моделей в композере | монохромный значок 16 px перед каждой строкой модели |
| Кнопка модели в композере | значок выбранной модели перед её названием (14 px) |
| Всплывающее окно команды `/model` | тот же значок на каждой строке |
| Скины, перерисовывающие список (`dsh-claude-style`) | тот же значок; собственная плашка скина в этой строке прячется, чтобы две плашки не встретились |

**Список моделей.** Профиль подключается к стороннему провайдеру через вручную
объявленный маршрут `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`, и именно список `models` этого
маршрута определяет, что вообще можно выбрать в интерфейсе: harness предлагает
модель только тогда, когда её отдаёт маршрут. Список, написанный вручную, устаревает
в тот день, когда провайдер выпускает новую модель — новая невидима, а снятая с
публикации остаётся выбираемой и падает уже на запросе. Плагин читает, что отдаёт
собственный эндпоинт маршрута, превращает это в точный формат записей адаптера,
показывает расхождение с установленным списком и по команде записывает его обратно
через `ctx.configEditor`.

**Ключи.** Несколько ключей провайдера в одном профиле и свой ключ для отдельного
чата — выбираемый в панели инструментов композера, сразу за списком режимов
доступа. Ключ добавляется в самом плагине, кнопкой **«+»**: ни `.env`, ни
`cordis.patch.yml`, ни страницу Models трогать не нужно, а выбор переживает
перезапуск. Учётная запись DeepSeek не затрагивается: подмена касается только
маршрутов этого плагина.

| Где | Что появляется |
|---|---|
| **Настройки → Rustvy** | раздел «API-ключи»: список ключей, кнопка **«+»**, замена значения, переименование, проверка, назначение ключом по умолчанию, удаление |
| Композер, сразу за списком режимов доступа | компактный переключатель ключа этого чата, с меню и строкой **«+ Добавить ключ»** |

Раздела ключей в меню моделей и в окне `/model` нет: выбор ключа живёт в одном
месте. Меню моделей вместо этого не показывает те группы провайдеров, которые
оказались клонами маршрутов этого кольца, — иначе один и тот же список моделей
повторялся бы по разу на каждый ключ.

## Зачем это нужно

Потому что обе поломки маршрута, который поддерживают вручную, — тихие. Модель,
которую провайдер добавил, не появляется, и никто не говорит почему: ошибки нет,
есть только отсутствие. Модель, которую провайдер снял, по-прежнему видна, и её
выбор даёт сетевую ошибку, которая выглядит как проблема со связью, а не как
устаревшая строка в YAML-файле.

И то и другое лечится чтением данных у провайдера вместо их переписывания. Список,
который записывает этот плагин, несёт настоящие размер окна контекста, лимит
вывода, входные модальности и уровни рассуждения, поэтому модель, получившая
поддержку изображений или новый уровень мышления, описана верно в тот же день, а не
наследует запасное значение, которое кто-то когда-то угадал.

А поскольку значки берутся из того же зеркала, совершенно новая модель приходит уже
с кешированным значком своего производителя: зеркало перечитывает каталог в тот
момент, когда эндпоинт называет модель, которой оно раньше не видело, — то есть
ровно тогда, когда выходит релиз.

Третья задача — про другую тишину. Ключ провайдера — это отдельный лимит и отдельный
учёт, а профиль один, поэтому «свой ключ на каждый чат» без плагина означает либо
второй профиль, либо вторую строку в YAML, которую кто-то должен поддерживать вручную.
Вручную поддержанный клон маршрута устаревает по тем же правилам, что и написанный
вручную список моделей, — в день релиза. Кольцо ключей пишет клоны само и тем же
проходом, которым записывается список моделей, поэтому маршрут ключа не отстаёт от
маршрута профиля, а чат, отправляющий запросы другим ключом, видит ровно тот же
выбор моделей, что и его сосед.

Ничего из этого не привязано к одному провайдеру. Сайт-источник, маршрут и строка
профиля — настройки; `https://rustvy.xyz` и `rustvy` являются значениями по
умолчанию.

## Установка

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-rustvy
```

Либо прямо с GitHub, если нужна самая свежая ревизия, а не опубликованная версия:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:koliy82/dsh-rustvy
```

Голый `koliy82/dsh-rustvy` без схемы не принимается: разбор источника установки
знает имя в реестре, git-спецификацию, tarball и абсолютный локальный путь, а
git-спецификации нужна схема либо сокращение `github:`.

Подтверждение сборки не запрашивается ни в том ни в другом случае: у пакета нет ни
install-скрипта, ни зависимостей, поэтому pnpm нечего собирать.

Из локальной копии этого репозитория:

```powershell
pwsh -File .\install.ps1
```

`install.ps1` копирует пакет в `<профиль>\node_modules\dsh-rustvy` как настоящий
каталог и дописывает имя в `dsh.profile.bundles` манифеста профиля. Работающий
harness подхватывает строку по изменению манифеста.

После этого один раз перезапустите harness или обновите страницу: значки и страница
настроек появляются на лету, а строка загрузчика читается на композиции.

### Маршрут, в который пишется список моделей

Значки работают без всего остального. Половине со списком моделей нужен маршрут
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`, в который можно писать. Добавьте в
`cordis.patch.yml` профиля — или отредактируйте в **Настройки → Плагины →
Конфигурация плагинов**:

```yaml
- id: llm-pi-ai
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai"
  config:
    providers:
      rustvy:
        displayName: rustvy
        apiKeyEnv: RUSTVY_API_KEY
        api: openai-completions
        baseURL: https://rustvy.xyz/v1
        models:
          - id: placeholder
            name: placeholder
```

Список `models` обязан только разбираться: этот плагин его заменяет. Все остальные
поля при перегенерации переносятся без изменений, потому что переключатель
совместимости протокола или ссылка на учётные данные — это знание о вашем
развёртывании, которого нет ни в одном каталоге.

`apiKeyEnv` задаёт, откуда маршрут берёт ключ; он разрешается на каждый запрос через
механизм учётных данных harness — сначала унаследованное окружение процесса, затем
`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`, затем `.env` в каталоге запуска или в `$DSH_HOME`.
Сам ключ в конфигурационные файлы не попадает. Плагин при чтении списка моделей
подставляет ключ только тогда, когда окружение процесса уже содержит переменную с
таким именем; эндпоинт, под который он написан, отвечает и без ключа.

Чтобы сделать модель основной:

```yaml
- id: agent-default-model
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-default-model"
  config:
    provider: rustvy
    model: claude-opus-5-5
    reasoningEffort: high
```

### Как пользоваться

Откройте **Настройки → Rustvy**. Страница показывает, что держит зеркало, что отдаёт
провайдер и каково точное расхождение между ними. Кнопка **«Об

plugins.description: Antigravity subagent for DeepSeek Harness: run Google Antigravity CLI (agy) as a one-shot coding subagent (subagent_antigravity), including Gemini 4 Argon.
plugins.readme_text:
---
description: "Antigravity subagent: drive the official Google Antigravity CLI (agy) as a one-shot coding subagent in DeepSeek Harness (subagent_antigravity), including Gemini 4 Argon on an Antigravity subscription."
kind: "package-bundle"
---

# dsh-subagent-antigravity

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-subagent-antigravity?label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-subagent-antigravity) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-subagent-antigravity)](https://github.com/PipeDream941/dsh-subagent-antigravity/blob/main/LICENSE)

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Adds an **Antigravity subagent** to DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a parent session can
call `subagent_antigravity` to run the official Google Antigravity CLI (`agy`) as
a fresh coding agent inside the parent workspace — it edits files, runs commands,
and returns only its final answer.

It has the same shape as the official Codex subagent (`subagent_codex`) and the
Claude Code subagent (`subagent_claude_code`), but the backend is Antigravity, so
it needs **no separate Gemini API key**: it uses your signed-in Antigravity Google
account subscription and can drive **Gemini 4 Argon** (`gemini-4-argon-low/medium/high`).

> Community plugin; not affiliated with Google. The Antigravity CLI is Google's
> official CLI — this plugin only drives it from DSH.

## Why this plugin exists

- **Gemini CLI cannot use Gemini 4 yet.** Gemini CLI 0.64 tops out at
  `gemini-3.8-flash` / `gemini-3.1-pro-preview`; the Gemini 4 support request
  (google-gemini/gemini-cli#29689) is still open, and Gemini 4 is not a public API
  model. Gemini 4 Argon is currently offered through Antigravity for Google AI
  Pro / Ultra subscribers, and `agy models` lists what your account can use.
- So "call Gemini 4 like Codex" means driving the **Antigravity CLI**, not the
  Gemini CLI. (A sibling plugin, `dsh-subagent-gemini`, covers the Gemini CLI
  route and will support Gemini 4 once Google ships it there.)

## How it works

```
parent session (DeepSeek model)
   │  calls tool subagent_antigravity({ description, prompt })
   ▼
DSH subagent seam (ctx.subagents)
   │  provider: antigravity (registered by this plugin)
   ▼
run layer: spawn agy --print --output-format stream-json
   │  parse NDJSON events (init / step_update / result), keep the final answer
   ▼
agy (separate process, parent cwd, your Antigravity sign-in and subscription)
   │  uses Antigravity's own tools (files, terminal, browser, MCP …)
   ▼
final answer → parent conversation
```

One delegation = one fresh process, one turn, final answer only. The child's
reasoning, tool traffic and stderr never enter the parent conversation; failures
return fixed stage/category diagnostics instead of raw stderr or credentials.

## Requirements

| Dependency | Version / notes |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | `0.2.1-rc.2` series (`ctx.subagents` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent`) |
| Node.js | `^22.19.0` or `>=24` |
| Google Antigravity CLI (`agy`) | official CLI, 1.4+; `agy --version` must answer |
| Antigravity account | signed in through the Antigravity app or CLI (AI Pro / Ultra for Gemini 4 Argon) |

Install the official CLI:

```bash
# macOS / Linux
curl -fsSL https://antigravity.google/cli/install.sh | bash
# Windows (PowerShell)
# irm https://antigravity.google/cli/install.ps1 | iex

agy --version      # expect 1.4.2+
agy models         # lists the models your account can use (incl. gemini-4-argon-*)
```

Sign-in is shared across local Antigravity surfaces; if the app is already signed
in, `agy` normally works directly. Otherwise run `agy` once and complete the
Google sign-in. Enterprise accounts can use `AGY_ADC_AUTH=true` with
`gcloud auth application-default login`, or the `GEMINI_API_KEY` mode (note: an
API key cannot reach Gemini 4 unless that key itself is entitled).

## Install the plugin

**From the DSH plugin market (recommended):** search for
`dsh-subagent-antigravity`, install and enable it.

**From the command line:**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-subagent-antigravity
```

Then add the package to that profile's `package.json` → `dsh.profile.bundles`
and restart (or let the profile recompose):

```json
"dsh": {
  "profile": {
    "bundles": ["…", "dsh-subagent-antigravity"]
  }
}
```

Once enabled, every agent sees the global tool `subagent_antigravity` (a running
session picks it up on its next request).

## Usage

```json
{
  "name": "subagent_antigravity",
  "arguments": {
    "description": "Fix login timeout",
    "prompt": "In the workspace, raise the login request timeout from 5s to 15s, run the related tests, and reply only with what you changed and the test result."
  }
}
```

- `description` — 3–5 word task name;
- `prompt` — a **self-contained** task; the child cannot see the parent conversation.

## Configuration

Override the `subagent-antigravity` entry's `config` in a profile patch:

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `providerName` | `antigravity` | name registered on `ctx.subagents`; unique per profile |
| `command` | empty (auto-detect) | path to `agy`; empty searches `PATH`, `~/.local/bin`, `/opt/homebrew/bin`, `/usr/local/bin`, … |
| `model` | `gemini-4-argon-medium` | fixed model; `agy models` lists the live catalogue (`gemini-4-argon-*`, `gemini-3.8-flash-*`, `claude-*-5-5-*`, …) |
| `effort` | empty | `low` / `medium` / `high` / `xhigh` / `max` |
| `mode` | empty | `accept-edits` / `auto` / `plan` (read-only) |
| `skipPermissions` | `true` | pass `--dangerously-skip-permissions` so an unattended child can edit/run; with `false`, headless cannot prompt and write tools are auto-denied |
| `sandbox` | `false` | pass `--sandbox` (the CLI's terminal sandbox) |
| `timeoutMs` | `900000` (15 min) | overall wall-clock budget per delegation |
| `disposeGraceMs` | `5000` | SIGTERM→SIGKILL escalation grace |
| `env` | `{}` | extra child environment variables |
| `extraArgs` | `[]` | extra CLI arguments for forward compatibility |

Example — Gemini 4 Argon High, read-only:

```yaml
- id: subagent-antigravity
  config:
    model: gemini-4-argon-high
    mode: plan
    skipPermissions: false
```

## Security and permissions

- The default `skipPermissions: true` is **unattended**: the child may edit files
  and run commands without a human approval prompt. That is what makes delegated
  coding tasks possible; use it in trusted workspaces and review `git diff`.
- For read-only delegation use `mode: plan` with `skipPermissions: false`; headless
  mode cannot prompt, so write attempts are auto-denied and reported as a
  `permission` failure instead of silently continuing.
- The child is a separate process: DSH's subprocess seam scrubs credential-like
  variables from the parent environment; only `env` entries are forwarded.
- No telemetry. No credential is read, logged or returned by this plugin; the
  Antigravity sign-in is managed by the CLI itself.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Fix |
|---|---|
| `Antigravity CLI (agy) was not found` | run the official install script and verify `agy --version` |
| diagnostic `category: auth` | not signed in: run `agy` once and complete the Google sign-in |
| diagnostic `category: permission` | headless cannot prompt: keep `skipPermissions: true` or use `mode: plan` |
| diagnostic `category: quota` | the model has no quota/rate left for this account right now |
| diagnostic `category: timeout` | raise `timeoutMs` or split the task |
| want to verify the machine | `npm run smoke` in the plugin checkout (one small Antigravity request) |

## Compatibility and development

- Unit tests: `npm test` (34 cases: config normalization, CLI discovery, and the
  run layer's event parsing, timeout, cancellation, permission and failure mapping);
- End-to-end self-check: `npm run smoke` (real `agy` + Gemini 4 Argon, expects PONG);
- No private DSH packages are imported (only `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` for config
  validation), so the run layer is unit-testable outside the host;
- Reference implementation: official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex` (the
  one-process-per-run, one-turn, final-answer, safe-diagnostics contract).

## Uninstall

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop rem

plugins.description: 仅本地、只读、不上传的 DSH Token 面板；按 provider 实际 usage 统计，所有后端统一汇总，含历史总量、365 天热力图、输入+输出/缓存明细、轮次/步骤、tok/s，归档不丢。
plugins.readme_text:
# Token Usage（LLMDSHPlugin_token-usage）

DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件：在桌面端/Web 端侧边栏左下角增加 **Token 统计**。所有统计只读本机 Session 日志，不访问外部服务、不上传数据；除了历史总量和每日热力图，还能看到输入+输出、缓存读写、轮次/步骤和平均 tok/s，会话归档或删除后历史仍然保留。

> 仅本地 · 只读 · 不上传 · 不挑后端。

## 关于“网络”能力标签

插件市场会把带前端界面的插件扫出 `network` 标签。本插件的 `network` 只来自浏览器端的一次同源请求：

```text
GET /api/llm-token-usage/stats
```

目标是**本机 DSH Host 自己注册的路由**，读取本机 Session 日志；不访问任何外部域名，不上传任何数据，不含遥测、统计或授权检查。Host 端的 `fs-read` 用于读 Session 日志，`fs-write` 只写 `~/.dsh/token-usage-ledger.json` 这一个文件。

## 亮点

- **仅本地，安全**：只读本机 Session 日志，不访问外部服务、不上传任何数据，也不修改 Session 或配置。
- **按实际用量**：按 provider 上报的 usage 统计，不做字符数估算。
- **不挑后端**：DeepSeek、GLM、Kimi 等只要在 Session 中留下 provider usage，就统一计入，不绑定单一模型或供应商。
- **安全可靠**：账本用临时文件 + 原子替换写入，文件损坏时保留 `.corrupt-*` 备份。
- **一眼看全**：左下角常驻今日用量；面板第一行是全部历史总量，下面是 365 天 GitHub 风格热力图。
- **明细够用**：每天可看总量、输入+输出、缓存读取、缓存写入和会话数。
- **不只 token**：全部历史的轮次、步骤和平均生成速度（tok/s）。
- **删了也不丢**：Host 把每个 Session 的日汇总持久化到 `~/.dsh/token-usage-ledger.json`，Session 归档或删除后历史仍然保留。
- **打开即用**：优先本地缓存；自动刷新最快 1 小时一次，手动刷新立即重新扫描。
- **增量刷新**：已归档的 Session 不重复扫描，只有 live 或新增 Session 重新读取；首次扫描后手动刷新通常秒回。
- **纯只读**：不修改任何 Session 或配置；fork 继承的事件不会重复计数。

## 关键指标

- 按 provider 上报的 usage 统计，包含 `inputTokens`、`outputTokens`、`cacheReadTokens`、`cacheWriteTokens`。
- 不区分 provider：所有在 Session 中记录 usage 的模型/后端统一汇总。
- 中文界面下大数字用「万 / 百万 / 千万 / 亿 / 万亿」显示，悬停明细同时保留精确数字。
- 日历显示最近 365 天；顶部总量覆盖全部历史。

## 安装

要求 DSH Desktop / Web 已安装，且 profile 中已启用 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`。

从本地目录安装到 Desktop profile：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add D:\WORK\ai-v5\LLMDSHPlugin_token-usage
```

或直接从 GitHub 安装：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:ai-v5/LLMDSHPlugin_token-usage
```

从 npm 安装：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add llm-dsh-token-usage
```

安装后重启 DSH Desktop。插件会出现在左侧栏底部 Settings 上方（同一区域还有 Cordis 入口）。如果终端里没有 `dsh` 命令，可使用 DSH Desktop 安装目录下的 `resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd`。

> 从旧的 LLMDSHPlugin monorepo 迁移：重新执行上面的 `add` 命令指向本仓库，旧的 `plugins\token-usage` 链接会失效。

卸载：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove llm-dsh-token-usage
```

## 统计口径

- 数据来自 DSH 的 `ctx.sessionQuery`：先 `listSessions()`，再读取每个 Session 的完整事件日志。
- 每个 `assistant/message` 或 `assistant/attempt` 的 provider usage 都会计入；同一 turn/step 的后续样本会替换前一样本，`llm/retry-started` 之后的 attempt 单独累计。
- `compaction/summary` 自带的 usage 也会计入（压缩调用不在 agent loop 的 step 内，日志里只有这一条记录）。
- 日期按 Host 本地时区划分。
- `totalTokens = inputTokens + outputTokens + cacheReadTokens + cacheWriteTokens`，其中包含 prompt cache 命中读取；面板同时展示不含 cache read 的 `inputOutputTokens`。
- 子 Session 与父 Session 都是独立 Session，会各自计入；fork 继承的前缀通过 `inheritedEventCount` 排除。

## 接口

Host 端注册只读路由：

```
GET /api/llm-token-usage/stats?range=all&refresh=1
```

也兼容 `?days=7|14|30|90` 的有界范围。返回：

```json
{
  "generatedAt": 1760000000000,
  "days": 366,
  "rangeKind": "all",
  "seriesTruncated": false,
  "range": { "from": "2025-10-19", "to": "2026-10-18" },
  "today": { "date": "2026-10-18", "inputTokens": 0, "outputTokens": 0, "cacheReadTokens": 0, "cacheWriteTokens": 0, "totalTokens": 0, "inputOutputTokens": 0, "sessions": 0 },
  "totals": { "...": "same shape as today" },
  "allTime": { "...": "same shape as today" },
  "series": [{ "date": "2025-10-19", "...": "same shape as today" }],
  "sessionCount": 0,
  "skippedSessions": 0,
  "incomplete": false,
  "activity": {
    "turns": 0,
    "steps": 0,
    "generationMs": 0,
    "timedOutputTokens": 0,
    "tokensPerSecond": 0
  }
}
```

`activity` 为全部历史汇总：`turns`/`steps` 来自 `turn/start`/`step/start`；`tokensPerSecond = timedOutputTokens / (generationMs / 1000)`，只统计带流式时间戳的 Assistant 调用。

Host 结果缓存 1 小时；`refresh=1` 跳过缓存并重新扫描。浏览器端在 `localStorage` 缓存最近一次成功结果：面板打开时优先显示缓存，缓存不足 1 小时不发请求，超过 1 小时才后台刷新；手动刷新不受此限制。

## 已知限制

- AI 会话标题（session title）等辅助调用不写入 Session 日志，因此不会计入；如果部署把这些调用计费，面板总量会略低于账单。
- 读取失败的 Session 会被跳过，面板会显示 `skippedSessions` 提示。
- 统计是 provider 上报 usage 的汇总，不是计费账单；不同 provider 对缓存读/写的上报口径可能不同。
- 首次打开或账本升级后需要完整扫描一次全部 Session 日志；之后只重读 live 或新增 Session，手动刷新通常秒回。
- 单个 Session 读取超过 15 秒，或整次扫描超过 45 秒，会跳过该部分并标记统计可能不完整，避免面板永久卡在刷新中。
- 插件首次成功扫描前就已经删除的 Session 无法追溯；删除 `~/.dsh/token-usage-ledger.json` 会重置历史汇总。

## 开发

```powershell
node --test tests/stats.test.mjs
node --check lib/stats.js
node --check index.js
node --check client.js
```

项目本身不需要构建：`index.js` 是 Host 半部，`client.js` 是浏览器半部，`locale/*.json` 提供插件管理页显示名称。

## 参考

设计上参考了 MIT 许可的 [HaoyueQin/dsh-usage-statistics-panel](https://github.com/HaoyueQin/dsh-usage-statistics-panel) 的按天口径与 footer 面板布局；本仓库代码是独立实现，没有复制其源码。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 客户端插件：把设置入口放到侧边栏底部，一键打开设置页。 / A DSH client plugin that puts a settings button at the bottom of the sidebar.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sidebar-settings

[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![verify](https://github.com/linguiyii/dsh-sidebar-settings/actions/workflows/verify.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/linguiyii/dsh-sidebar-settings/actions/workflows/verify.yml)

把 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的设置入口从「账号菜单 → 设置」的二级菜单里提出来，直接放到**侧边栏底部**：
点一下就打开设置面板，不必再先点账号头像。

A DeepSeek Harness **client plugin**: one settings button at the bottom of the sidebar, one click to the
settings panel — no more avatar menu → 设置.

![侧边栏底部的设置按钮](docs/sidebar-button.png)

> 图里两行「⚙ 设置」：上面一行是本插件新增的 `sidebar.footer.action` 座位，下面一行是外壳原生的
> `sidebar.settings` 入口（本插件不删除它）。

![点击后打开设置面板](docs/settings-panel.png)

> 截图展示的是设置面板的「添加 API Key」引导态；侧栏内容已做模糊处理。

侧边栏折叠成图标栏（rail）时只显示齿轮：

![折叠态下的图标按钮](docs/rail.png)

> 第一行是本插件渲染的图标按钮，第二行是原生入口。

`sidebar-button.png` 与 `settings-panel.png` 由仓库里的 CDP 探测脚本产出（见「开发」）；折叠态截图是在
同一个临时 profile 里手工折叠侧边栏后截取的。

## 前置条件

- **Node.js ≥ 22**（`package.json` 的 `engines`，构建与安装脚本都要求）。
- **DeepSeek Harness 桌面端**：已在 0.1.5-rc.2 的 Web UI 上做过端到端验证。
- 安装需要写权限：`<DSH_HOME>/profiles/<profile>` 目录（Windows 默认 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh`）。
- 仅 e2e 探测额外需要：`dsh` CLI + Chrome/Edge（`--headless=new --remote-debugging-port=<port>`）。

## 安装

先克隆，再把这个仓库装进 DSH profile（Windows 桌面端默认 profile 为 `desktop`）：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/linguiyii/dsh-sidebar-settings
cd dsh-sidebar-settings

node scripts/install-desktop.mjs --dry-run   # 先看要改什么
node scripts/install-desktop.mjs             # 真正写入
```

脚本只做三件事，并把改动过的文件各备份一份为 `<file>.dsh-sidebar-settings.bak`：

1. 在 `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-sidebar-settings` 建立指向本仓库的 junction
   （非 Windows 平台用目录符号链接）；
2. 在 profile 的 `package.json` 的 `dependencies` 里记录 `"dsh-sidebar-settings": "link:<本仓库路径>"`；
3. 把 `dsh-sidebar-settings` 追加到 `dsh.profile.bundles`（host 启动时按这个列表加载 profile 层）。

> **为什么不用 `dsh plugin add`**：`dsh plugin --profile desktop ...` 会被拒绝 ——
> `error: profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`
> （`desktop` profile 由桌面应用独占管理）。所以这里用脚本完成同样的三处改动。

安装后**重启 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端**（客户端 bundle 在启动时装配）。
卸载：`node scripts/install-desktop.mjs --uninstall` —— 删除链接、`dependencies` 条目与
`dsh.profile.bundles` 条目；已经不存在的那几项会跳过。

其他 profile / 其他 DSH_HOME：

```powershell
$env:DSH_HOME = "C:\path\to\.dsh"; node scripts/install-desktop.mjs --profile web
```

## 使用

- 侧边栏底部多出一行「⚙ 设置」，点一下即打开设置面板；
- 侧边栏折叠成图标栏（rail）时只显示齿轮图标，鼠标悬停提示「打开设置 (Ctrl+,)」；
- 原有入口都保留：账号菜单里的「设置」、快捷键 `Ctrl+,`（Windows/macOS 桌面端）照常可用。

## 实现方式

插件只做两件事：注册一个座位、打开一个面板。

**1. 按钮放在哪** —— `sidebar.footer.action`（`list` 槽，多插件可共存，按 `order` 排序）。
它在侧边栏 footer 的 `footerActions` 区，紧贴在最底部的 `sidebar.settings` 行（账号菜单行）之上；
侧边栏折叠时 `wide: false`，我们渲染成居中的图标按钮。样式以一个带 `data-plugin` 标记的
`<style>` 注入（客户端模块加载器会接管它，卸载/热更新时自动移除），配色走 `--dsw-*` 主题变量。

**2. 怎么打开设置** —— 两条路径，先精确后兜底：

- **store 路径**（较新的外壳）：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-general` 注册 `sidebar.settings`
  时把设置外壳的 store 挂在该槽的 entry 上（`store.create()` 返回同一份 shell 实例）。
  我们通过 `ctx.slots.entries("sidebar.settings")` 取回它并调用 `actions.open()` —— 与原生齿轮按钮、
  `Ctrl+,` 命令、账号菜单里的「设置」走的是同一个 action。
- **DOM 兜底**（较旧的外壳，store 未公开）：直接点侧边栏设置行自己的控件 ——
  旧外壳那里是原生齿轮按钮（点一次就开）；新外壳那里是账号菜单触发器，于是再等一帧点掉菜单里的
  「设置 / Settings」项。全部基于 `[data-slot="..."]` 与 `aria-haspopup` 语义选择器，不依赖哈希后的
  CSS module 类名。

不靠合成键盘事件：桌面端的 `Ctrl+,` 由宿主注册和处理，页面里派发 `keydown` 并不会打开设置。
所以本插件直接调用设置外壳的 action（store 路径），或者点真实控件（DOM 兜底）。

## 开发

仓库零依赖，不需要打包器：`src/client.js` 直接以「客户端模块工厂函数体」的形式书写（CommonJS，
只 `require` 外壳提供的平台模块），构建脚本只做字符串包装 + 纯度和校验。

```powershell
node scripts/build.mjs     # src/client.js -> lib/client.js（window.__ModuleLoader__.load 包装）
node scripts/verify.mjs    # 契约测试：VM 里加载 bundle，验证注册、渲染、四条打开/兜底路径
```

`lib/client.js` 是提交进仓库的构建产物，CI 会重跑构建并用 `git diff --exit-code -- lib/client.js`
确认它和 `src/client.js` 同步。

端到端验证（可选，需要一个已装插件的 Web 实例 + 带调试端口的 Chrome/Edge）：

```powershell
# 1) 起一个临时 profile 的 Web 实例（--from-default-profile 从内置模板初始化，避免影响正在用的桌面端）
$env:DSH_HOME = "$env:TEMP\dsh-verify"
dsh --profile verify --from-default-profile web --port 4779 --no-open
# 2) Chrome 打开 http://127.0.0.1:4779/?token=... 并带上 --headless=new --remote-debugging-port=9333
node scripts/probe-ui.mjs --cdp 9333 --shot lib/probe.png
```

`probe-ui.mjs` 会等到按钮出现、打印它的标签/位置、截侧栏底部特写（`<shot>-sidebar.png`），点击按钮后
确认设置面板打开并截整窗（`<shot>`），否则退出码 1。折叠态（rail）截图不在脚本里，需要手工折叠
侧边栏后另拍。

## 目录

```
cordis.patch.yml        profile 层 patch：插入插件行
lib/index.js            host 侧加载行（本插件不占 host 服务，apply 为空）
lib/client.js           构建产物：浏览器端 bundle（已提交，安装时无需构建）
src/client.js           浏览器端源码（factory body 形式）
scripts/build.mjs       无依赖构建：包装 + require 纯度闸门
scripts/verify.mjs      Node 内契约测试
scripts/install-desktop.mjs  把本仓库装进/卸出 DSH profile
scripts/probe-ui.mjs    CDP 端到端探测（渲染 + 点击 + 截图）
.github/workflows/verify.yml  CI：build → 构建产物漂移检查 → 契约测试
docs/                   验证截图
LICENSE                 MIT
```

## 已知限制

- **账号菜单里的「设置」不会被删掉**：那一项由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-account`
  的内部组件渲染，没有公开的扩展点可以移除它；本插件只是在你更顺手的位置补一个直达入口。
- 需要**重启桌面端**后生效（客户端 bundle 在启动时装配）。
- 侧边栏折叠时，`sidebar.footer.action` 座位只给 `wide`，无法感知当前面板是否已打开，按钮不做开/关状态高亮。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: The official DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI, unmodified, running on HarmonyOS 2in1 / tablet inside the system ArkWeb — with the dsh Host on a real Node.js runtime embedded in the same process. No Electron, no bundled Chromium, no ArkUI rewrite of the Web UI.
plugins.readme_text:
[中文](./README_zh.md) | English # DSH Desktop · HarmonyOS Edition > The **official DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web UI, unmodified**, running on HarmonyOS 2in1 / tablet inside the system **ArkWeb** — with the dsh Host on a **real Node.js runtime embedded in the same process**. No Electron, no bundled Chromium, no ArkUI rewrite.

## What you get - **The same dsh you already know** — sessions, tools, plugins, settings, themes. The frontend is upstream, untouched; the agent host runs locally, so there is no relay, no CORS, no account gate. - **Nothing to render with** — the system WebView draws the UI, so the package ships only the agent runtime (≈42 MB payload) instead of a browser engine. The HAP is ≈88 MB. - **Installs without restricted permissions** — the default build is JIT-free (`compat`), so side-loading needs no ACL-bound permission. A `jit` variant exists for devices granted the writable-code-memory permission. - **Zero upstream changes** — HarmonyOS differences live in an `ohos` profile, one bundle layer, seam plugins and six audited shims. Upgrading dsh means re-running the pipeline, not re-doing patches. - **Branded as this product** — own icon, name and window title; the upstream preview notice and the DeepSeek first-run dialog no longer open by themselves (both remain reachable in Settings). ## Two HarmonyOS editions HarmonyOS gets **two independent editions** with the same shell architecture, the same unmodified Web UI and the same data plane; the difference is **which runtime provides Node**: | | **HarmonyOS Edition** (this repo) | **Electron on HarmonyOS Edition** ([`dsh-desktop-hos`](../dsh-desktop-hos)) | |---|---|---| | Renderer | The system **ArkWeb** — nothing bundled | Chromium, shipped inside Electron 37 | | Node.js | `libnode.so` started in the app's own process (v24.2.0) | Inside the Electron runtime (Node 22.17) | | Runtime plumbing | [`@fellow99/node-bridge`](https://ohpm.openharmony.cn/#/cn/detail/@fellow99%2Fnode-bridge) + [`@fellow99/node-runtime`](https://ohpm.openharmony.cn/#/cn/detail/@fellow99%2Fnode-runtime) (ohpm) | [`harmonypc-electron`](../harmonypc-electron) | | Upstream dsh patches | **0** — profile + bundle layer + audited shims | 13 source patches | | Install requirement | none (JIT-free default) | JIT restricted permission (ACL) | | Package size | ≈88 MB | Electron-sized (hundreds of MB) | | Maturity | 0.2.1 — device-verified on HarmonyOS 6.1.0.135 (API 24) | 0.2.1 — device-verified (0.2.0 baseline) | Neither replaces the other: the Electron edition buys maximum desktop fidelity at the cost of a bundled Chromium and JIT; this edition buys a small payload and a permission-free install at the cost of covering platform gaps in the shim layer. ## Capabilities at a glance | Area | State | |---|---| | dsh Web UI, sessions, tools, skills, subagents | ✅ works as upstream | | File read / write / edit, image attachments | ✅ | | Workspace picker with Documents & Downloads (grant → read/write) | ✅ | | Git (21 tools, pure JS, no `git` binary needed) | ✅ | | Local plugins loaded from the profile, own branding | ✅ | | Command execution (`bash`) | ⚠️ executor ships; a path-resolution fix is pending | | Content search (`grep` / `glob`) | ⚠️ needs a pure-JS backend (no `ripgrep` binary on arm64) | | Delete / move / copy / chmod | ⚠️ upstream `ctx.fs` has no such primitives yet | | Plugin marketplace, tray icon, window-state memory | — not in this edition | The complete matrix — every capability, both editions side by side, with root causes — is [`docs/鸿蒙环境能力清单-0.2.1.md`](docs/鸿蒙环境能力清单-0.2.1.md). ## Status `0.2.1` (`versionCode` 201) — **runs on device**. Verified on HarmonyOS 6.1.0.135 (API 24, 2in1): installs with zero ACLs, the payload self-extracts and reports `ready`, all shims install, `node:sqlite`/FTS5 available, text and image conversations, workspace picker across the three roots, git clone (public and intranet), and the branded window (checked through the WebView debugger). Known gaps and their fix points are listed in the capability inventory above. ## Build Prerequisites: DevEco **Command Line Tools** (SDK API 24) and the sibling submodule `../deepseek-harness`. The Node runtime is pulled from the OpenHarmony ohpm central repository: [`@fellow99/node-bridge`](https://ohpm.openharmony.cn/#/cn/detail/@fellow99%2Fnode-bridge) (API + NAPI bootstrap) and [`@fellow99/node-runtime@24.2.0`](https://ohpm.openharmony.cn/#/cn/detail/@fellow99%2Fnode-runtime) (the `libnode.so` engine, SHA-256-locked by the bundled `runtime.lock.json`). ```bash node scripts/assemble-payload.mjs --deploy --apply # ① materialize the dsh runtime bash scripts/build-hap.sh # ② ohpm install → payload archive + HAP build/sign hdc app install -r entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap ``` `OHOS_CLT` overrides the Command Line Tools root; `node scripts/verify-upstream.mjs` proves the upstream pin is intact (tag, clean tree, patch ids, brand/onboarding gates). ## Docs | Document | What it answers | |---|---| | [Capability inventory 0.2.1](docs/鸿蒙环境能力清单-0.2.1.md) | What works, what does not, and how this compares to the Electron edition | | [Engineering plan](docs/000-工程规划.md) | Why this architecture, what was rejected, and the shim whitelist | | [On-device notes](docs/010-真机调试记录.md) | What broke on the device and how it was diagnosed | | [JIT and ACL](docs/ACL配置.md) · [JIT-less decision](docs/109-jitless-方案决策.md) | The two runtime forms and what each costs | | [Specifications](specs/README.md) | 11 spec modules (101–109, 204, 205) with plans and gates | ## Related - [`dsh-desktop`](../dsh-desktop) — Electron shell for Windows / Linux / macOS - [`dsh-desktop-hos`](../dsh-desktop-hos) — Electron on HarmonyOS Edition - [`@fellow99/node-bridge`](https://ohpm.openharmony.cn/#/cn/detail/@fellow99%2Fnode-bridge) / [`@fellow99/node-runtime`](https://ohpm.openharmony.cn/#/cn/detail/@fellow99%2Fnode-runtime) — the ohpm packages that embed Node (`node::Start`) in-process - [`deepseek-harness`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — the wrapped agent host ## License [MIT](./LICENSE)

plugins.description: Self-healing plugin doctor for DeepSeek Harness: detects failed plugin rows, disables them automatically with a patch backup, and reports diagnostics via /doctor.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-doctor

插件体检与自动修复。当某个插件行在加载时发生冲突（apply 抛错、服务重复注册、依赖缺失等），DSH 会把它标记为 `failed` 并让它停摆，但整个宿主继续运行。本插件周期扫描 Loader 树：

- 发现 `failed` 行时，调用官方 `pluginManager.setPluginEnabled(id, false)` **持久化禁用**该行（写入 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 并触发热重组），让其余插件照常工作；
- 每次修复写入 `$DSH_HOME/plugin-doctor/incidents.jsonl`，整份报告写入 `report.json`；
- 注册 `/doctor` 斜杠命令，随时手动体检。

## 配置（profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里给本行加 config）

```yaml
- id: plugin-doctor
  name: 'dsh-plugin-doctor'
  config:
    autoFix: true        # 默认 true：自动禁用加载失败的行
    scanDelayMs: 3000    # 启动后延迟首次扫描的毫秒数
    watchIntervalMs: 12000  # 运行期扫描间隔（0 = 只在启动时扫描一次）
    maxFixesPerBoot: 3   # 单次启动最多自动修复的行数
```

## 安全边界

- 只禁用，不卸载、不改 `package.json` 依赖；
- 不处理自身、`dsh-plugin-manager` 与插件清单模块，以及只读行（`readOnlyReason`）；
- 修复数量有上限；临时冲突（`HMR transactions cannot be nested`）自动重试，最多 6 次；
- 被修复的行在「插件」页仍可手动重新启用；修复记录完整可查。

## 报告格式

`report.json` 每次扫描重写：

```json
{
  "at": "…",
  "total": 199,
  "active": 174,
  "failed": [{ "entryId": "…", "moduleName": "…", "readOnlyReason": null }],
  "dormant": [],
  "fixed": [{ "entryId": "…", "result": { "application": "applied", "changed": true } }],
  "skipped": [{ "entryId": "…", "reason": "…" }],
  "errors": []
}
```

`dormant` = 启用但没有任何存活 fiber 的行（常见于模块导入失败），仅报告、不自动处理。

## 测试

- `node test/smoke.mjs`：假上下文下的 4 个场景（正常禁用 / 临时冲突重试 / autoFix 关闭 / 修复上限）。
- `test/broken-plugin.mjs`：故意在 apply 抛错的测试插件，可通过 patch 的 `insert` 行临时装载，验证端到端自动修复（实测通过：失败行被禁用并写入 `disabled: true`）。

## 实现细节

- **失败检测**：优先 `pluginManager.listPlugins()`（带 `readOnlyReason` 与 `fiberPhase`），拿不到时直读 `ctx.loader.entries()` 并按 `fiber.state` 映射阶段。
- **修复**：`pluginManager.setPluginEnabled(entryId, false)` —— 官方开关 API，写入 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 并触发 HMR 重组。
- **HMR 上下文坑**：本插件若在一次热重组中被挂载，apply 里创建的定时器会继承那次事务的 `AsyncLocalStorage` 上下文，`runExclusive` 会以 "HMR transactions cannot be nested" 拒绝修复。因此修复调用包在 `hmr.executing.exit(callback)` 里（临时清空事务上下文）；拿不到该字段时回退直接调用。此路径已在桌面实例实测通过。

## 局限

- 只看宿主侧 Loader 行；浏览器端模块加载失败、slot 层 UI 重叠不在本插件范围内。
- 若失败发生在宿主启动的极早期（Loader 树本身起不来），本插件同样无法启动——需要人工介入。
- 导入失败（模块不存在）通常不产生 `failed` fiber，只在 `dormant` 里出现；被 `dormant` 记录的模块需要人工检查模块名/依赖。

## 目录

```
lib/index.js       宿主侧插件实现
cordis.patch.yml   本 bundle 的插入行
test/smoke.mjs     假上下文冒烟测试
test/broken-plugin.mjs  端到端故障注入插件
```

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness provider for a copilot-api gateway
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-copilot-api

[Chinese](README.zh-CN.md)

DeepSeek Harness provider for a copilot-api gateway. Tested with Harness `0.2.1-rc.2`.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-copilot-api
```

Restart Harness after the first install. The package inserts entry `copilot-api-provider`. No profile configuration is required.

Defaults:

- `baseURL`: `http://localhost:4141` (with or without `/v1`)
- `protocol`: `openai-responses`
- credential reference: `GITHUB_COPILOT_API_KEY`

Save the key in the Models card with **Save API key**, in Harness credentials, or in the launch environment of that name. Configuration stores the reference name, not the key.

Use `anthropic-messages` as `protocol` for Messages.

## Change the connection

Override the inserted entry only when a default is wrong. Keep the id `copilot-api-provider`, and restate every connection field you still need:

```yaml
- id: copilot-api-provider
  config:
    baseURL: http://localhost:4141
    apiKey: GITHUB_COPILOT_API_KEY
    protocol: openai-responses
    modelRefreshInterval: 120000
```

`apiKey` is a credential reference. `apiKeyEnv` is the same kind of name; when both are set, they must match. `headers` can be set to custom request headers. `modelRefreshInterval` is in milliseconds and defaults to `120000` (automatic refresh every 2 minutes); set it to `0` to disable periodic refresh.

## From a checkout

```sh
cd /absolute/path/dsh-copilot-api
bun install
bun run build
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/dsh-copilot-api
```

Model mapping and overrides: [docs/models.md](docs/models.md). Headers and sessions: [docs/headers.md](docs/headers.md). Development: [docs/development.md](docs/development.md).

plugins.description: In-place selection translation for DeepSeek Harness — right-click selected text to replace it with Chinese, right-click again to restore the original. 右键划词翻译，再次右键还原。
plugins.readme_text:
# 划词翻译 · DSH Selection Translator

在 **DeepSeek Harness Web UI** 里选中文字后右键，菜单中除了「复制」还会多出「翻译成中文」。点击后，选中的英文会在原位置直接被中文替换；再次右键被翻译的文字，菜单变为「取消翻译」，点击即可还原原文。

![plugin icon](icon.svg)

## 功能

- 选中文字右键 → **复制 / 翻译成中文**
- 翻译结果**就地覆盖**选区，不弹窗、不新增消息
- 被翻译的片段带点状下划线，再次右键 → **取消翻译** 还原原文
- 中英混合选区会整体翻译成中文
- 菜单文案固定为中文（不跟随界面语言）

## 安装

发布到 npm 后，在 Harness 的插件管理器中安装：

```
dsh-selection-translator
```

本地开发时，克隆仓库后在插件管理器中从本地目录安装，或把该目录加为 profile 的依赖。

安装后会同时挂载 Harness 自带的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-translator`，用于提供匿名翻译服务，无需账号或 API Key。

## 使用

1. 在对话、工具输出或任意可选中的文本上拖选内容。
2. 在选区上点右键，选择「翻译成中文」。
3. 中文就地覆盖原文。
4. 对中文片段再次右键，选择「取消翻译」恢复原文。

## 隐私

选中的文本会离开本机，发往 Harness 的匿名翻译提供方（当前为 Microsoft Bing 的 Edge 翻译端点）。本插件自身不保存原文或译文，也不会随翻译请求发送会话 ID；翻译由 Harness 的 `translator` 服务完成，结果不落盘。

如果文本涉及敏感信息，请不要使用翻译功能。

## 已知限制

- 按段落/文本节点分别翻译，长文本会自动分段，翻译过程中菜单里显示进度条；极短片段（尤其是被行内代码切开的两段）译文可能不如整段通顺。
- 完整选中的段落会保留段落、标题、列表和行内代码/代码块；加粗、链接等不承载代码语义的内联样式会被拍平。
- 消息被 React 重新渲染（例如流式输出或切换会话）时，翻译片段可能丢失，原文会重新出现；重新翻译即可。
- 插件会插入 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-translator` 行；如果其他 bundle 也挂载了 translator，可能产生服务冲突。
- 百度翻译的公开接口需要 appid 和签名，本插件没有使用百度。

## 工作原理

- `client.js`：在 `shell.overlay` 槽位注册浮动菜单。Electron 桌面端的「复制」菜单由主进程生成，仅靠 DOM 的 `preventDefault()` 无法压制，因此右键按下时先保存选区再清空选区，让原生菜单没有可显示条目。
  - 完整选中的段落整段翻译，行内代码/代码块用占位符保留并原样放回；不完整的段落按文本节点逐段替换，保留原有 DOM 结构。
  - 长文本按 8 个片段一批发送，菜单里显示进度条；关闭菜单会取消进行中的翻译。
- `index.js`：Host 半注册同源路由 `POST /api/dsh/selection-translator`，调用 Harness 的 `translator` 服务把文本翻译成中文；超过 3500 字符的片段会自动切块翻译后拼接。
- `cordis.patch.yml`：同时挂载 translator 服务和本插件。

## 开发与发布

见 [PUBLISHING.md](PUBLISHING.md)；上架 DSH 插件市场见 [MARKET.md](MARKET.md)。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

# dsh-chat-wallpaper

给 DSH Web 的**聊天对话区**加一张背景图片，并且保证正文始终看得清：插件按当前主题自动校正亮度（曝光）和对比度，再按正文颜色反解出不透明度，使估算对比度不低于 4.5:1。

- 入口：侧边栏「设置 → 聊天背景」
- 只画在对话正文区：不覆盖消息气泡、输入框、侧边栏和标题栏
- 深浅主题自动适配，切换主题立刻重算
- 图片只存在本机 `localStorage`，不上传、不发网络请求

<!-- 待补：docs/setup.png（设置页）、docs/background.png（带背景的会话），补好后在这里引用 -->

## 安装

```sh
# 从 GitHub（推荐先这样试）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:wangjiaxi/dsh-chat-wallpaper

# 从本地目录（开发时用，link 方式，改文件即时生效）
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-chat-wallpaper

# 从 npm（发布之后）
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-chat-wallpaper@latest
```

装完刷新一次页面，`设置 → 聊天背景` 就会出现。

> 注意：包声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`，所以 `dsh plugin add` 会自动把它写进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，不需要手改 `cordis.patch.yml`。
>
> 在 Web UI 的插件页里安装时，`dsh-web` 进程的 `PATH` 里必须有 `pnpm`；如果报 `spawn pnpm ENOENT`，就用上面的命令行方式（在你自己 shell 里带好 `PATH`）装。

## 用法

1. 打开 `设置 → 聊天背景`
2. `选择图片`（PNG / JPEG / WebP，12MB 以内；超过 1800px 会先缩小再存）
3. 默认开着「自动校正」，五个滑杆显示的就是解出来的值
4. 觉得还差一点就关掉自动，自己调；页面会实时显示「估算正文对比度 x.x:1」
5. `清除背景` 一键回到默认

## 为什么不是「只调曝光」或「只调对比度」

影响阅读的不是某一个参数，而是**背景与文字的相对亮度**。插件因此分三层，朝同一个方向收敛：

| 参数 | 通俗叫法 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `brightness` | 曝光 | 把整张图的平均亮度移到当前主题底色附近，让壁纸和界面「响度」一致 |
| `contrast` | 对比度 | 压缩明暗跨度。壁纸只需要氛围，不需要满幅细节 |
| `opacity` | 不透明度 | 兜底：解出「最坏像素」仍满足 4.5:1 所需的最大不透明度 |
| `blur` / `saturate` | 模糊 / 饱和度 | 降低高频细节和高饱和色块对字迹的干扰 |

自动模式的算法：

1. 图片缩到 1800px 以内，取 72×72 采样算亮度直方图（`p01` / `p50` / `p99` / 均值），透明像素按「露出底色」跳过。
2. 从主题令牌 `--dsw-alias-bg-base`（底色）和 `--dsw-alias-label-primary`（正文色）**实时解析**真实的 WCAG 相对亮度——不写死深浅色，也不猜。
3. 用底色亮度解出 `brightness`，用目标跨度解出 `contrast`（只压不涨）。
4. 换算最坏像素（暗色主题取最亮、亮色主题取最暗），穿过 `brightness` + `contrast` 后反解不透明度上限，令估算对比度 ≥ 4.5:1，再留 8% 余量。
5. 主题切换由 `MutationObserver` 监听（比对解析出的颜色，不是比对类名），命中就重算重绘。

## 实现要点

- 背景画在 `[data-conversation-region="chat"]::before`：这是会话正文区的稳定 `data-` 属性，不依赖打包后的哈希类名。
- 该区域加 `isolation: isolate` 得到独立堆叠上下文，伪元素 `z-index: -1` 正好落在面板底色之上、所有消息行与文字之下；不碰布局，`pointer-events: none` 也不吃点击。
- 颜色全部走主题令牌，深浅主题一套代码。
- 一个 `<style data-dshwp-style>` 注入 + 一组 `--dshwp-*` 自定义属性；状态（图片 + 五个参数）写 `localStorage['dsh-chat-wallpaper/v1']`。
- Client 半边手写为 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`，**不需要构建步骤**，仓库里提交的就是运行产物。

## 目录

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | 清单：`dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client`（web 平台、`immediately`）+ 兼容性 `peerDependencies` |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 挂载一行 `chat-wallpaper` |
| `index.js` | Host 半边，空实现（功能全在浏览器端） |
| `client.js` | 设置页 + 样式 + 自动校正算法 |
| `scripts/validate.mjs` | 清单/补丁/导出/注册 id 的自检，可离线跑 |

## 兼容性

`peerDependencies` 里声明了三个 DSH Client 包（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots`、`dsh-client-locale`、`dsh-client-ui-conversation`），当前对应 **dsh 0.2.0-rc.2**。

DSH 在装载 bundle 时会用运行时版本校验这些 peer 范围；**不匹配会直接跳过整个 bundle**（不会报一堆错，只是插件静默不出现）。所以 DSH 升到 0.3 之前请一并更新这里：

```json
"peerDependencies": {
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale": "^0.3.0",
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots": "^0.3.0",
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation": "^0.3.0"
}
```

## 已知限制

- 依赖 `data-conversation-region="chat"`。如果上游改名，背景会**静默失效**（不报错）；`设置 → 聊天背景` 里有「已检测到聊天区域」提示，可以用来判断。
- 标题栏和输入框保持不透明，这是刻意的：可读性优先。
- 视觉与交互没有自动化测试（无浏览器环境），只做了清单、bundle 分发和插槽注册的验证。

## 开发

```sh
node --check client.js
node --check index.js
npm run validate        # 清单 / patch / exports / 注册 id
```

插件装成 `link:` 时，改 `client.js` 保存即可，页面侧 HMR 会重新拉取；改 `package.json` 的 `dsh.client` 段通常要重启 `dsh-web`。

## English

DSH Web plugin: an uploaded image as the conversation-area wallpaper. The image is auto-corrected for the active theme — brightness moves its mean luminance onto the theme surface, contrast compresses its range, and opacity is solved so the worst pixel still leaves 4.5:1 against the body text colour. Theme tokens only; no network, no upload, `localStorage` only. Hand-written client module, no build step. Requires `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots` / `dsh-client-locale` / `dsh-client-ui-conversation` peer `^0.2.0-rc.2`.

## 许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

[![](https://img.shields.io/badge/powered_by-dsh-4D6BFE?style=flat-square&logo=deepseek&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

# dsh-review-panel [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-0.2.1%2B-4B6BFB)](https://www.deepseek.com/download/) [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/sadgsk/dsh-review-panel/ci.yml?branch=main&label=CI)](https://github.com/sadgsk/dsh-review-panel/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[English](README.en.md) · [Issues](https://github.com/sadgsk/dsh-review-panel/issues) ![代码审查：完整源码 + 行级内联 diff](docs/images/review-panel.png) ## 这是什么 `dsh-review-panel` 把 **Cursor 式的代码审查体验**带进 DeepSeek Harness：在官方右侧栏里加一个只读的「代码审查」页，用完整源码 + 行级内联 diff 展示 Agent 本轮改了什么，并把常用的 **VS Code 快捷键操作**搬了过来。 DSH 自带的审查是一个个 hunk 片段；这个插件给的是**整个文件**——新增行整行着色，删除行按原行号内联显示，配合文件树、编辑器标签页和键盘操作，像在编辑器里 review 一样。 - **完整源码 + 行级内联 diff**：新增行整行着色，删除行内联保留原行号 - **三种对比基线**：`Agent 本轮` / `Git 未提交` / `仅代码`，一键切换 - **VS Code 式工作区**：文件树、编辑器标签页、Quick Open（Ctrl+P）、命令面板、工作区搜索 - **语言服务导航**：F12 跳转定义、Shift+F12 查找引用、悬停提示、文档大纲、只读诊断 - **只读安全**：不写文件、不提交 Git、不静默安装任何东西；需要操作时交给 DSH Agent - **自动跟随 DSH 明暗主题** ## 安装 需要 **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2** 或更高版本（Desktop 与 Web 均可）。Git 与语言服务器都是可选项，缺失时自动降级。 ### 1. 打开插件页 在 DSH 左侧栏打开 **插件**，点右上角的 **添加插件**： ![在插件页点击添加插件](docs/images/install-plugins-page.png) ### 2. 粘贴仓库地址并安装 在输入框里粘贴本仓库地址（`https://github.com/sadgsk/dsh-review-panel`），点 **安装**： ![添加插件对话框](docs/images/install-dialog.png) ### 3. 打开代码审查 安装完成后按提示重启 DSH。之后在右侧栏点 **+**，选择 **代码审查** 即可： ![在右侧栏 + 菜单里打开代码审查](docs/images/entry-plus-menu.png) 如果预览入口还没出现，也可以点击聊天输入框上方的「本轮修改」直接打开。 ## 快捷键 所有命令都注册在 DSH 官方快捷键服务里，可在 **设置 → 通用 → 键盘快捷键** 中重新绑定。macOS 上把 `Ctrl` 换成 `Cmd`；个别组合被系统占用时会显示为未绑定，此时可在设置里改绑。 | 操作 | Windows / Linux | macOS | | --- | --- | --- | | 打开代码审查 | `Ctrl+Alt+D` | `Cmd+Option+D` | | 上一处 / 下一处改动 | `Shift+F7` / `F7` | `Shift+F7` / `F7` | | 快速打开文件 | `Ctrl+P`（被占用时 `Ctrl+Alt+P`） | `Cmd+P`（被占用时 `Cmd+Option+P`） | | 命令面板 | `Ctrl+Shift+P` | `Cmd+Shift+P` | | 工作区搜索 | `Ctrl+Shift+F` | `Cmd+Shift+F` | | 跳转到行 | `Ctrl+G` | `Cmd+G` | | 下一个 / 上一个标签页 | `Ctrl+Tab` / `Ctrl+Shift+Tab` | `Cmd+Tab` / `Cmd+Shift+Tab` | | 关闭标签页 | `Ctrl+F4` | `Cmd+F4` | | 显示 / 隐藏文件树 | `Ctrl+Shift+E` | `Cmd+Shift+E` | | 文档大纲 | `Ctrl+Shift+O` | `Cmd+Shift+O` | | 编辑器内查找 | `Ctrl+F` | `Cmd+F` | | 跳转定义 | `F12` / `Ctrl+单击` | `F12` / `Cmd+单击` | | 查找引用 | `Shift+F12` | `Shift+F12` | | 折叠 / 展开代码块 | `Ctrl+Shift+[` / `Ctrl+Shift+]` | `Cmd+Option+[` / `Cmd+Option+]` | | 全部折叠 / 全部展开 | `Ctrl+K Ctrl+0` / `Ctrl+K Ctrl+J` | `Cmd+K Cmd+0` / `Cmd+K Cmd+J` | | 字号缩放 | `Ctrl+滚轮` / `Ctrl+=` / `Ctrl+-` / `Ctrl+0` | `Cmd+滚轮` / `Cmd+=` / `Cmd+-` / `Cmd+0` | 导航后退 / 前进默认不占用按键，可在设置里自行绑定。 ## 反馈 使用中遇到问题、有功能建议，或者想分享使用体验，欢迎提 [Issue](https://github.com/sadgsk/dsh-review-panel/issues)。 ## License 采用 [MIT](LICENSE) 许可。第三方组件与对应许可见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-powerbox

A power button for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) Web UI: one click in the conversation header opens a small dialog offering **Restart DSH** or **Quit DSH** — and each of those asks for confirmation again before anything happens.

**[中文说明 →](README.zh-CN.md)**

![Header power button](docs/screenshot-header.png)

The two-step flow — pick an action, then confirm it:

![Restart or quit, each behind a confirmation](docs/screenshot.png)

---

## Why

Restarting or quitting DSH normally means reaching for the tray icon / title bar and hunting through menus. That is awkward when the window is in the foreground and you are mid-session. This plugin puts both actions where you already are looking: the top-right of the conversation header.

Because both actions are destructive — restarting kills in-flight tool calls, quitting closes the app — the flow is deliberately two-step:

```
[⏻]  →  Choose an action  →  Restart DSH / Quit DSH
                            ↓
                         Confirm  →  act
```

`Cancel`, `Esc` and clicking the backdrop all exit without touching anything.

## Requirements

- DSH with the Web UI (`dsh --profile <name>`), version 0.2 or newer.
- A desktop shell that exposes `window.dshDesktop` for the power actions. In a plain browser the button renders **disabled** with an explanatory tooltip instead of half-working.
  - Restart calls `dshDesktop.boot.restart()`.
  - Quit calls `dshDesktop._call('win.close-force', {})`.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:AsterLuo/dsh-powerbox
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so the official CLI appends `dsh-powerbox` to `dsh.profile.bundles` on its own. **You do not need to edit `cordis.patch.yml` or `package.json` by hand.** Restart DSH (or reload the Web UI) and the button appears in the conversation header.

Using an older CLI that does not reconcile bundles? Then add the row manually to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: powerbox
      name: 'dsh-powerbox'
```

## Uninstall

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> remove dsh-powerbox
```

If you added the patch row by hand, delete it as well. Restart DSH afterwards.

## How it works

| Piece | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the plugin row into the composed profile (this is what makes it load). |
| `lib/index.js` | Host half. Intentionally a no-op — it only exists so the package is a valid bundle (the loader requires `name` + `apply`). |
| `lib/client.js` | Everything else: the header button, the mode dialog, both confirmation dialogs, and the bridge calls. |

The client half registers one entry in the `conversation.session.header.utilities` slot (a `list` slot, session scope — the same one the official *Open in app* action uses), which is what places the button at the right end of the conversation header.

- No build step. It is a hand-written `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` bundle, exactly like the built-in plugins.
- No runtime dependencies. `react` is provided by the host through the module loader.
- Styling uses only `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens, so it follows light and dark themes.

### Safety details

- The confirm button disables itself while the request is in flight, and a synchronous re-entry guard makes a second call impossible even if the click is dispatched programmatically.
- `Esc` closes the dialog — except while an action is running, so you cannot hide a restart you already triggered.
- Focus returns to the power button when the dialog closes.
- Failures are reported in the dialog with a retry path, never swallowed.

## Development

```bash
npm install
npm test        # node --test, jsdom-backed
npm run check   # syntax check both halves
```

The tests drive the real plugin bundle in a jsdom window with a recording `window.dshDesktop` stub. `react` is replaced by a small hook-compatible stub (see `test/harness.mjs`), because the real one is supplied by the host at runtime and is not a dependency of this package. Covered: slot registration contract, the full click-through of both flows, "no bridge call before the second confirmation", exactly-one-call, in-flight disabling, `Esc`, backdrop, focus restore, missing-bridge degradation, error surfacing, and the package/patch metadata that the installer relies on.

## License

MIT © AsterLuo

plugins.description: A GitHub repositories launcher for the DSH Web client, with mirror browsing and accelerated clone/download routes.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-github-mirror

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

A GitHub repository launcher panel for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) Web GUI. It puts a GitHub entry in the sidebar, lists your repositories, and opens them through a configurable mirror instead of `github.com`.

[中文说明](README.zh-CN.md)

## Features

- **Sidebar panel** — a GitHub icon in the DSH sidebar opens the repository browser.
- **Repository list** — reads up to 100 recently updated repositories and shows description, language, stars, update time, and private/fork/archived badges.
- **Mirror browsing** — repository links are rewritten to the selected mirror (`bgithub.xyz` by default). Also supports `gitclone.com`, official GitHub, or a custom mirror.
- **Mirror health check** — when the panel opens, it probes the selected browse mirror once. If the mirror is unreachable, links temporarily fall back to official GitHub and a banner explains what happened.
- **Accelerated clone/download** — `git clone` commands and zip downloads use a separate route (`ghfast.top` by default, `gh-proxy.com`, `gitclone.com`, or official).
- **Quick open** — paste `owner/repo`, `https://github.com/owner/repo`, `git@github.com:owner/repo.git`, or a mirror URL into the search box and press Enter.
- **Optional private repositories** — a read-only personal access token enables `/user/repos`, including private and organization repositories, and raises the API limit from 60 to 5,000 requests per hour.
- **Offline cache** — the last successful list is cached for 6 hours and remains visible when a refresh fails.

## Requirements

- A DSH build with client plugin support (tested with `0.2.1-rc.2`).
- Network access to `api.github.com`. If it is blocked, the panel automatically tries the `gh-proxy.com` API mirror for unauthenticated requests.
- No build step: `client.js` is the browser bundle.

## Install

### From the DSH Plugins page

1. Open **Settings → Plugins**.
2. Choose **Add plugin → Install a third-party plugin**.
3. Enter the Git address:

   ```text
   https://github.com/Jianmo-R/dsh-github-mirror
   ```

4. Enable the bundle and restart DSH if the host asks for a restart.

The plugin is installed into the active DSH profile. It does not require npm publishing.

### Manual install

Clone the repository somewhere stable, then add it to the profile as a linked package:

```jsonc
// <DSH_HOME>/profiles/<profile>/package.json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-github-mirror": "link:C:/path/to/dsh-github-mirror"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        "...",
        "dsh-github-mirror"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

Run `pnpm install` in the profile directory and restart DSH. The plugin's own `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the `github-mirror` Loader entry.

### From the CLI

If your DSH installation exposes the `dsh` CLI:

```bash
dsh plugin add https://github.com/Jianmo-R/dsh-github-mirror
```

## Usage

1. Click the GitHub icon in the DSH sidebar.
2. Enter a GitHub username on first use. Only a username is needed; do not paste an email or a full URL.
3. Public repositories work without logging in. For private repositories, open the gear menu and add a token with `repo` read access.
4. Use the two route selectors at the top of the panel:
   - **Browse via** rewrites repository and profile links.
   - **Clone / download** rewrites `git clone` and zip URLs.
5. Each repository row has three actions: copy clone command, download the default branch zip, and open in the selected mirror.

The username, routes, and cache are stored in the browser. The token is session-only unless **Remember the token** is checked.

## Routes

| Route | Used for | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bgithub.xyz` | Browse | GitHub-style web mirror; availability varies |
| `gitclone.com` | Browse / Git | Web mirror and clone acceleration |
| `ghfast.top` | Clone / downloads | Proxies `github.com` and `raw.githubusercontent.com` |
| `gh-proxy.com` | Clone / downloads / API | Also used as the unauthenticated API fallback |
| Official GitHub | Fallback | Direct connection |

Mirrors are third-party services and can change or disappear. Every route is selectable at runtime, and the settings dialog accepts custom mirror and acceleration prefixes, so no code change is needed when a mirror goes down.

## Privacy and security

- The username, route choices, and repository cache live in `localStorage`.
- The token is kept in `sessionStorage` by default and is written to `localStorage` only when **Remember the token** is enabled.
- The token is sent only to `https://api.github.com`. It is never forwarded to `gh-proxy.com` or any other mirror.
- The cache can contain private repository names and descriptions. **Clear local settings** removes it.
- The plugin opens links in the system browser; it does not proxy git traffic or store repositories locally.

## Limitations

- Only the first 100 repositories are read (sorted by recent update); there is no pagination yet.
- Without a token, `/users/:name/repos` returns public repositories owned by that account. Organization and collaborator repositories require a token and `/user/repos`.
- A mirror page is only as fresh as the mirror; it may lag behind GitHub.
- Fetched repository data comes from the GitHub REST API. The panel is a launcher, not a full GitHub client.

## Development

```text
client.js         Browser bundle (plain CJS factory registered with window.__ModuleLoader__)
index.js          Empty host half; gives the bundle a Loader entry
cordis.patch.yml  Inserts the github-mirror entry
package.json      DSH client declaration and package metadata
```

There is no bundler or build step. After editing `client.js`, DSH's client module system reloads it by file revision; refresh the page if needed.

Useful checks:

```bash
node --check client.js
node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('package.json','utf8'))"
```

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for the manual test checklist.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Real-time sandbox observability for DeepSeek Harness: latency, loss, errors, tokens, CPU and a live sandbox preview in the native right sidebar.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sandbox-monitor

**Real-time sandbox observability for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — latency, loss, errors and resource burn in the native right sidebar.**

A live dashboard plus a terminal-style sandbox preview, so you can see *what the sandbox is doing right now* instead of guessing from the chat transcript.

[中文说明](./README.zh-CN.md)

![Dashboard](docs/panel-dashboard.png)

![Options](docs/panel-options.png)

## Why

DSH runs tools inside a sandbox (PowerShell, file reads/writes, MCP calls, …). When something feels slow or fails silently, the chat only shows the final result. This plugin samples the tool pipeline and answers:

- How long do sandbox calls actually take? (avg / P95 / peak, 60 s sparkline)
- Are calls being blocked, cancelled or timing out? (loss rate)
- What is failing, and with which error code?
- How much are we spending? (tokens, bytes, CPU, memory)
- Which tools dominate the workload?
- What is running *right now*?

## Features

- **Sandbox preview** — a live console of the most recent calls: time, tool, command/path summary, duration, status. Plus the active sandbox mode, root directory, uptime and in-flight count.
- **14 selectable metrics** — add/remove cards at any time; the selection is persisted server-side.
- **Live event stream** — every call, with human-readable arguments (command, path, pattern), not just `ok`.
- **Tool distribution and error-code aggregation**.
- **Theme-native** — uses DSH design tokens, so light/dark and glass skins work out of the box.
- **Zero schema cost** — no LLM tool is registered, nothing is added to the system prompt. Sampling is passive.
- **Local only** — counters live in the host process; config lives in `~/.dsh/sandbox-monitor/config.json`. No network calls, no telemetry.

## Install

Requires a DSH build with the native right sidebar (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right`), tested on **0.2.0-rc.2**.

```bash
# recommended
dsh plugin --profile web add github:wuming295/dsh-sandbox-monitor

# or a release tarball
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/wuming295/dsh-sandbox-monitor/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-sandbox-monitor-0.1.0.tgz
```

Replace `web` with your profile name (e.g. `desktop`), then refresh the browser.

> An npm release is planned; until then install from GitHub or the release tarball above.

### From source / without the plugin manager

```bash
git clone https://github.com/wuming295/dsh-sandbox-monitor.git
cd dsh-sandbox-monitor
```

Point your local DSH loader at the folder (the super-injector path), or add it to a profile's `node_modules` and enable the bundle. There is **no build step** — `lib/` is the shipped JavaScript.

## Where to find it

- **First install** opens itself once, automatically.
- Afterwards: click the pulse icon at the bottom-left of the sidebar, or
- Right sidebar → `+` → **沙箱监视** (Sandbox Monitor).

The panel is session-independent: it shows the whole host, not just the current conversation.

## Metrics

| Metric | What it measures |
| --- | --- |
| Latency | Tool dispatch duration: avg / P50 / P95 / peak, plus a 60 s sparkline |
| Loss rate | Calls denied by policy, cancelled, or aborted/timeout |
| Errors | Failed tool calls + agent-level errors, with error-rate and error codes |
| In-flight | Sandbox calls executing right now |
| Call rate | Calls per minute over the sampling window |
| Tokens | Input/output tokens folded from `assistant/message` usage |
| Throughput | Argument + result bytes per second |
| Exec time | Cumulative dispatch time and average per call |
| CPU | Host process CPU (sum across cores) |
| Memory | Host process RSS / heap |
| Blocked | Policy denials, cancellations and approval rejections |
| Tool distribution | Calls, errors and average duration per tool |
| Error codes | Aggregated failure codes |
| Events | The live call stream |

### Options

Open the sliders button in the panel header:

- enable/disable any metric (8 of 14 on by default),
- set the polling interval (1 s / 1.5 s / 3 s / 5 s),
- reset the current counters.

## How it works

The host half is a passive sampler. It hooks:

- `tools/pre-execute` — policy decisions (deny/cancel)
- `tools/execute` — dispatch timing and in-flight tracking
- `tools/result` — errors, result size, final status
- `agent/error` — agent-level failures
- `session/event` — token usage from assistant messages
- `process.cpuUsage()` / `process.memoryUsage()` — host resources

Waterfall hooks always call `next()` and return the original decision/result unchanged.

The client half registers a tab type with `sidebarRightTabs`, mounts the panel on `sidebar.right.pane.tab`, and adds a footer button on `sidebar.footer.action`. It polls the host through a small JSON endpoint.

## HTTP API

```text
GET  /sandbox-monitor/api/snapshot
GET  /sandbox-monitor/api/health
POST /sandbox-monitor/api/config   { "enabled"?: string[], "refreshMs"?: number, "windowSec"?: number }
POST /sandbox-monitor/api/reset
```

## Configuration

`~/.dsh/sandbox-monitor/config.json`:

```json
{
  "enabled": ["latency", "loss", "errors", "inflight", "tokens", "cpu", "tools", "events"],
  "windowSec": 60,
  "refreshMs": 1500,
  "maxEvents": 40
}
```

## Compatibility

- DSH Web with the native right sidebar (`ui-sidebar-right`).
- Tested on DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` (Windows desktop build).
- Node.js ≥ 20.
- No bundler required; the client bundle is a plain `__ModuleLoader__` module.

## Development

```bash
git clone https://github.com/wuming295/dsh-sandbox-monitor.git
cd dsh-sandbox-monitor
npm run check      # syntax-check both halves
npm pack --dry-run # inspect the package contents
```

- `lib/index.js` — host: sampling, aggregation, HTTP routes, config persistence.
- `lib/client.js` — client: right-sidebar tab, cards, options page.
- `docs/` — screenshots.

PRs are welcome. Please keep both halves dependency-free and theme-token based.

# dsh-hover-sidebar

**DeepSeek Harness 左栏悬停展开，移开收起。** 手动打开的侧栏保持展开。

[English](README.en.md) · [发行版本](https://github.com/VanlxyG/dsh-hover-sidebar/releases) · [反馈问题](https://github.com/VanlxyG/dsh-hover-sidebar/issues)

零运行时依赖，无需构建，无安装脚本。插件通过 Harness 的 `layout.toggleSidebar()` 操作左栏；不修改宿主文件，不读取会话或凭据，不发送网络请求。

## 安装与开关

在官方桌面版 **设置 → 插件** 的添加插件入口，填入发行包地址：

```text
https://github.com/VanlxyG/dsh-hover-sidebar/releases/download/v0.2.0/dsh-hover-sidebar-0.2.0.tgz
```

也可以下载发行页中的 `.tgz`，在添加插件处选择本地包。安装后按宿主提示刷新页面或重启。

安装完成后，在 **设置 → 插件** 找到“侧边栏悬停展开”，使用旁边的开关启停。宿主会保存选择，并管理卸载。支持热卸载的宿主会即时清理监听、计时器和动画；宿主要求刷新时，刷新后完成启停。

Web 版可用 CLI：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/VanlxyG/dsh-hover-sidebar/releases/download/v0.2.0/dsh-hover-sidebar-0.2.0.tgz
```

桌面 profile 请使用桌面端自己的插件管理入口。**不要仅手工复制到 `node_modules`**：正式安装需要同时记录依赖、来源和 bundle；否则宿主重装依赖后可能丢包。

从旧手工版本迁移时，应先备份并删除用户 `cordis.patch.yml` 中旧的 `- insert: ... id: hover-sidebar / name: dsh-hover-sidebar` 登记块，再通过管理器安装，避免重复实例。保留其他插件和配置。

## 使用

| 操作 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 收起后，在窗口左边缘停留 120ms | 自动展开。桌面默认热区 12px；Web 版整个收起图标栏都有效 |
| 鼠标离开侧栏右边缘及 24px 缓冲区 | 300ms 后收起；返回侧栏取消收起 |
| 手动点击原生开关或使用宿主快捷键打开 | 固定展开，不自动关闭 |
| 手动收起时鼠标仍停在左缘 | 移出热区再回来才重新展开 |
| 在临时展开的侧栏里输入、使用键盘导航或菜单 | 保持展开，交互结束后重新判断 |
| 拖拽、调整栏宽、按住鼠标按钮 | 暂停自动触发 |
| 按 Escape | 收起临时展开的侧栏 |

仅处理鼠标和悬停笔事件，不用触摸手势触发。动画遵循系统“减少动态效果”设置。

## 兼容性

当前适配基线：官方 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 的布局契约。桌面收起宽度 0、Web 图标栏宽度 56 的交互与动画有独立浏览器验收。

宿主处于快速迭代阶段，[官方明确提示可能出现破坏性变更](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)。任何插件都无法保证永远不受更新影响。这里用以下措施减少维护成本：

- 无宿主内部模块导入、无锁定版本的 DSH peer 依赖、无 React 或打包器依赖。
- 只调用布局服务公开动作；DOM 适配集中在一个函数中，接受变化的 CSS 模块哈希。
- 侧栏 DOM 被热替换后自动重新绑定；无法识别布局或缺少能力时停止增强，不猜测其他按钮。
- 幂等卸载与单实例替换，禁用后不继续拦截事件或改变动画。
- 提交自动运行逻辑测试、打包检查和真实 Chromium 回归。

兼容宿主更新不等于阻止宿主删除或重置整个 profile。正式安装能让依赖管理器知道此包存在；整份 profile 被覆盖仍需从备份或发行包恢复。

## 调参

默认值适合直接使用。高级参数可在页面开发者工具设置；保存在当前浏览器源的本地存储，立即生效：

```js
__dshHoverSidebar.configure({ hotzonePx: 16, leaveDelayMs: 450 })
__dshHoverSidebar.setEnabled(false) // 当前浏览器的功能开关
__dshHoverSidebar.setEnabled(true)
__dshHoverSidebar.configure({}) // 恢复默认
__dshHoverSidebar.state()       // 诊断，不含会话或凭据信息
__dshHoverSidebar.stop()        // 卸载本次实例，下次刷新恢复
```

浏览器功能开关与宿主的包启用状态分别保存。需要跨重启、跨页面稳定停用时，使用宿主插件管理开关。随机端口的桌面源可能使浏览器参数在重启后回到默认。

| 参数 | 默认 | 允许范围 |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `hotzonePx` | 12 | 1–48px |
| `keepOpenMarginPx` | 24 | 0–80px |
| `openDelayMs` | 120 | 0–2000ms |
| `leaveDelayMs` | 300 | 0–5000ms |
| `animMs` / `closeAnimMs` | 260 / 200 | 0–1200ms |
| `railMaxPx` | 100 | 48–160px，用于识别收起图标栏 |
| `smooth` / `enabled` | true | 布尔值 |
| `easing` / `closeEasing` | 见源码 | 标准 easing 名称或合法 cubic-bezier |

## 开发与发布

Node.js 22 或更新版本，使用内置测试运行器。无需 `npm install`。

```sh
npm test
npm run check
npm run test:browser
npm run pack:release
```

浏览器测试自动启动隔离的无界面 Chrome / Edge，使用随机回环端口和临时用户目录；不接入日常浏览器，不读取 DSH 凭据。无法自动找到浏览器时，设置 `BROWSER_BIN` 为其可执行文件路径。测试产物在被忽略的 `artifacts/`，发行包及校验和在 `dist/`。

`main` 的 CI 全部通过后自动为新的 `package.json` 版本创建 GitHub Release，附 `.tgz` 和 `SHA256SUMS`；已存在的发行版本不覆盖。发布新版本时同步更新 `package.json`、`client.js` 中的版本号和安装示例，再维护 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

## 市场与安全

标准 bundle 可以由宿主管理。要在 dsh-market 的公开“发现”列表中搜到，还需要向 [awesome-dsh-plugin 社区目录](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)提交收录申请；[市场官方说明](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market#submit-your-plugin)明确由该目录维护列表。建仓或安装成功本身不表示已经收录。

见 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) 的边界与漏洞报告方式，见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) 的维护约定。MIT 许可证。
