plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-abacus（算盘） · DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 用量台账、账户余额与套餐监控插件 [English](README.en.md) | 中文

   

给 DSH Web GUI 与桌面客户端的 Token 用量台账、账户余额与编程套餐监控
侧边栏用量卡 · 本次对话明细 · 时间范围驱动的用量页 · 余额与套餐 · 余量提醒 · 历史补录

它把每一次模型调用的 token 用量记成一份按「本地日期 / 供应商 / 模型」分桶的账本，再把同一份数据放在三个地方显示：侧边栏左下角的用量卡、输入框下方那枚「本次对话」胶囊、设置里的「用量统计」页。除了用量，它还会查询供应商的账户余额与编程套餐剩余额度，并在余量偏低时标出提醒。 数据只有两个来源：DSH 自己的会话事件（用量）和供应商自己的接口（余额与套餐）。余额与套餐**不做任何本地估算** —— 查不到就写明原因，不猜一个数字出来。 > **为什么叫「算盘」**：账本本来就是一颗一颗珠子拨出来的累计数。而在一堆 `dsh-usage`、`dsh-usage-stat`、`dsh-token-*` 之间，「算盘」不会认错 —— 这个插件 2.0.0 之前叫 `dsh-usage-stat`，[迁移方法见下](#从-dsh-usage-stat-迁移)。 ## 界面 > 下面是 `tools/preview.mjs` 用**插件自己的组件**渲染出来的截图，不是应用截图：把样式表逐字注入，套在一个设置对话框外壳的替身里，颜色取自正在运行的 DSH 主题变量。主题色跟随皮肤变化，这里是原生主题。 | 位置 | 形态 | |---|---| | 侧边栏左下角 | 折叠时一行「今日用量 + 总量」，点开列出各供应商与模型；余量偏低时在对应供应商前点一个红点 | | 输入框下方 | 一枚「本次对话 N tokens」胶囊，点开是这段对话自己的分供应商、分模型明细 | | 设置 → 用量统计 | 四个标签页：用量、金额、账户、设置 |

        

点开可看原尺寸

## 功能 - **用量页**：一排等宽分栏的合计（总 tokens / 输入 / 输出 / 缓存读 / 调用次数，缓存写只在窗口内真的出现过时才占一格）、按供应商与模型的明细、以及覆盖整个所选窗口的每日柱状图。顶部可切换统计范围：今天、近 7 天、近 30 天、全部，或自选起止日期。所有卡片都跟随所选范围，供应商占比条全页共用一个刻度。 - **账户页**：每个供应商的账户余额与套餐窗口合在一处 —— 余额按币种显示，套餐显示 5 小时 / 本周 / 本月窗口的已用百分比与重置时间。查不到数据的供应商折叠在卡片最下面，并写明原因（未配置 API Key、已用账号登录、非官方地址、该供应商没有提供这项数据）。 - **金额页**：把所选窗口的 token 按价目表折算成金额，范围可以选全部、某个供应商、或某个供应商下的某个模型；单日窗口还会按小时折算。没有价格的模型不会被算成 0，而是单独列出来告诉你有多少 token 没计入。 - **设置页**：用量刷新间隔、账户查询开关与间隔、余量提醒阈值、价目表，以及底部的版本号与历史补录状态。 - **余量提醒**：给余额和三个套餐窗口各设一个阈值，低于阈值时在对应供应商旁点一个红点（左下角卡片与账户页都有）。阈值填 0 表示那一项不提醒。判定发生在读取时，所以改完立刻生效。 - **历史补录**：插件只记录它运行期间的用量。首次启用时会自动把 DSH 已经保存在磁盘上的过往会话补进来；中间关过插件的话，可以在设置页手动再补一次。补录按调用发生的那一天入账，不会算成今天。 ### 柱状图的纵轴 纵轴是**相对的**：所选窗口里用量最重的那天就是满格。绝对刻度会把安静的一周压成一条看不见的线，而相对刻度让你一眼看出形状；卡片右上角会写出这个锚点（例如「最高 33.3M（10-17）」），把鼠标停在柱子上能看到当天的总量与调用次数。 选中「今天」或某个具体日期时，这张图换成**每小时**：固定 24 列，空的小时不画柱子（没有记录和用量为零是两回事），峰值同样写在卡片右上角。多日窗口仍然是按天。 ### 金额是怎么算的 按**价目表的标准价**折算，不含任何折扣、套餐或中转站的加价 —— 它是一个参考值，不是账单。内置了 DeepSeek 官方两档模型的价格，其余模型可以在设置页里按「每百万 token 的输入、输出、缓存读、缓存写」自己添一行。 内置价是官方的**空闲时段**价；DeepSeek 在北京时间工作日 9:00-12:00、14:00-18:00 按两倍计费，周末与中国法定节假日全天按空闲价。插件按每次调用发生的时刻判断，所以同一个窗口里的高峰时段和空闲时段各按各的价算。 价格可以**带生效日期**：涨价就再加一行、填上新价生效的那天，旧价仍然管着它生效的那段历史。生效日期留空表示从最早算起。 改价格会**立刻改变它生效范围内所有已记录调用**的金额：金额是读取时按当前价目表算出来的，不写进账本，所以纠正一个价格就纠正了那段历史，而不是只影响以后。 内置价目表和节假日表会**自动更新**：每天读一次 DeepSeek 官方定价页，每月读一次节假日表，结果缓存在本机。读不到、或者页面改了版式认不出来，就继续用上一次拿到的（从没拿到过就用随插件内置的那份），不会因此把金额算错。 缓存写没有单独给价时按输入价计。没有价格的模型不参与合计，只报告「另有 N 个模型未定价，X tokens 未计入」—— 把未知价格当成 0 会让合计看起来像免费的，那比不给数字更糟。 ## 安装 要求 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 或更高，Web GUI 与官方桌面客户端都可以。 从 GitHub 安装： ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add git+https://github.com/SereneJi/dsh-abacus.git ``` 从本地克隆安装（源码即产物，改完刷新页面就生效，适合自己改）： ```bash git clone https://github.com/SereneJi/dsh-abacus.git dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:./dsh-abacus ``` `--profile` 填你在用的 profile 名（桌面客户端是 `desktop`，`dsh web` 一般是 `web`）。 宿主端改动需要重启一次 DSH；此后的界面改动刷新页面即可。设置入口在 **设置 → 用量统计**。 卸载： ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-abacus ``` ## 从 `dsh-usage-stat` 迁移 2.0.0 的改名不只是换了标题：**插件 id、HTTP 路由前缀、状态目录都跟着变了**（`usage-stat` → `abacus`），所以旧版本要先卸再装，不能就地升级： ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-usage-stat dsh plugin --profile desktop add git+https://github.com/SereneJi/dsh-abacus.git ``` 账本不会丢：第一次启动时如果 `$DSH_HOME/abacus/` 还不存在，插件会把旧目录 `$DSH_HOME/usage-stat/` 整个复制过来再开始记账，旧目录原样留着当备份（确认新界面里的历史都对，再自己删）。已经是新目录的不会被动 —— 不合并、不覆盖：两份账本挑一份合，比丢一份更糟。 旧版留在浏览器里的界面偏好（用量卡展开状态、上次选的统计范围）也会被一次性搬到新键上，键名是 `dsh-usage-stat.*` → `dsh-abacus.*`。 ## 配置 设置页里的每一项都对应 `$DSH_HOME/abacus/config.json` 里的一个键（`$DSH_HOME` 默认是 `~/.dsh`）。 | 键 | 默认 | 含义 | | --- | --- | --- | | `enabled` | `true` | 总开关；关掉后不记账、不探测、界面消失 | | `pollIntervalSec` | `60` | 界面刷新用量的间隔（5–600 秒） | | `probeEnabled` | `true` | 是否查询供应商余额与套餐 | | `probeIntervalSec` | `300` | 余额与套餐的查询间隔（60–3600 秒） | | `alertEnabled` | `true` | 余量提醒总开关 | | `alertBalanceBelow` | `0` | 余额低于这个金额时提醒；`0` 表示不提醒 | | `alertWindow5h` | `0` | 5 小时窗口剩余低于这个百分比时提醒；`0` 表示不提醒 | | `alertWindowWeek` | `0` | 本周窗口剩余低于这个百分比时提醒；`0` 表示不提醒 | | `alertWindowMonth` | `0` | 本月窗口剩余低于这个百分比时提醒；`0` 表示不提醒 | | `prices` | DeepSeek 官方两档（空闲价） | 价目表；键是模型名，值是每百万 token 的 `input` / `output` / `cacheRead` / `cacheWrite`（CNY）。同一个模型可以给多行，每行带一个 `from` 生效日期 | 价目表也可以直接写在配置文件里，格式与设置页里的文本一致： ```json "prices": { "deepseek-flash": { "input": 2, "output": 8, "cacheRead": 0.04, "cacheWrite": 2 } } ``` `deepseek-v4.1-flash`、`deepseek-v4-flash` 这类带版本或后缀的名字会自动归到内置的 `deepseek-flash` 一行，所以官方改小版本号不会让价格突然消失。 记账是本地且廉价的，查询供应商要出门、可能被限流，所以两者有各自独立的开关和周期：关掉 `probeEnabled` 之后用量照常统计，只是余额与套餐不再刷新。 提醒判定用的是「**低于**」：余额刚好等于阈值、或窗口刚好还剩阈值那么多，都**不算**命中。提醒也只在真的有数字可读时出现 —— 没有凭据、查不到余额、窗口没有百分比的供应商不会被点红点。 超出范围的值会被夹到边界，不认识的键会被忽略，手改文件不会把插件弄进界面表达不出的状态。 ## 数据放在哪 | 路径 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | `$DSH_HOME/abacus/usage.json` | 用量账本 | | `$DSH_HOME/abacus/providers.json` | 余额与套餐快照 | | `$DSH_HOME/abacus/upstream.json` | 抓到的价目表与节假日表（抓不到就用内置的） | | `$DSH_HOME/abacus/config.json` | 配置 | 账本**刻意不设时间与体积上限**。一天一个日期桶在 1 KB 量级，一年也就几百 KB，而任何「只保留 N 天」「超过 N KB 就删」的规则都只会在某一天悄悄丢掉你本来看得到的历史。唯一剩下的上限是会话行的条数（5000），那是防止文件被跑坏的兜底，不是预算。 供应商的 API Key 由 DSH 自己的凭据服务保管，只被宿主端读取，**不会进入浏览器**。 ## 已知限制 - **历史补录只能补回 DSH 日志还在的会话**：日志被删掉的、或在别的工作区里已经清掉的，补不回来。没有序号的事件会被跳过 —— 一个无法与已计过的调用区分开的事件，宁可漏记也不重复计数。补录是一次性的书签，不是持续订阅：日志在插件运行期间仍在增长，那部分由实时事件负责。 - **余额与套餐只覆盖已知端点的供应商**（余额 9 条路由、套餐 8 条）。其余供应商会写「该供应商没有提供这项数据」，不会用本地 token 数折算成钱。 - **余额需要能读到的 API Key**。用账号登录的供应商（例如桌面端的 DeepSeek 账号）不一定提供开放平台的余额接口，界面会如实说明。 - **金额是标准价折算，不是账单**：不含折扣、套餐与中转站的加价。内置价是官方**空闲时段**价，工作日 9:00-12:00 与 14:00-18:00 按两倍计；峰谷判定用**本机时区**，法定节假日表来自公开日历，国务院尚未公布的年份按普通工作日算。缓存写没有单独给价时按 0 计，没有价格的模型只报告、不计入合计。 - **图表最多回溯 366 天**：`全部` 或跨年窗口里，每日柱状图只画最近 366 天，轴上的日期只到月-日，所以更早的部分既看不到也不显示。 - **余量提醒是界面上的标记，不是系统通知**：它只出现在左下角卡片与账户页，不会弹窗、不发声。 - **「本次对话」的分供应商明细只对启用之后的对话有效**：更早的对话只留下总量，这时面板会写明「只有总量记录」，而不是把总量算到某个供应商头上。 - **界面文案是插件自带的 zh/en 两套**，按浏览器语言选一次，不跟随 DSH 设置里切换语言。 - 侧边栏卡片依赖 DSH 侧边栏的 DOM 结构，落位失败会退化成「追加到侧边栏底部」，不会崩 —— 这是 DOM 注入的固有代价。 ## 许可证与来源 MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。 界面布局的灵感来自 [`@linxin666/dsh-usage`](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web)（Apache-2.0）。 ## 开发 面向维护者的内容 —— 数据来源与折叠语义、HTTP 接口、代码结构、设计取舍、测试与预览台、回退与升级路径 —— 都在 [DEVELOPMENT.md](DEVELOPMENT.md)。

plugins.description: DSH plugin orchestration and workspace-isolation manager: plugin scanning, per-workspace isolated instances, and a standalone rescue entry.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-workspace-orchestrator

**按工作区隔离插件、诊断冲突、并在 DSH 崩溃时自救。**

DSH 插件编排与工作区隔离管理器：插件清单、冲突扫描、按工作区禁用插件（黑名单）、
独立的多开隔离实例，以及一个完全不依赖 DSH 进程的急救工具。

## 安装

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-workspace-orchestrator
```

装完**托盘彻底退出 DSH 再启动**（不是关窗口）。

## 三个核心能力

### 1. 工作区插件黑名单（设置 → 工作区编排）

插件默认全开——原生面板怎么开就怎么来。这个面板只负责**局部禁用**：

- 顶部下拉框自动读取 DSH 左侧栏的工作区列表
- 下方列出所有第三方插件，**默认全部打勾**
- **取消勾选 = 在这个工作区禁用该插件**
- 切换工作区，勾选状态随之切换

写入 `$DSH_HOME/workspace-orchestrator/single-mode.json`：

```json
{ "version": 2, "workspaces": { "D:/my-project": { "disabledPlugins": ["dsh-novel-writer"] } } }
```

真正生效在**新建会话**时：进入某工作区，黑名单里的插件被卸载，其余恢复。
离开该工作区会自动还原。

> 带界面的双端插件（如 `dsh-webds-bridge`）后端被卸载后，**页面上的入口要刷新
> （`Ctrl+Shift+R`）才消失**——client 代码已经加载进浏览器了，后端管不到。

### 2. 隔离实例（多开）

面板里的「在此工作区开启隔离实例」，或对 Agent 说「在 `D:\code` 开一个隔离实例」。
独立 profile、独立会话与存储、OS 分配的端口。同样遵守该工作区的黑名单。

### 3. 急救工具

DSH 起不来时**不依赖 DSH**：

```bat
bin\rescue.bat --web        :: 打开独立急救网页面板（127.0.0.1:8765）
bin\rescue.bat desktop --disable <插件id>   :: 命令行禁用坏插件
```

急救面板可以列出插件、把插件**可逆地**移出 `node_modules` 并写入 `disabled: true`，
也支持 bundle 插件（无文件夹可移时改为改配置）。所有改动先备份，可一键恢复。

## Agent 工具

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `scan_plugins` | 列出当前 profile 的第三方插件 |
| `scan_conflicts` | 静态冲突扫描（重复 id / 重复包 / 重复 service / 循环依赖 / 缺依赖） |
| `manage_workspace_scope` | 读写工作区黑名单 |
| `launch/list/stop_workspace_instance` | 隔离实例的生死管理 |
| `debug_single_mode` | 诊断黑名单：报告每行的 `fiber` 是 ACTIVE 还是已卸载 |

直接说「调用 debug_single_mode」即可，它会给出结论，例如
「dsh-webds-bridge：已禁用，fiber 已卸载 —— 单开模式工作正常」。

## 排障

**插件禁用了还在跑？** 调用 `debug_single_mode` 看 `fiber` 列：

- `NONE` = 后端已卸载，你看到的是前端残留 → 刷新页面
- `ACTIVE` = 没禁用成功 → 看下面的调试日志

**开调试日志**（默认关闭）：

```powershell
# 方式一：环境变量后重启
setx DSH_ORCH_DEBUG 1

# 方式二：运行时开启（立即生效）
curl.exe -X POST -H "content-type: application/json" -d "{\"enabled\":true}" `
  "http://127.0.0.1:<端口>/workspace-orchestrator/api/scope/debug"
```

日志写入 `$DSH_HOME/workspace-orchestrator/debug.log`，含实际 cwd、`pathKey`、
匹配到的黑名单、每行的 `fiber` 前后状态。

## 离线自测

```powershell
node lib/orchestrator-core/verify-context-access.mjs
node lib/orchestrator-core/verify-rescue-web.mjs  --home D:\tmp\dsh-test
node lib/orchestrator-core/verify-scope-rpc.mjs   --home D:\tmp\dsh-test
node lib/orchestrator-core/verify-blacklist.mjs   --home D:\tmp\dsh-test
```

共 158 项检查，**拒绝在真实 `~/.dsh` 上运行**。

## 兼容性

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| DSH 运行时 | `0.2.1-rc.2`（本版本实测） |
| Node | `>= 22.19.0` |
| 前端 | DSH Web / 桌面端共用同一套设置面板 |
| 平台 | Windows 优先（路径规范化、急救 `.bat`）；其余平台未实测 |

## 设计约束

- **零第三方依赖，零 `@deepseek-ai/*` import**——框架能力只通过 `ctx` 获取
- **`apply()` 永不抛错**：任何失败都记录并降级，插件不会是 profile 启动失败的原因
- **绝不写回 profile patch**（除急救工具的显式动作）：黑名单只改内存与自己的映射文件

## What exists today

| Piece | State |
|---|---|
| Bundle patch `cordis.patch.yml` inserting loader row `dsh-workspace-orchestrator` | done |
| `apply(ctx)` — registers seven tools, zero throwing IO, never fails a boot | done |
| `scan_plugins` — third-party plugin inventory **+ live isolated-instance summary** | done |
| `launch_workspace_instance` — one-shot profile, isolated sessions/storages, OS-assigned port | done |
| `list_workspace_instances` — registry + process/port liveness | done |
| `stop_workspace_instance` — by pid / profile name / workspace path | done |
| `lib/orchestrator-core/` — profile & patch orchestration, instance registry, rescue mode | done |
| `bin/rescue.mjs` + `bin/rescue.bat` — standalone rescue (no DSH process needed) | done |
| `bin/rescue.mjs --web` — standalone rescue **web panel** with reversible disable/restore | done |
| Bundle-level rescue (`dsh.profile.bundles`): 仅禁用 / 彻底移除 / 恢复 | done |
| Workspace blacklist (settings panel + `manage_workspace_scope`) | done |
| Conflict scan (`lib/conflict-scan.mjs`, `scan_conflicts` tool + settings panel) | done |
| `debug_single_mode` — live fiber state diagnosis | done |
| Version rollback | **not yet** |

Everything instance-related lives in `lib/orchestrator-core/`; the tools are thin bridges that
translate arguments and render results, so there is exactly one implementation of the behaviour.

## Compatibility

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| DSH runtime verified against | `0.2.0-rc.2` (desktop app build `04f392c9ddd144fa426da2045178797da6db6c11`) |
| Electron / Node host | Electron `44.0.0`, Node `24.18.1` |
| `@deepseek-ai/cordis` | `4.0.4` |
| Declared in `package.json` | `dsh.compatibleRuntime: "0.2.0-rc.2"` |

## Engineering contract

- **No `@deepseek-ai/*` import.** Framework capabilities are reached through `ctx`
  (`ctx.tools`, `ctx.logger`). The tool is registered as a plain definition object, so
  `defineTool` is not needed; `lib/patch-yaml.js` and `lib/profile.js` are dependency-free
  and import only `node:` builtins.
- **`apply(ctx)` never throws and performs no IO.** It registers one tool and returns. Every
  failure path logs and degrades. Scanning happens inside `execute`.
- **No HTTP routes.** When one is added it will use the `/plugin-orchestrator/` prefix and
  degrade on conflict.
- **Unique entry id.** `dsh-workspace-orchestrator`; the tool name `scan_plugins` is
  likewise unique (the registry rejects duplicates, which is verified).
- **Read-only.** Stage 1 writes nothing anywhere.

## `scan_plugins`

Reads, in order:

1. `<profile>/package.json` → `dsh.profile.bundles` (the ordered bundle selection) and
   `dependencies` (what is actually installed).
2. `<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` → the user's patch layer: `insert` rows add loader entries,
   id-targeted rows override or disable them.
3. `ctx.get('pluginManager')` → optional. When the official manager service is mounted it
   supplies the runtime version and per-bundle load state. Its absence degrades fields to
   `null`; it never errors.

Returns, per third-party plugin: loader-entry `id`, package `name`, `version`, effective
`enabled`, and the `source` row that produced it (`bundle` / `patch-insert` / `dependency` /
`patch-override`). Bundles under `@deepseek-ai/*` are filtered out and only counted.

### The profile directory

Finding the *active* profile from inside the host process is the subtle part. `DSH_PROFILE_DIR`
and `DSH_PROFILE` are injected into **tool subprocess** environments and may be absent in the
host, so they are only the first guess. Candidates are tried in order
(`env:DSH_PROFILE_DIR` → the launcher's own `--profile` / positional argv → `hmr.baseDir` →`env:DSH_PROFILE` → walk-up from this module) and each is **validated structurally**: a real
profile directory has a `package.json` with a `dsh.profile` field. An unresolved profile is
reported as such rather than guessed.

## Installing

The Desktop profile is owned by the Electron application, so the CLI refuses to boot or
`--dump-config` it; plugin installation, however, is supported:

```
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-workspace-orchestrator
```

For any other profile, list the package in `dsh.profile.bundles` (or load
`cordis.patch.yml` as a `--patch` overlay):

```
dsh --profile <name> --patch <this-dir>/cordis.patch.yml
```

## Layout

```
index.js              apply(ctx), the scan_plugins definition, and its renderer
lib/profile.js        profile-directory discovery and structural validation
lib/patch-yaml.js     dependency-free reader for cordis.patch.yml
lib/scan.js           the inventory: sources, resolution, merge, report
cordis.patch.yml      bundle patch inserting the loader row
```

## Known limitation

`lib/patch-yaml.js` is not a general YAML parser. It reads exactly the patch layer's shape and
skips `config:` blocks wholesale (a row's config is arbitrary deployment data — the desktop
profile's `llm-pi-ai` row holds a ~230-line nested provider map). Flow collections, block
scalars, anchors/aliases and multi-document files are reported as diagnostics rather than
silently misread.

## 六个工具与极简用法

| Tool | 一句话 | 自然语言示例 |
|---|---|---|
| `scan_plugins` | 列出当前 profile 的第三方插件 + 已开实例 | 「看看我现在装了哪些第三方插件？」 |
| `scan_conflicts` | 静态冲突扫描（重复 id / 重复包 / 重复 service / 环 / 缺依赖） | 「扫一下当前 profile 有没有插件冲突。」 |
| `manage_workspace_scope` | 读写「工作区 → 禁用黑名单」 | 「在 `D:\novels` 禁用 `dsh-novel-writer`。」 |
| `launch_workspace_instance` | 为工作区拉起隔离实例，返回 URL | 「在 `D:\code` 开一个隔离实例。」 |
| `list_workspace_instances` | 列出本管理器拉起的实例并探活 | 「现在开着几个隔

plugins.description: Select text anywhere in a DSH conversation, attach a note to it, and send the whole annotation batch together with the next message.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-context-annotations

[![DSH Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-4D6BFE)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%E2%89%A5%200.1.7--rc.2-4D6BFE)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE)

**English** · [中文](README.zh.md)

A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web GUI plugin: select any text in the conversation,
write a note about it, and let the whole batch ride along with your next message
— for that one round only.

This repository carries the [`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) topic, which the DeepSeek Harness documentation requires of plugin repositories so they can be discovered; the link above is the inline, clickable form of that requirement.

## What it does

1. **Select → annotate.** Select text anywhere in the conversation (a reply, a
   tool card, your own message), and a floating **注释** button appears beside the
   selection. Click it, type the note, press **Enter**. Shift+Enter breaks the
   line, Escape cancels.
2. **Collect several.** Every saved note becomes a numbered marker at the left
   edge of the passage it is about — **hovering a marker shows that note** — and a
   **N 条注释** strip appears above the composer. Click the strip to open the
   pending batch, where each annotation shows its quoted passage and note with
   edit and delete actions. Clicking a marker opens that note's editor, with a
   delete button.
3. **Send together.** Your message gains one short **“💬 N 条注释”** bubble; the
   annotation text never appears in the conversation. **Hover that bubble** to see
   exactly which passages the batch quoted and what each note says. The list
   reaches the model as a system-prompt section, so the request still carries
   every quoted passage and note. The batch is consumed once and its markers stay
   in the transcript, dimmed.
4. **Send alone.** With an empty composer, the strip's send button starts a round
   from the annotations alone.

## How it works

The browser half owns the editing UI; the Host half owns delivery.

- The browser posts the complete batch to `/api/dsh-context-annotations`
  (a route registered through `ctx.connection.fetch`, behind the carrier's trust
  fence). It never writes into the draft.
- The Host keeps that batch per Session and listens on the `agent/pre-step`
  waterfall. `pre-step` hands over exactly the messages the step claimed — never
  replayed history — so a batch can only ride one round. When the step carries a
  `source.kind === "user"` message, the Host appends one extra message that holds
  only the marker (`💬 N 条注释`) and leaves the human message byte-for-byte
  unchanged.
- The annotation text does not travel in a message: `ctx.systemPrompt.section()`
  contributes it to the prompt, and the rendered prompt is logged as a hidden
  `system/message` node. The conversation therefore shows one short bubble while
  the request carries the full list; both are reconstructable from the log, and
  no plugin event type is invented.
- The marker message is written before the step records its messages, so it is
  part of an ordinary `user/message` record, and the prompt is likewise
  reconstructable from the log. By design, fork, resume and replay should
  reproduce the conversation the model saw; no plugin event type is invented.
- An empty composer cannot submit on its own, so the strip's send button writes a
  zero-width draft; that round is one empty human message plus the marker.
- The batch outlives only the turn it rode: `pre-step` marks it consumed (the
  browser then clears the strip) and that turn's `turn/end` retires it from the
  prompt, so a later round never inherits it. A batch that no round consumed is
  left pending instead — a note written while the model is still answering waits
  for your next message rather than vanishing with that turn.
- After a send the browser reconciles with one cheap request: the Host states
  `consumed` explicitly, which marks the local annotations sent (the strip
  collapses and the markers stay, dimmed). The same request adopts a still-pending
  batch after a page reload.

## What the conversation shows vs what the model receives

The conversation gains exactly one short message:

```
💬 2 条注释
```

The model receives the list as a system-prompt section:

```
1. 所选文本：
<the selected passage>
注释：<your note>

2. 所选文本：
<the selected passage>
注释：<your note>
```

## Files

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | Host half: batch store, `/api/dsh-context-annotations`, `agent/pre-step` fold |
| `lib/client.js` | Browser half: selection button, note editor, numbered markers, composer strip and panel |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Insert the plugin row into the profile |
| `locale/{zh,en}.json` | Plugin Manager title and description |
| `test/smoke.mjs` | Dependency-free test of the fold semantics and the browser bundle's registration |
| `test/client.mjs` | Regression test for the browser store: per-Session push, explicit consumption, editor identity, composer exclusion |

## Configuration

The bundle currently reads no configuration. The folded list carries no marker
line, so it reads as the user's own numbered notes rather than a plugin block.

## Install

Installed from this repository:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle  target="github:YubaiLoving/dsh-context-annotations"
```

Or from a local checkout of this directory:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle  (target: this directory)
```

## Limits

- Markers key on character offsets into the flattened conversation text and are
  validated against the recorded passage; when that offset no longer matches (the
  content above the passage changed), a whitespace-insensitive passage search
  takes over, disambiguated by the passage's occurrence ordinal. There is no DOM
  path fallback. A passage that is re-rendered with different wording loses its
  marker; the note itself stays in the strip and is still sent. Markers that
  would land on the same box are nudged upwards so they do not stack.
- Annotations live in Host memory per Session. A Host restart drops a pending
  batch (the browser adopts only what the Host still holds).
- The float, strip, and panel read documented `data-*` markers of the shipped
  conversation shell (`[data-conversation-content]`, `[data-composer-seat]`,
  `[data-composer-card]`) and the browser's own selection. No other plugin's DOM
  is modified.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: MT 管理器 MCP 连接 DeepSeek Harness：在设置页填写手机的 MCP 地址，手机文件 / APK / ZIP 能力即以 mcp__mt__* 工具可用，地址随时可改、无需重启。安装：dsh plugin --profile web add github:aikunx/dsh-mt-mcp
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mt-mcp [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/powered_by-dsh-4D6BFE?style=flat-square&logo=deepseek&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) ![DSH plugin 0.1.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH_plugin-0.1.0-4D6BFE?style=flat-square&logo=deepseek&logoColor=white) ![MCP Streamable HTTP](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP-Streamable_HTTP-blueviolet?style=flat-square) ![deps 0](https://img.shields.io/badge/deps-0-brightgreen?style=flat-square) ![MT Manager Android](https://img.shields.io/badge/MT_Manager-Android-3DDC84?style=flat-square&logo=android&logoColor=white) ![license MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green?style=flat-square) ## 安装 ```bash # 从 npm 安装（推荐） dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mt-mcp # 或从 GitHub 源码安装 dsh plugin --profile web add github:aikunx/dsh-mt-mcp ``` 桌面端把 `web` 换成 `desktop`。装完**重启 DSH**、刷新页面，进入 **设置 → MT 管理器** 填写手机地址即可。 连接手机上的 **MT 管理器**（[mt.cc](https://mt.cc)）与 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）** · Connect **MT Manager** ([mt.cc](https://mt.cc)) on your Android phone to **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**. > 本页默认显示**简体中文**。英文版在下方折叠区，点开即在当前页面展开，不会跳转。 > > This page shows **简体中文** by default. The English version is collapsed below — expand it in place, without leaving this page.
English version（点击展开 / click to expand）
Connect **MT Manager** ([mt.cc](https://mt.cc)) on your Android phone to **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**. MT Manager ships an MCP server: start it on the phone and it becomes a **Streamable HTTP** MCP endpoint exposing phone files, APK, and ZIP capabilities. This plugin is the **desktop-side client** — a DSH plugin bundle that brings MT's tools into DSH sessions and adds a settings panel where the address can be changed at any time. Once connected, MT's capabilities appear as `mcp__mt__*` tools, so you can just ask in plain language: ``` Read test.txt in MT's Home folder and summarize it. Don't modify anything yet. Analyze the startup flow of the current APK and explain the relevant classes and methods. Pack the project folder in Home into project.zip at the archive root. ``` ### Why this exists DSH's built-in MCP client (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`) is configured through the composition: changing the endpoint means editing a profile patch file and restarting the Host. But a phone's LAN IP **changes** — DHCP lease renewal, a different Wi-Fi, a hotspot. This plugin moves "where to connect" out of configuration files and into the Web settings page: type the address, save, and it reconnects. No restart, no YAML. ### Install Requires a working DSH (`dsh web` opens the UI). **Compatible with DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` and later** (`0.2.x`). The plugin has **no runtime third-party dependencies**: the MCP protocol is implemented in `lib/mcp-http.js` using Node's built-in `fetch`, and the only import is DSH's own `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`. Any install method works, and `pnpm install` is never needed. #### One-line install (recommended) ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add github:aikunx/dsh-mt-mcp ``` Then **refresh the Web page once** — a newly installed client plugin has to be reloaded. "MT Manager" then appears in the settings sidebar. > Using a different profile? Replace `web`. The Electron-managed `desktop` profile is handled by the app itself and does not go through this command. > > `dsh plugin` forwards its arguments to pnpm verbatim, so any pnpm-supported spec works. To pin a commit: > `dsh plugin --profile web add github:aikunx/dsh-mt-mcp#` #### Install from the plugin market Add this index URL to the Plugins settings page, then install from the Discover tab: ``` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aikunx/dsh-mt-mcp/main/market.json ``` #### Local development ```bash git clone https://github.com/aikunx/dsh-mt-mcp.git cd dsh-mt-mcp dsh plugin --profile web add . ``` No dependency install needed. Alternatively, have the Agent driving your session call `plugin_manager(action: "install_bundle", target: "")`. > If the plugin row reports `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` with a path pointing at a **previous** install location, the Host process cached the old module resolution — restart DSH. ### The panel ![The "MT Manager" panel in DSH settings](docs/settings-panel.png) Settings → MT Manager: enter the address and an optional token, then save to connect. The panel lists discovered tools and shows the config file path. > The image is drawn from the panel source's layout and sizing, to convey the information structure. Actual appearance follows your DSH theme (light/dark). ### Usage 1. On the phone: MT Manager → **sidebar → Tools → MCP Service → Start**. 2. Copy the address MT shows. DSH runs on your computer, so use the **LAN address**, e.g. `http://192.168.5.20:8787/mcp`. - The trailing `/mcp` is required; the default port is `8787`. - **Do not use `127.0.0.1`** — that points at the computer itself, not the phone. 3. In DSH: **Settings → MT Manager**, paste the address, then "Save and connect". 4. A green status line means connected, and the panel lists the discovered tools (measured: MT 2.26.x exposes **57**). #### The address changes; edit it any time Edit the address in the panel and save — **no DSH restart needed**. It reconnects immediately and replaces both the old connection and the registered tools. Set a **static IP / DHCP reservation** for the phone on your router to avoid editing it at all. #### Bearer token (optional) MT has authentication **off** by default: anyone who can reach the port can call it. Enable Bearer token auth under MT's **Settings → Authentication**, then paste the token into the panel's token field: - The token is created by MT; it is unrelated to any model API key. - Leaving the field empty keeps the current token; only "Clear token" removes it. - It is echoed only as `abcd****wxyz` — the full token never appears in any output. - Authentication does **not** encrypt HTTP. Use it on a trusted LAN only, and **never expose port 8787 to the internet**. ### What it can do The tools come from MT; this plugin only forwards them. Three groups by name: | Prefix | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `mcp__mt__mt_file_*` | Phone files: list directories, search by name/content/size/time, read and write text and bytes, move and delete, create directories | | `mcp__mt__mt_apk_*` | APK: open a workspace, analyze manifest/resources/smali/so, edit, rebuild and sign, manage workspaces | | `mcp__mt__mt_zip_*` | ZIP: browse, read entries, verify integrity, create, add/replace/delete entries, extract | Plus two helper tools from this plugin: | Tool | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `mt_mcp_status` | Show address, connection state, tool count, last error (never echoes the token) | | `mt_mcp_connect` | Reconnect using the saved address | #### The phone decides the access scope Which files are reachable is **entirely decided by MT's file access rules**; this plugin offers no bypass. The measured default is "the Home folder is read-write, everything else is denied": - Home defaults to `/storage/emulated/0/MT2/mcp` (changeable in MT's **Settings → General**). - To read outside Home, add a rule for that directory in MT's **Settings → Files**. - Files inside Home **cannot** be tightened to read-only; put files needing read-only protection outside Home and grant them individually. Only you can change these rules, on the phone. ### Disconnects and reconnects - On disconnect it retries with **1s → 2s → 4s … 30s** backoff, up to 10 attempts. After that, press "Reconnect" in the panel. - Android may kill MT in the background. Enable **floating ball** in MT's **Settings → General** and grant the overlay permission; this markedly improves survival. - Restarting MT's service or the phone changing IP will drop the connection. Edit the address and save, or press "Reconnect". - Phone and computer must be on the **same LAN**. Guest Wi-Fi, AP isolation, and VPNs can all prevent connection. ### Security boundary | Item | Detail | | --- | --- | | Config storage | `~/.dsh/dsh-mt-mcp.json`, mode `0600` | | Settings routes | `/api/dsh-mt-mcp/*` accepts **loopback requests only** (verified via source IP, Host header, O

plugins.description: Soft pink bow-kitty theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: kitty-print wallpaper, light and dark palettes, kitty mascots.
plugins.readme_text:
# Pink Bow Kitty

A soft, simple pink theme for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).
一个粉嫩、简洁的 DeepSeek Harness 主题。

![Pink Bow Kitty wallpaper](assets/kitty-pattern.svg)

## About / 关于

**English.** Pink Bow Kitty is a soft, simple pink theme for DeepSeek Harness. It keeps the interface quiet and uncluttered: a hand-drawn kitty-print wallpaper, a gentle pink palette in both light and dark, and two small bow-wearing kitty mascots. There are no extra panels, no configuration, and no workflow changes — just a softer, friendlier Harness.

**中文。** 粉色蝴蝶结小猫是一个粉嫩、简洁的 DeepSeek Harness 主题。它让界面保持安静、克制：手绘小猫印花壁纸、浅色与深色两套柔和粉色，以及两只戴蝴蝶结的小猫装饰。没有额外面板，没有复杂配置，也不改变任何工作流——只是让 Harness 更柔和、更亲切。

## Features / 特点

- Soft pink palettes for light and dark / 浅色与深色两套柔和粉色
- Hand-drawn kitty-print wallpaper, softened with a pink veil so text stays readable / 手绘小猫印花壁纸，叠加粉色薄纱，文字仍然清晰
- Bow-wearing kitty mascots under the composer and on the welcome screen / 输入框下方与欢迎页的蝴蝶结小猫装饰
- No configuration, no extra panels, no workflow changes / 无需配置、没有额外面板、不改变工作流

## Install / 安装

This is a standard DSH bundle: `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle` and `dsh.client`, and `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the plugin row.

这是一个标准的 DSH bundle：`package.json` 声明 `dsh.bundle` 与 `dsh.client`，`cordis.patch.yml` 插入插件行。

- From the DSH plugin market: search for **Pink Bow Kitty** and install it from the Themes tab. / 在 DSH 插件市场搜索 **Pink Bow Kitty**，从主题页安装。
- Or install this repository as a bundle through the DSH plugin manager. / 或通过 DSH 插件管理器把本仓库作为 bundle 安装。

The theme applies immediately after the client plugin loads. Disable or remove the bundle to restore the stock UI exactly.

客户端插件加载后主题立即生效；停用或移除 bundle 即可完全恢复原生界面。

## Compatibility / 兼容性

Built against the DSH Web client's `theme` token-override service and the documented UI slots (`shell.overlay`, `conversation.composer.dock`, `conversation.hero.brand.mark`). No DeepSeek Harness client package is imported.

基于 DSH Web 客户端的 `theme` token 覆盖服务与公开 UI 插槽（`shell.overlay`、`conversation.composer.dock`、`conversation.hero.brand.mark`）实现；不导入任何 DeepSeek Harness 客户端包。

## Artwork / 素材

All artwork in this repository is original vector art drawn for this plugin: the kitty faces, the repeating wallpaper, and the plugin icon. No third-party characters or images are bundled.

本仓库的所有素材均为原创矢量绘制：小猫头像、循环壁纸与插件图标；不包含任何第三方角色或图片。

## Author / 作者

ZCFE327

plugins.description: Workspace memory for DeepSeek Harness, ported from ZCode: a per-workspace Markdown memory directory injected into every main session, refreshed by background extraction after completed turns.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-workspace-memory — 工作区记忆（移植 ZCode）

把 ZCode 的 **Project / Workspace Memory** 移植到 DeepSeek Harness：每个工作区一份持久 Markdown
记忆，主会话开始时自动进入模型上下文，每轮成功对话后由后台提取补充；另有一个只读页面浏览记忆。

- 上游依据：ZCode `apps/zcode-cli/docs/design/v2/memory/README.md`（Memory 设计 v4）+
  `packages/core/src/memory/*`、`packages/core/src/context/sections/memory.ts`。
- 本插件是 **Host + Client** 两半，纯 JS、无构建步骤；`dsh plugin add` 一条命令装好，
  也可用 `plugin_manager install_bundle` 从本地目录装。

## 它做什么

1. **持久记忆目录**：每个工作区 `<workspaceRoot>/.dsh/memory/`，内含 `MEMORY.md` 索引与
   「一事实一文件」的 `<fact-name>.md`（YAML frontmatter + Markdown 正文）。
2. **会话开始注入**：主会话创建/恢复时，把 ZCode 同源的 `# Memory` 使用规则 + 当前
   `MEMORY.md` 索引注入 system prompt（每个 Agent 只读一次，会话中途不重读）。
3. **模型自己写**：你对助手说「记住…」，它按规则用现有 `write` / `edit` 工具把事实写进记忆目录，
   并同步 `MEMORY.md` 指针行（`- [Title](fact.md) — hook`）。
4. **后台自动提取**：每轮**成功**对话后（回复已经产出、不阻塞），后台发一个一次性模型请求，
   从本轮对话里挑出值得长期记住的事实，写成事实文件并维护索引。
5. **只读浏览**：左栏「工作区记忆」图标 → 整页列出所有有记忆的工作区与文件，查看原文（等宽原文，
   不渲染 Markdown）。

## 生效范围

| 维度 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| 开关粒度 | `enabled` 是**插件级（profile 级）**配置；开启后该 profile 下所有工作区的主会话都生效（与 ZCode 的全局开关一致） |
| 内容隔离 | **按工作区隔离**：记忆根 = 会话不可变的 `session.header.cwd`；工作区之间互不可见，同一工作区的多个会话共享一份 |
| 落盘时机 | **惰性**：只有真的开过主会话的工作区才会 best-effort 创建 `.dsh/memory/` |
| 子 Agent | **不生效**：`session.header.origin === 'subagent'`（subagent / workflow child / 队友）不注入、不提取 |
| read-only 会话 | 半生效：规则段照常注入，但**不建目录、不提取**；模型写记忆按沙箱正常被拒（无绕过） |
| 计划模式 | 记忆写入沿用宿主工具策略，会被拦（与 ZCode 有意不同，见下） |
| 其它 profile | 不装不生效；安装是 profile 级动作 |

## 数据布局

```text
<workspaceRoot>/.dsh/memory/
  MEMORY.md              # 索引；无 frontmatter；一行一条 `- [Title](fact-name.md) — hook`
  <fact-name>.md         # 一事实一文件
```

事实文件格式（与 ZCode 一致）：

```markdown
---
name: concise-memory-name
description: one-line recall description
metadata:
  node_type: memory
  type: user | feedback | project | reference
  originSessionId: sess_…
---
One durable fact.
```

- `type`：`user`（用户角色/背景/偏好）、`feedback`（协作方式的确认或纠正，正文带 `**Why:**` /
  `**How to apply:**`）、`project`（代码里推不出的项目原因/约束/决策）、`reference`（外部资源指针）。
- `name` 为小写 kebab-case（1–48 字符），正文可用 `[[other-name]]` 关联其它事实。
- `metadata.node_type` 与 `originSessionId` 由插件维护（新建时填当前会话，更新时保留原值）；
  其余约束与 ZCode 一样是提示词级约束，不做写后 schema 校验。
- 建议把记忆目录加进 `.gitignore`（插件自身绝不改 `.gitignore` 或其它仓库文件）：

  ```bash
  echo '.dsh/memory' >> .gitignore
  ```

## 配置（插件设置页 / cordis.patch.yml）

| 字段 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关：注入规则与索引、创建记忆目录、后台提取、页面数据 |
| `autoExtract` | `true` | 每轮成功对话后自动提取长期记忆（会产生额外模型请求与 token 成本） |
| `maxIndexChars` | `25000` | 注入的 `MEMORY.md` 块字符上限（另有 200 行上限） |
| `debugLog` | `false` | 追加更细的诊断（索引读取、跳过原因、写盘细节）到 `%TEMP%\workspace-memory-host.log` |

> 宿主日志 `%TEMP%\workspace-memory-host.log` 里，**每轮结束都会有一行提取结论**
> （`extraction done …` / `extraction skipped … (原因)` / `extraction request failed …`），
> 因为后台提取是一次真实计费请求、不会进入会话日志；`debugLog` 只增加更啰嗦的过程细节。

> 用量提示：开启 `autoExtract` 后，系统可能发起额外的模型请求来提取长期记忆，从而增加 Token
> 用量与使用成本。关掉它仍然可以手动让助手「记住…」。

## 后台提取（autoExtract）细节

- **触发**：`turn/end` 且 `reason.kind === 'completed'`；每个 Agent 单槽排队（正在跑时只保留最新一次）。
- **跳过规则**（ZCode 同款）：本轮里模型自己写过记忆（写工具参数命中记忆根）→ 跳过；
  本轮没有「独立文本块且词数 ≥ 3」的用户发言 → 跳过。中文按 CJK 字符折半计词
  （否则纯中文发言的词数永远算 1，自动提取再也不会触发）。
- **模型请求**：复用会话当前路由（`session.requestContext()` → 请求头 → Agent 选项 → 默认模型），
  `maxTokens = 1200`，只喂本轮的 user/assistant 文本（尾部截断 24,000 字符）与现有记忆清单；
  要求回复固定 JSON（`{"memories":[…],"forget":[…]}`），失败/非法 JSON/非 `stop` 结束 → 整轮放弃，不重试、不部分写入。
- **写入**：每轮最多 5 条事实；沿用会话自己的沙箱策略写入本工作区，`forget` 删除文件并移除指针。
- 关闭宿主/会话结束时中断在飞的提取，丢弃迟到结果。

## 与 ZCode 的差异（有意为之）

| 项 | ZCode | 本插件 |
|---|---|---|
| 存储根 | CLI 私有存储 `memories/projects/<key>/memory/`（仓库外） | 工作区内 `<cwd>/.dsh/memory/` —— DSH 沙箱默认 workspace-write，工作区外写会被拒；放工作区内可全程不绕过沙箱、模型用原生工具维护 |
| 写入方式 | 模型用 Write/Edit 写；提取是受限的 5 轮 Memory Agent（Read/Grep/Glob/只读 Bash/记忆目录内 Write/Edit） | 模型用 `write`/`edit`；提取是一次性 JSON 请求 + Host 写盘（DSH 不允许插件注册新工具策略/追加事件类型） |
| 注入位置 | system 段（规则）+ 首条 user message（索引） | 单个 per-agent system section（规则 + 索引），语义等价、KV 前缀更稳 |
| 索引刷新 | 每会话初始化读一次 | 同（中途不重读；提取的新记忆下个会话可见） |
| Plan 模式 | 允许写记忆 | 沿用宿主工具策略（会被拦） |
| 提取资格 | 「独立文本块 ≥ 3 个空白分隔词」 | 同样阈值，但 CJK 字符折半计词（中文发言才能合格） |
| 语义召回 / Dream | 代码保留但当前产品链路不启用 | 不做（与上游当前行为一致） |
| custom-agent 记忆 / 全局 kill switch 分层 / `-p` headless 门控 | 有 | 不做 |

## 安装 / 更新 / 卸载

从 GitHub 安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:moondrop12138/dsh-zcode-workspace-memory
```

本地开发目录安装：`plugin_manager` → `install_bundle`，target 为本目录绝对路径。

- 更新：**Client 半改动刷新页面即可；Host 半改动必须 `remove_bundle` + `install_bundle` 重装。**
- 卸载：`remove_bundle`（或 `dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-workspace-memory`），
  左栏图标与页面随之消失（监听/定时器都由 `ctx.effect` 接管）。

## 测试

```bash
cd dsh-zcode-workspace-memory && node --test
```

覆盖：路径与文件名安全、索引 frontmatter/注释剥离与双上限截断、指针 upsert/remove、
事实文件生成与 frontmatter 解析、origin 保留、提取资格判定（direct-write / 词数）、
转录尾部截断、提取提示词、JSON 解析（围栏/前后废话/字符串内花括号/非法条目整轮放弃/5 条上限）、
路由回退顺序。

## 验收实测（2026-10-18，本机 Desktop profile）

| 验收项 | 结果 | 证据 |
|---|---|---|
| A1 安装 | ✅ | `install_bundle` → `application: applied`、`warnings: []`；`Config.listConfigs` 返回 `enabled/autoExtract/maxIndexChars/debugLog` 四个 `x-cordis.volatile` 字段与默认值 |
| A2 会话注入 | ✅（活会话） | 安装后同一个正在运行的会话，最新 `system/message` 含 `# Memory`，且带绝对记忆根 `<workspace>\.dsh\memory/`；`.dsh/memory/` 已被创建 |
| A2' 插件热生效 | ✅ | 删除记忆目录后 `remove_bundle` + `install_bundle`，目录被重新创建，宿主日志无 `systemPrompt is unavailable`（`systemPrompt` 已声明为硬依赖） |
| A4' 提取落盘（宿主侧） | ✅ | Lead 独立 E2E（`scripts/verify-host-e2e.mjs`）：14/14 通过 —— 事实文件 + `originSessionId` + `MEMORY.md` 指针、请求带 route/system/1200 maxTokens、direct-write 跳过、read-only 不建目录不提取、subagent 不注入不提取 |
| A5 read-only | ✅ | 同上（不建目录、不提取、仍注入规则段） |
| A6 子 Agent | ✅ | 同上（无 `# Memory`、不提取） |
| A7 UI 注册 | ✅（live 槽位） | `Slots.listSubTree('sidebar.panellist')` 出现 `workspace-memory`（order 30，active）；`main` 出现 key `workspace-memory` |
| A8 单元测试 | ✅ | `node --test` 37/37 通过 |
| A4 触发与判定（live） | ✅ | 宿主日志每个 `turn/end` 一行结论：本会话 3 个完成的 turn 都在判定范围内；定时提醒那轮判为 `extraction skipped … (no-user-prose)`——正确，因为提醒消息的 `source.kind` 是 `schedule` 而不是 `user`（会话日志实测 `userMessageSources = {user:2, runtime-context:1, skill-catalog:1, time-context:5, agent-message:5, subagent-settled:5, schedule:2}`） |
| A4' 真实模型提取 | ⏳ | 尚未发生：装好之后的所有 turn 的用户发言要么是 `schedule` 来源、要么在 journaling 之前结束。**发一句真实中文（≥3 字单位，如「记住：这个项目用 tabs」）**即可触发，届时日志出现 `extraction done … memories=N` |
| A3 记忆协议落盘（live） | ✅（协议） | 按协议写入示例事实 `workspace-memory-port.md` + `MEMORY.md`，用插件自己的纯函数回读校验：文件名被接受、frontmatter 解析出 `type: project` 与 `originSessionId`、`buildManifest` 正常、下一会话的注入块含该指针行 |
| A3' 模型自主写入 | ⏳ | 提示词与文件协议已就绪并已注入；是否照做取决于模型，需一次真实「记住…」指令才能作为证据 |
| 设置表单可见性 | ⏳（待目视） | schema 已确认；请在「插件」页确认 Configure 表单 |

复现命令：

```bash
cd dsh-zcode-workspace-memory
node --test                        # 37 项纯函数/集成用例
node scripts/verify-host-e2e.mjs   # 14 项宿主侧端到端断言
node scripts/inspect-session.mjs <session.v4.jsonl.zstd>   # 检查某会话最新 system 段是否含 # Memory
node scripts/verify-memory-dir.mjs "<工作区绝对路径>"        # 用插件自己的纯函数校验记忆目录与注入块
```

## 已知限制

- **提取请求不可回放**：DSH 不允许插件追加新的事件类型，提取的请求/响应不会写进会话日志；
  只有 `%TEMP%\workspace-memory-host.log` 里的每轮结论行（成功了什么、为什么跳过、是否失败）。
- **中途不刷新索引**：会话中途模型或提取写入的新记忆，要到下一个会话才进入上下文（ZCode 同语义）。
- **索引指针可能悬空**：记忆文件被外部删除/改名后，插件不做修复器（与 ZCode 一致）；页面会显示实际存在的文件。
- **记忆可见性**：`.dsh/memory/` 在仓库里，是否提交由你决定。
- **UI 是只读的**：页面不提供编辑/删除；开关在插件设置里，记忆内容由模型或提取写入。

## 许可证与上游

- **本仓库第一方代码：MIT**（见 `LICENSE`）。
- 记忆的提示词文本（`memoryRulesText` / `buildExtractionPrompt`）与记忆设计移植自
  **ZCode**（[zai-org/ZCode](https://github.com/zai-org/ZCode)，Apache-2.0，Copyright 2026 Z.AI Co., Ltd）：
  改了什么、没移植什么、哪些是重写而非照抄，见 [`NOTICE.md`](NOTICE.md)；该许可的副本是
  [`LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt`](LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt)。

## 结构

```text
package.json        # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client{platform:web, immediately, inject:[…]}
cordis.patch.yml    # insert: id: workspace-memory, name: dsh-workspace-memory
INTERFACES.md       # 冻结的跨半契约（RPC 信封/端点/数据形状/座位/config 语义）
lib/memory-core.js  # 纯函数：路径、索引、指针、事实文件、提取提示与解析、路由（零依赖）
lib/host.js         # Host 半：Config、system section、会话监听、后台提取、ctx.fs 写盘、RPC
lib/client.js       # Client 半：左栏图标 + 整页（纯浏览器 JS，只 require('react')）
locale/{zh,en}.json # 插件管理页元数据
icon.svg            # 原创图标
test/               # node --test 用例
```

plugins.description: DSH 的按需 MCP 网关：server 只在被用到时连接，空闲自动断开，工具列表缓存在磁盘，子进程环境自动脱敏。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lazy-mcp

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![CI](https://github.com/zhe97396-tech/dsh-lazy-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/zhe97396-tech/dsh-lazy-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D20-brightgreen.svg)](https://nodejs.org)

A lazy-loading **MCP gateway** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH). No MCP server starts at boot: each server connects on first use and is released after an idle window. Tools and resources are bridged into the model's tool catalog, and the Web UI shows live server state.

![The MCP status panel](assets/panel.png)

<sub>The status panel: per-server state, lifecycle, tool count, and the adjustable idle window.</sub>

## Why this exists

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` connects every configured server while the plugin activates and awaits the initial connection plus tool discovery, so:

- every server is live before the Harness's first turn;
- a slow or broken server delays startup;
- servers stay resident until the Harness restarts (its only `idle`-shaped knob, `reconnect.maxDelayMs`, governs reconnect backoff, not idle shutdown).

This gateway starts nothing at boot.

| Behaviour | `dsh-mcp-client` | this plugin |
|---|---|---|
| Server process at Harness startup | started | **not started** |
| Server starts | at plugin activation | **on first tool call that needs it** |
| Server stops | only on config reload / Harness restart | **after `idleDisconnectMs` idle** |
| Standing tool definitions | one per MCP tool, sent every request | **3 fixed gateway tools** |
| Tool schemas in context | all, always | **only when `mcp_tools` is called** |
| Describing a dormant server | requires a connection | **served from cached metadata** |
| Per-server lifecycle | one behaviour | **`lazy` / `lazy-keep-alive` / `eager` / `keep-alive`** |

## Install

Requirements: Node.js 20 or newer and a DSH profile (the Web profile is the usual one). The package has **no `@deepseek-ai/*` dependency**, so a Harness peer-range change cannot break it; its single runtime dependency is the MCP TypeScript client SDK, the same SDK the official bridge uses.

### Option A — install from GitHub

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zhe97396-tech/dsh-lazy-mcp
```

Then **restart `dsh web`**. The Host half and the browser half are both loaded from the installed package, and a running Harness cannot pick up a freshly installed module without a restart.

### Option B — install a release tarball

Download `dsh-lazy-mcp-<version>.tgz` from the [Releases](https://github.com/zhe97396-tech/dsh-lazy-mcp/releases) page and install it through the plugin manager (or `dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-lazy-mcp-<version>.tgz`), then restart `dsh web`.

The plugin is enabled by an `- id: lazy-mcp` row in the profile. A configuration-only change normally hot-reloads, **but when it ships inside a replaced package the manager defers it to the restart** (the result reads `application: "restart-required"`). Toggling the row off and on — the plugin manager's `set_plugin` on `include:lazy-mcp` — forces a re-compose and applies the new configuration immediately, without a restart.

### Two halves

| Half | File | Loaded by |
|---|---|---|
| Host | `index.js` | the bundle row in `cordis.patch.yml` |
| Browser | `client.js` | the `dsh.client` declaration in `package.json`, served by `dsh-client-modules` |

The browser half imports **no DSH Client package**: React comes from the browser module table and every color is a theme token, so it follows light and dark without a second stylesheet. Its `__ModuleLoader__.load({ id })` uses the exact package name, which is why the package name, the Loader row name, and the naming manifest must be renamed together.

The two halves are wired only by the read-only JSON route the Host half registers at `/lazy-mcp/state` and by the shared panel id `lazy-mcp`.

### Where it actually lives

| What | Where |
|---|---|
| Profile dependency + bundle list | `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json` |
| Installed package — a **real directory** with its own `node_modules` | `~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-lazy-mcp` |
| Vendored tarball (only when installed from a tarball) | `~/.dsh/profiles/web/.local-packages/dsh-lazy-mcp-<version>.tgz` |
| Enablement override written by the plugin manager | `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` (`- id: lazy-mcp`) |
| Source | this repository — **not read at runtime** |

The plugin's **settings** live in this package's own `cordis.patch.yml`, loaded as the bundle's patch layer — not in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. To override a setting from the profile layer instead, add an `- id: lazy-mcp` entry with a `config` there; the profile layer wins.

### Rebuilding after a code change

```sh
cd dsh-lazy-mcp
pnpm install
pnpm run check      # syntax check of both halves
pnpm run lint       # package identity / manifest consistency
pnpm run verify     # self-check harness (starts a real MCP reference server)
pnpm pack           # dsh-lazy-mcp-<version>.tgz
```

Bump `version` first, so the new artifact gets a distinct name and the old one can be pruned, then install that tarball through the plugin manager and restart `dsh web`.

## Configure

The package ships with **no servers configured** (`servers: []`), so nothing is spawned until you add entries to the `lazy-mcp` row's `config`:

```yaml
- id: lazy-mcp
  config:
    idleDisconnectMs: 600000        # disconnect a lazy server after 10 minutes idle
    connectTimeoutMs: 30000         # deadline for connect + tool discovery
    callTimeoutMs: 60000            # deadline for one tools/call
    # cachePath: !!js dshHomePath('lazy-mcp/tool-cache.json')   # default: <DSH_PROFILE_DIR>/lazy-mcp/tool-cache.json
    servers:
      - name: docs                  # ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}$, unique
        transport: stdio
        lifecycle: lazy
        description: Documentation lookup
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'some-mcp-server']
        # env: { SOME_TOKEN: '...' }   # optional, merged over the scrubbed env
        # cwd: 'C:\path\to\project'    # optional
        # idleDisconnectMs: 120000     # optional per-server override

      - name: knowledge
        transport: streamable-http
        lifecycle: lazy
        description: Internal knowledge base
        url: https://mcp.example.com/rpc
        # headers: { Authorization: !!js '`Bearer ${process.env.MCP_TOKEN}`' }
```

Every field is optional except a server's `name`, `transport`, and that transport's target (`command` for stdio, `url` for streamable-http). An invalid configuration fails activation with the exact offending path named.

### Environment scrubbing

A stdio server's child environment is the parent environment **minus** every name matching `KEY|PASSWORD|SECRET|TOKEN` (case-insensitive) and **minus** every `DSH_*` name, then merged with the server's explicit `env`. This matches the shipped subprocess seam's definition, so a child server never inherits this process's model credentials. A server that needs a secret must receive it through its own `env` mapping. **Env values are never logged and never written to the cache** — only the key set is, and only to detect a configuration change.

## Importing an existing MCP setup

Point `configPaths` at any JSON file containing a standard `mcpServers` object and its servers appear here. This is how an existing **Pi** (`pi-mcp-adapter`), **Claude Code**, **Cursor**, or **`.mcp.json`** setup becomes reusable without copying commands by hand — the other tool stays the source of truth.

```yaml
- id: lazy-mcp
  config:
    configPaths:
      - '~/.config/mcp/mcp.json'          # Pi shared config
      - '~/.pi/agent/mcp-adapter.json'    # Pi adapter config
```

Standard fields are translated: `command`/`args`/`env`/`cwd` become a stdio server, `url`/`headers` become a streamable-http server. A leading `~/` in a path, and `${VAR}` / `$VAR` in `args`, `cwd`, `env`, `headers`, and `url`, are expanded from the environment — an unknown name is left literal ra

plugins.description: 用量事件 JSONL 记账与单一口径报表（只记账、不设闸、不读余额）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ledger

用量账本（accounting only）：监听 session/event 中带 usage 的记录写 JSONL；
`ledger_report.mjs` 出单一口径报表。口径对齐 usage-aggregate.py：
只加不乘、原币不折算、面板数与机记分列（本插件只记机记）。

## 禁用

不读余额接口、不设预算硬闸。裁决与预算归人/主审计。

## 测试

```bash
node --test test/ledger.test.mjs
```

# 大肥鱼识屏 · DSH 桌宠插件

给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的桌面桌宠 **dsh-pet** 加上「识屏模式」：桌面上的大肥鱼会定时看一眼你的屏幕，主动吐槽，也能看着屏幕跟你聊天。

> 两个插件**配套使用**：只装 `pet-menu` 菜单会出来但点了没反应；只装 `screensense` 就没有右键入口。

| 插件 | 版本 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`dafeiyu-screensense`](./dafeiyu-screensense) | 1.1.0 | 识屏本体：定时截屏、画面变化检测、主动吐槽、看着屏幕聊天 |
| [`dafeiyu-pet-menu`](./dafeiyu-pet-menu) | 1.0.0 | 给桌面右键菜单加「识屏模式」入口（开启 / 关闭 / 识别间隔） |

## 特性

- **定时识屏**：默认每 30 秒截一张主屏，缩到 1280 宽 JPEG。
- **不瞎说话**：8×8 均值哈希比较画面，画面没变化就静默，**零模型调用、零 token**。
- **主动吐槽**：画面变化时把截图交给当前模型，用大肥鱼的口吻说一句（≤60 字），气泡显示在桌宠上。
- **看着屏幕聊天**：`/fish <消息>` 让大肥鱼结合当前画面回你。
- **右键菜单**：识屏模式 → 开启识屏 / 关闭识屏 / 识别间隔（15 / 30 / 60 / 120 秒），开和关都会用气泡回话。
- **两端同步**：走 dsh-pet 的 `POST /dsh-pet-7340/broadcast`，浏览器 overlay 和桌面小窗看到同一份内容。

## 环境要求

- 已安装 DeepSeek Harness（DSH），桌面模式可正常显示桌宠。
- 已安装 **dsh-pet 0.3.x**（只在 0.3.7 上验证过）。
- Windows：截屏脚本依赖 PowerShell 的 `System.Windows.Forms` + `System.Drawing`。

## 安装

### 方式一：Release 安装包（推荐）

1. 到 [Releases](../../releases) 下载最新的 `dafeiyu-dsh-plugins-v*.zip`，解压到**不带中文的路径**。
2. 在 DSH 里对 AI 说：

   > 用 plugin_manager install_bundle 安装这两个目录：
   > `<解压目录>\dafeiyu-screensense`
   > `<解压目录>\dafeiyu-pet-menu`

3. 安装需要完全访问权限，会弹一次批准；装完 `dafeiyu-pet-menu` 会自动重启桌面助手。
4. 若菜单没出现：右键大肥鱼 →「重载配置」。

### 方式二：从源码目录安装

```bash
git clone https://github.com/marx-otto/dafeiyu-dsh-plugins.git
cd dafeiyu-dsh-plugins
npm pack --pack-destination dist ./dafeiyu-screensense
npm pack --pack-destination dist ./dafeiyu-pet-menu
```

然后同样用 `install_bundle` 指向上面的两个目录，或用 `dsh plugin add` 安装生成的 `.tgz`。

## 使用

右键桌面大肥鱼：「回到初始位置」下面会出现 **识屏模式**：

- **开启识屏** → 气泡回「识屏模式：开啦！我盯着你的屏幕咯～」
- **关闭识屏** → 气泡回「识屏模式：关啦，我先眯一会儿～」
- **识别间隔** → 15 / 30 / 60 / 120 秒

命令：

| 命令 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `/fish <消息>` | 结合当前屏幕画面聊天 |
| `/fish_look` | 立刻看一眼屏幕 |
| `/fish_screen on` / `off` | 开 / 关识屏 |
| `/fish_screen <秒数>` | 改间隔（≥10 秒） |
| `/fish_screen status` | 查看当前状态 |

HTTP 接口：

- `GET /dafeiyu-screensense/status` —— 当前开关、间隔、上次截图时间等
- `POST /dafeiyu-screensense/control` —— 开 / 关 / 改间隔（右键菜单就是调它）

## 配置（`dafeiyu-screensense`）

写在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `config` 里，改完重载该插件行即生效。

| 键 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | 是否启用识屏 |
| `intervalSec` | `30` | 截屏间隔（秒） |
| `idleRepeatSec` | `120` | 画面不变时，隔多久允许再主动说一句 |
| `changeThreshold` | `6` | 哈希差异阈值，越大越不敏感 |
| `maxWidth` | `1280` | 截图缩放后的宽度 |
| `jpegQuality` | `72` | JPEG 质量 |
| `maxChars` | `60` | 单次吐槽最大字数 |
| `chatMemoryRounds` | `6` | `/fish` 聊天保留的上下文轮数 |
| `firstLookDelaySec` | `8` | 开启后首次截屏的延迟 |
| `provider` / `model` | 空 | 留空则跟随当前会话的默认模型 |
| `petId` | 空 | 指定桌宠实例，一般留空 |

`dafeiyu-pet-menu` 只有一个开关：`enabled`。

## 隐私与费用

- **截图会发给你当前选择的模型服务商**（截图作为图片消息随请求发出），只在开启识屏时发生。
- 画面没变化时不会调用模型，不会产生 token 消耗。
- 介意隐私的话，别在开着识屏时处理敏感内容，或直接把间隔调大 / 关掉。

## 兼容性与风险

`dafeiyu-pet-menu` 是**补丁插件**：dsh-pet 没提供右键菜单扩展接口，所以它会：

1. 找到 `node_modules/dsh-pet/runtime/electron-helper/renderer.js`；
2. 首次修改前备份为 `renderer.js.dafeiyu.bak`；
3. 追加带 `dafeiyu-pet-menu v1` 标记的 IIFE 补丁。

补丁是幂等的（已有标记就跳过）。**dsh-pet 升级后补丁可能被覆盖**，重装或重启本插件会自动补回。菜单依赖 dsh-pet 0.3.x 的 shared-core 实现，大版本升级后菜单可能不出现，但不会弄坏宠物。

## 卸载

1. 在 DSH 插件管理里停用 / 移除 `dafeiyu-pet-menu` 和 `dafeiyu-screensense`。
2. 想彻底还原右键菜单：把 `renderer.js.dafeiyu.bak` 覆盖回 `renderer.js`，再「重载配置」。

## 开发

```bash
npm pack --pack-destination dist ./dafeiyu-screensense
npm pack --pack-destination dist ./dafeiyu-pet-menu
```

两个包都带 `dsh.bundle.patch`，装进 profile 后由 DSH 的插件管理器加载。

## License

[MIT](./LICENSE)

plugins.description: Startup splash for DeepSeek Harness: the whale floods black, then pulls out the | deepseek HARNESS wordmark.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-boot-splash · a boot film for DeepSeek Harness

The white‑and‑blue whale sits alone in the middle of the window. As the app loads it is
**flooded black from below** — ink rising like a tide — and the moment loading finishes it is
completely black. Then it glides left, pulling `| deepseek HARNESS` out of its own body, settles
with a small bounce, and hands the window back to the app.

![boot splash](preview/boot-splash.gif)

中文说明见 [README.zh.md](README.zh.md)。

## Timeline (7.6 s, one deterministic clock)

| Time | Beat |
| --- | --- |
| 0.0 s | the blue whale condenses out of a soft blue bloom, breathing on a blurred contact shadow |
| 1.1 s | ink floods up the body; **the tide line is the progress bar**, with a white meniscus on its edge |
| 3.5 s | the whale is fully black; the bloom exhales once, shed particles fade out |
| 3.6 s | a specular sweep crosses the black body |
| 3.7 s | glide left: 3° bank, a hairline wake and two afterimages, condensing to wordmark size |
| 4.3 s | `deepseek` is drawn out of the whale glyph by glyph, resolving from blur |
| 5.1 s | the black plate slides out of the end of the wordmark, uncovering `HARNESS` |
| 5.6 s | lands with a 1.3 % rebound and a slow breath; a faint signature rule blooms and dissolves |
| 6.5 s | a slow light sweep across the finished lockup |
| 6.9 s | the whole layer fades out (1.2 % slow zoom) and reveals the app |

Click anywhere to skip. Colours are restricted to black, white, grey and blue: the only
non‑grayscale tokens are `#2f6bff`, `#8db8ff` and the bloom.

**This version has no loading ring.** Progress is carried by the ink tide, its white meniscus,
the charging bloom and the particles shed along the flood line. A few typographic layers were
added at the same time — film grain, corner falloff, a contact shadow under the mark, a wake
hairline during the glide, and a signature rule under the finished lockup.

## The artwork is the real thing

There is no typesetting: the whale mark, `deepseek` wordmark, plate and `HARNESS` glyphs are the
app's own vectors, extracted from `favicon.svg` + `welcome-brand.svg` inside `app.asar` by
[`dev/build-logo-data.mjs`](dev/build-logo-data.mjs) into [`dev/logo-data.js`](dev/logo-data.js).
The last frame is pixel‑identical to the sidebar brand row.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-boot-splash
# or from a local checkout
dsh plugin add /path/to/dsh-boot-splash
```

Restart the app (or the `dsh web` process) once; the film plays on the next page load and
unmounts itself when the clock ends. It plays once per page load.

## Layout

Three readable sources, assembled by `build.mjs`:

* `src/scene.css` — bloom, vignette, grain, contact shadow, wake, signature rule, lockup layout.
* `src/scene.html` — the hero whale's SVG, particle layer, finished lockup.
* `src/timeline.js` — the only clock: `mountSplash(host, logo, opts)` with a pure `render(t)`
  that draws any instant of the film, so it can be frozen or scrubbed.
* `client.js` — generated; a React component registered on the `shell.overlay` slot, cleaned up
  through `ctx.effect`.
* `src/splash.js` — generated, used only by `dev/boot.html` so the preview runs shipped code.
* `lib/index.js` — intentionally empty host half, so the loader mounts a fiber and the client
  bundle reaches the page.
* `dev/` — `boot.html` (`?t=1200` freezes a frame), `shot.mjs` (deterministic CDP capture),
  `frames.py` (contact sheets), `integration.html` (runs the shipped `client.js` against a tiny
  `__ModuleLoader__`/React stub), `make-gif.mjs` + `gif.py`.

```bash
node build.mjs             # regenerate src/splash.js + client.js
node dev/serve.mjs .       # http://127.0.0.1:8899/dev/boot.html?t=2600
node dev/make-gif.mjs      # 76 frames @10 fps -> python dev/gif.py
```

## Notes

* Painted on `shell.overlay`: no app root replacement, no sidebar DOM, no reading other plugins'
  DOM, never clipped by scroll containers.
* Decoration only: no host behaviour, no settings namespace, no network.
* Brand vectors belong to DeepSeek and ship only as part of this fan‑made boot film; the plugin
  code itself is MIT.

MIT © liushuchang-2012

plugins.description: Adds a Continue button to the DeepSeek Harness composer for interrupted turns.
plugins.readme_text:
# client-resume-button

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](./LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%3E%3D0.2.0--rc.2-blue)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

给 DeepSeek Harness 的输入框加一个「继续」按钮：上一轮被中断后，点一下就能让模型接着把那一轮做完。

[English](./README.en.md) | 中文

---

## 效果

![preview](./docs/screenshot.png)

红圈处即「继续」按钮，位于模型选择器左侧。开始输入或添加附件时它收窄消失，清空后展开回来。

## 功能

按钮可见需要同时满足两点：

- 上一轮以 `aborted`（用户按停止）、`interrupted`（崩溃）或 `error` 结束
- 主提交按钮处于禁用态——即输入框为空、没有待上传附件、也没有轮次在跑

`aborted` 只在子原因为用户主动停止时才算，超时或策略取消不算。

点击后发送两条 plugin 来源的提示给模型：一条要求继续，一条提醒检查残留进程、不重做已完成步骤。

## 安装

```
插件页 → 「添加插件」→ 输入 client-resume-button → 安装 → 重启 DSH
```

命令行等价写法（`--profile` 填你实际在用的：桌面客户端 `desktop`，`dsh web` 用 `web`）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add client-resume-button
```

**装完必须重启 DSH**，浏览器端代码只在启动时加载。

<details>
<summary>其他安装方式</summary>

从 Git 仓库（需要能访问 `github.com`）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:ddy-007/dsh-client-resume-button
```

若 `github.com` 不可达，可临时借助 `ghproxy.net` 这类第三方镜像转发。镜像只是绕开网络限制的便利手段，不是推荐路径——它会把安装流量经第三方转发，其供应链可信度未经本项目评估。优先用 npm 包或直连 GitHub。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://ghproxy.net/https://github.com/ddy-007/dsh-client-resume-button.git
```

改源码时用 `link:`，不必每次重装，改完只需重启：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:<仓库绝对路径>"
```

</details>

## 卸载

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove client-resume-button
```

## 验证

```sh
npm test      # 26 个断言：三种中断各留标记，completed 与超时不留
npm run record   # 每态一次折叠的人可读记录
npm run verify   # 在临时 DSH_HOME 里用真实投影注册表跑一遍
```

`npm test` 与 `npm run record` 只碰 `lib/projection.js`，它没有 import，所以不需要装依赖、不需要联网。`npm run verify` 需要 SDK 依赖（`pnpm install`），它会挂载真实的 Cordis 上下文与投影注册表，向真实 `Session` 追加真实事件，再读客户端渲染用的那份快照。

用例的事件形状取自真实会话日志，不是构造的近似值。

## 限制

- **按钮位于模型选择器左侧**，不在主提交按钮旁。更近的 `conversation.input.activity` 槽位是 `single` 类型，已被语音输入插件占用，抢占会导致应用无法启动。
- **开始新一轮后按钮就消失**。中断标记会在下一次 `turn/start` 时清除——中断后只要又发了消息，无论内容是什么，都无法再「继续上一轮」。
- **不能恢复中断时的半截输出**。那部分内容从未写入日志，插件是新开一轮 turn 重做，而非续写原流。

## 兼容性

实测 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`、`0.2.1-rc.2`。`dsh.engines.dsh` 声明 `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.2.1-0 || >=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`，低于下界或达到 `0.3.0`（含 `0.3.0-rc.1` 这类预发布版）会被拒绝安装。

范围写成两段而不是 `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`，是因为后者会静默排除所有 `0.2.1-*` 预发布版：node-semver 只有在**某个比较符自身**与目标版本共享完整的 `major.minor.patch` 元组、且该比较符带预发布标签时才放行预发布版本。写成一整段时，`0.2.1-rc.2` 被排除，`npm install` 会直接报 `ERESOLVE`。DSH 自己的兼容门用 `includePrerelease: true` 求值，恰好看不出这个问题——所以两段式是这个缺陷的修复，不是风格偏好。

同样地，`@deepseek-ai/*` 的 peer 范围全部写明版本线，没有一处用 `"*"`。这些包在 npm 上的 `latest` 标签停留在很久以前的版本（配套 harness 的线在 `next` 上），`"*"` 会让 npm 挑 `latest`，展开出一份 `0.0.x` 的旧依赖图，其中包含从未发布到 npm 的包，安装当场失败。

依赖以下内部约定，DSH 升级后可能失效：`turn/end` reason 枚举、`conversation.input.right` 槽位、`<hash>_primary` 类名、`agent.inbox.prepend` / `agent.steer`、`window.__ModuleLoader__.load`。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: 手机远程操控 DSH：手机浏览器原生页面 + 限时门 + 企微机器人长连接
plugins.readme_text:
# Phone Remote · 手机远程操控 DSH 界面

> 让安卓/iPhone 手机在外面也能用**浏览器原生页面**打开本机的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH），
> 收「任务跑完」提醒，并在手机上给电脑发一句话就能**召唤**远程入口。

一套由插件 + 三个配套小服务组成的最小可用方案。**不需要买域名、不需要改路由器、不租服务器。**

语言：**中文** · [English](README.en.md)

---

## 它解决什么问题

DSH 的 Web 界面默认只监听 `127.0.0.1`，手机碰不到。本方案做四件事：

| # | 能力 | 走什么 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 同 WiFi 用手机浏览器直接开 DSH | 本机反向代理（传达室）+ 自动续登录钥匙 |
| 2 | 出门用流量也想用浏览器原生页面 | **临时限时门**（到点自动关，链接作废） |
| 3 | 任务跑完/出错主动提醒到手机 | 任意 **Webhook 推送通道**（企微群机器人等） |
| 4 | 手机发一句话就能召唤（在外面也能开门） | **机器人长连接**（Bot ID + Secret，主动连出去） |

> **通知里的链接一律走公网（v0.3.0 起）**：发通知前，插件先看有没有**还活着的**临时门
> （`doorMinRemainingMs` 默认 `0`：只要没到期就复用，**不重开门**；复用时通知里只说明"门没关"、不重复给链接）；
> 没有才**自动开一扇**（`doorMinutes` 默认 **480 = 8 小时**）再把公网地址放进通知；门到点自动关、链接随即失效。
> **进门要带门钥匙**（`?gate=<gateKey>`，32 字符随机串，跟门同生共死）：**只拿到域名打不开（401）**，
> 但**拿到完整链接的人在门关之前都能进**——这条边界详见 [`docs/SECURITY.md`](docs/SECURITY.md) 第 2 节。
> 门没开成时**宁可不带链接**（附一句说明），也**绝不推一条点不开的死链接**。
> 为什么改：以前通知里放的是"手机可达地址前缀"（`mobileBaseUrl`，家里局域网 IP），
> **一出门在公网上根本不存在这个地址，点开必然打不开**——这是 10-19 boss反馈的根因。

## 目录结构

```
plugin/            # DSH 的 Cordis 插件（Host 半 + Client 半），本目录
├─ index.js        #   Host 半：生成手机入口链接、写 upstream、任务完成/出错推送
├─ client.js       #   Client 半：「手机远程」窄屏面板（工作区分区 + 忙闲 + 派活）
├─ cordis.patch.yml#   插件行配置（上传前请替换为 config.example.yml 的占位符写法）
├─ config.example.yml  # 脱敏配置模板
├─ bot.example.json    # 机器人凭据模板（脱敏）
├─ docs/           # 文档：踩坑 / 引导 / 架构 / 安全
└─ .gitignore      # 排除真实凭据、日志、二进制

../phone-proxy.mjs        # 传达室：51130 → 127.0.0.1:<DSH端口>（改写 Host/Origin）
../temp-door.mjs          # 临时限时门：cloudflared 快速隧道，到点自动关
../bot/wecom-bot.mjs      # 机器人长连接（示例实现：企业微信智能机器人）
```

> 三个配套服务各自独立、可单独使用。**只用插件也能跑通第 1、3 条**；
> 第 2 条要 `temp-door.mjs`，第 4 条要 `bot/`。

---

## 快速开始（最短路径）

1. **装插件**：把 `plugin/` 目录用 DSH 的插件管理器装载（`install_bundle`，目标指向本目录）。
2. **配两项**（见 `config.example.yml`）：
   - `pushWebhook`：任意接受 `POST` JSON 的推送地址（企微群机器人 / 飞书自定义机器人 / 钉钉 / ntfy…）；
   - `linkFile` / `mobileBaseUrl`：入口链接落盘位置、手机可达的地址前缀。
3. **起传达室**（同 WiFi 直接用）：`node phone-proxy.mjs`，建议用系统计划任务托管（见 `docs/GUIDE.md`）。
4. **（可选）起机器人长连接**：填 `botId`/`secret` 后 `node bot/wecom-bot.mjs`，手机发「开门」即召唤。

细节步骤、分平台适配、验证清单见 **[docs/GUIDE.md](docs/GUIDE.md)**。

---

## 文档索引

| 文档 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| **[docs/TUTORIAL-WECOM.md](docs/TUTORIAL-WECOM.md)** | **企业微信部署教程**：照着做就能跑通（含智能机器人长连接 + 群机器人推送 + 计划任务托管 + 排障表）；英文版 [TUTORIAL-WECOM.en.md](docs/TUTORIAL-WECOM.en.md) |
| [docs/GUIDE.md](docs/GUIDE.md) | 通用引导：从零到跑通、平台适配表、验证清单、排障 |
| [docs/PITFALLS.md](docs/PITFALLS.md) | **踩坑总结**：我们实际踩过的每一个坑（现象 → 根因 → 对策） |
| [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) | 架构与数据流、平台无关抽象（出口 Webhook / 入口 Bot） |
| [docs/SECURITY.md](docs/SECURITY.md) | 安全须知、凭据管理、**上传公开仓库前的脱敏清单** |

## 打包分享清单（要带走哪些文件）

仓库里**只放**：

```
plugin/
├─ index.js  client.js  package.json  icon.svg
├─ locale/{en,zh}.json
├─ config.example.yml      # 配置模板（占位符）
├─ bot.example.json        # 机器人凭据模板（占位符）
├─ README.md  docs/*.md  .gitignore
└─ companion/               # ← 上传前从上一级目录移入并脱敏（见下）
   ├─ phone-proxy.mjs  phone-proxy-supervisor.mjs
   ├─ temp-door.mjs
   └─ wecom-bot.mjs
```

**上传前必须处理的三件事**：

1. **不要提交** `cordis.patch.yml`（含真实工作路径 / 内网 IP / 推送频道）→ 用 `config.example.yml` 代替；
2. **不要提交** 任何 `*.json` 真实配置（机器人 `botId/secret`、推送通道表）→ 用 `bot.example.json` 代替；
3. `companion/` 里的三个配套脚本**已经是脱敏副本**（推送出口改读 `push.json` 或环境变量 `PUSH_WEBHOOK`；机器人脚本的相对路径已按同目录改好），直接带上即可。

> **更省事的做法**：跑一键打包脚本，它自动剔除全部敏感文件与产物：
> ```powershell
> pwsh -File .\publish.ps1 -Target ..\..\dsh-phone-remote-publish
> ```
> 生成目录即为**可直接 `git push`** 的仓库内容。
> 提交前请逐条跑 `docs/SECURITY.md` 第 5.3 节的自检命令，**全部应为"无匹配"**。

## 平台无关性

本方案刻意不绑定某个 IM 平台，只要满足下面两条就能适配：

- **出口（发通知）**：给一个 **Webhook 协议地址**，能 `POST` 一段 JSON。
  企微群机器人、飞书自定义机器人、钉钉机器人、ntfy、Slack…均可。
- **入口（收消息）**：给一个 **Bot ID + Secret**，且该平台支持**长连接**（客户端主动连出去收消息）。
  企业微信「智能机器人」、飞书自建应用、QQ 机器人均属此类。

> 关键取舍：**收消息一定要走长连接，不要走"平台把消息推到一个公网回调地址"**。
> 后者要求一个**固定不变**的公网 HTTPS 地址——家庭宽带几乎做不到（详见 `docs/PITFALLS.md` 第 1、3 条）。

## 演示视频

手机远程实机演示（开门 → 手机浏览器原生页面进入 → 远程派活）：[`media/phone-remote-demo.mp4`](media/phone-remote-demo.mp4)

## 版本

当前 **v0.3.0**（2026-10-19）。改了什么、每个版本修了哪些坑，见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

## 许可与出处

示例实现以企业微信为基准（官方 SDK `@wecom/aibot-node-sdk`）。
欢迎按 `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` 的适配接口补其他平台。

plugins.description: A DSH plugin that turns one provider API key into a managed pool + more built-in LLM Providers
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Keys Manager

[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-keys-manager)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-keys-manager)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%5E22.19%20%7C%7C%20%3E%3D24-339933)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-keys-manager)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%5E0.2.1--rc.2-0969DA)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm)

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns one provider API key into a managed pool.
It extends the Models page rather than replacing it: providers, models, and the
model picker stay where they are; only the API-key source moves behind the
manager.

## Features

- Several keys per provider, each with an alias and health state.
- One key pinned to a session, with round-robin selection for new sessions.
- Bounded retry on the same key, then automatic failover to another key.
- Exponential cooldown recovery, capped at seven days.
- A search-driven Keys Manager page on the plugin's own detail page.
- A "managed by Keys Manager" badge inside the existing Models provider cards.
- Extra built-in providers installed as ordinary `llm-pi-ai` routes.
- OAuth account sign-in for seven pi-ai-backed providers, stored beside
  the API keys.
- A companion transport component for providers the vendored pi-ai cannot
  speak — Cursor (`cursor`) today — installed with the plugin.

### Extra providers

This catalog of 35 extra providers comes from
[oh-my-pi](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi)'s provider catalog (MIT).

<details>
<summary>All 35 extra providers</summary>

| Provider | Route id | API key env |
|---|---|---|
| DeepInfra | `deepinfra` | `DEEPINFRA_API_KEY` |
| Novita | `novita` | `NOVITA_API_KEY` |
| StepFun | `stepfun` | `STEPFUN_API_KEY` |
| SambaNova | `sambanova` | `SAMBANOVA_API_KEY` |
| Qianfan | `qianfan` | `QIANFAN_API_KEY` |
| GMI Cloud | `gmi-cloud` | `GMI_API_KEY` |
| Synthetic | `synthetic` | `SYNTHETIC_API_KEY` |
| ZenMux | `zenmux` | `ZENMUX_API_KEY` |
| Kilo Gateway | `kilo` | `KILO_API_KEY` |
| NanoGPT | `nanogpt` | `NANO_GPT_API_KEY` |
| Venice AI | `venice` | `VENICE_API_KEY` |
| AIML API | `aimlapi` | `AIMLAPI_API_KEY` |
| AI& | `aiand` | `AIAND_API_KEY` |
| Helmcode | `helmcode` | `HELMCODE_API_KEY` |
| Alibaba Coding Plan | `alibaba-coding-plan` | `ALIBABA_CODING_PLAN_API_KEY` |
| MiniMax Coding (Global) | `minimax-code` | `MINIMAX_CODE_API_KEY` |
| MiniMax Coding (CN) | `minimax-code-cn` | `MINIMAX_CODE_CN_API_KEY` |
| Umans AI Coding Plan | `umans` | `UMANS_AI_CODING_PLAN_API_KEY` |
| Sakana AI | `sakana` | `SAKANA_API_KEY` |
| CoralBricks | `coralbricks` | `CORAL_API_KEY` |
| Wafer Serverless | `wafer-serverless` | `WAFER_SERVERLESS_API_KEY` |
| Alibaba Token Plan | `alibaba-token-plan` | `ALIBABA_TOKEN_PLAN_API_KEY` |
| Alibaba Token Plan (CN) | `alibaba-token-plan-cn` | `BAILIAN_TOKEN_PLAN_API_KEY` |
| Charm Hyper | `charm-hyper` | `CHARM_HYPER_API_KEY`, `HYPER_API_KEY` |
| LiteLLM Proxy | `litellm` | `LITELLM_API_KEY` |
| SiliconFlow | `siliconflow` | `SILICONFLOW_API_KEY` |
| SiliconFlow (CN) | `siliconflow-cn` | `SILICONFLOW_CN_API_KEY` |
| Zhipu Coding Plan | `zhipu-coding-plan` | `ZHIPU_API_KEY` |
| Abliteration | `abliteration` | `ABLITERATION_API_KEY`, `ABLIT_KEY` |
| ClinePass | `cline-pass` | `CLINE_API_KEY` |
| Command Code | `commandcode` | `COMMAND_CODE_API_KEY`, `COMMANDCODE_API_KEY` |
| CoreWeave Serverless Inference | `coreweave` | `COREWEAVE_API_KEY` |
| Fire Pass | `firepass` | `FIREPASS_API_KEY` |
| Ollama Cloud | `ollama-cloud` | `OLLAMA_CLOUD_API_KEY` |
| Yolo Auto | `yolo-auto` | `YOLO_AUTO_API_KEY` |

Where two variables are listed, either is accepted; the first is the primary.

CoreWeave Serverless Inference also needs `COREWEAVE_PROJECT=<team>/<project>` in the DSH process environment before it is added.

</details>

## Quick start

### Install — DeepSeek Harness Desktop / Web

In the DeepSeek Harness Desktop or Web app, open **Plugins**, click
**Add plugin**, enter `dsh-keys-manager` in the package field, and click
**Install**. When the install finishes, choose **Enable now** so the plugin is
switched on.

Through the wizard, the app installs the same published npm package as the
CLI path below, already carrying its built bundle. Refresh the DeepSeek
Harness page afterwards so the browser half is fetched.

### Install — published package

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-keys-manager
```

Installing `dsh-keys-manager` installs two bundle components. The published
package depends on `dsh-llm-omp-transports`, so one install resolves both npm
packages, and the plugin page lists both `dsh-keys-manager` and
`llm-omp-transports`. Enable both: the manager owns credentials and routing,
the transport component owns the Cursor wire protocol.

### Install — local checkout

```sh
git clone https://github.com/btspoony/dsh-keys-manager
cd dsh-keys-manager
pnpm i
dsh plugin --profile web link .
```

The two CLI paths differ in where the build output comes from: `dsh plugin
--profile web add dsh-keys-manager` installs the published npm tarball, which
ships the built `lib/` and the client bundle. The local
`dsh plugin --profile web link .` path runs `prepare` during `pnpm i`, which
builds `lib/` and the client bundle, so the clone flow above includes that
build step; `prepack` builds the same output when the package is packed or
published.

Refresh the Web page after installing so the browser half is fetched.

## Usage

Open **Plugins → Keys Manager → View** (rendered as
`Plugins → 密钥管理 → 查看` in the Chinese locale). The manager renders on the
plugin's detail page, between its description and its included rows, matching
the shipped plugin configuration cards.

1. Search for a provider. Existing DSH providers appear first; the plugin also
   ships the curated extra catalog described above.
2. Adopt a provider. For an existing provider the manager imports the
   currently resolved credential, writes a broker reference into the provider
   profile, and leaves the original key in the credential store so release can
   restore it.
3. Add more keys with an alias. Every key is stored in the Harness credential
   store under its own reference; the manager state document never contains a
   key literal.
4. Manage a key from the three-dot menu: rename, pause/resume, delete. A key
   row shows status, last use, and the recovery time while cooling.
5. Tune retry count (1–3), base cooldown, and recovery grace in the settings
   card.

### OAuth accounts

Providers that ship a native OAuth sign-in offer two ways to join the pool:
**Add key** stores a static API key, while **Add account** runs the
provider's OAuth sign-in flow and stores the resulting grant as an account
row in the same pool.

Supported providers — the seven whose OAuth flows `llm-pi-ai` implements:
Anthropic, GitHub Copilot, Kimi Coding, OpenAI Codex, OpenRouter, Radius,
and xAI.

The increment-1 model is honest about scope: **API keys form the selection
ring** — sticky sessions, round-robin, retry failover, and cooldowns
operate across the provider's API keys — while **one projected OAuth grant
serves its provider**: the account whose grant is projected answers
requests directly, and one active grant per provider is kept. Per-account
ranking (rotating or load-balancing between accounts) is future work. An
account row's counters reflect that account's own successes and failures,
not a per-account traffic split. When the projected grant fails (expired
or refresh rejected), the account cools down. On a key-capable route the
pool falls back to the provider's key pool; an OAuth-only route has no
API-key pool and stops serving requests until an account is signed in
again. Recovery is a manual re-login from the account menu.

Adding an account stores only the provider-issued grant in the Harness
credential store, behind the account's `grantRef`; the manager state keeps
the reference plus non-sensitive metadata (email, account id, expiry) — the
same secret-free layout as API keys.

### Sign-in providers (Kilo, Z.AI Coding Plan)

Two more routes sign in from Keys Manager thro
